tieu_de: The blessings of the Saints
noi_dung:
THE VOICES OF THE SAINTS

Heaven and earth are impartial, gods supervise, do not give blessings because of worship, do not give blessings because of disrespect, people in position do not fully enjoy, do not fully enjoy when they have blessings, do not bully the poor, the three types of people are cyclical in heaven's fate, one day of good deeds, blessings have not yet arrived, disasters gradually fade away; One day of doing evil, although disaster has not yet arrived, blessings gradually drift away. People who practice good deeds, like grass in a spring garden, do not see long growth, but grow day by day; Those who practice evil, like sharpening stones, do not see damage, wear out day by day, harm others and seek selfish interests, they must be abandoned!

Dong Nhac Dai De - Reviving treasures

The desire to seek glory, honor is not positive, zealous to get rich, children and grandchildren die; Practicing wisdom and virtue, blessings and blessings come; faint wishes, long life in peace; Don't deceive lonely people, don't obscure the three lights; a true soul, a spirit at your side; The disaster will be cured, with boundless blessings.

True Martial Emperor

The origin of animals is the creator, people and animals have reincarnated from eternity to the present;

You should not wear feathers and hang horns, advise people not to have an animal mentality.

Phu Am Master

Blessings and misfortunes are immeasurable, they are brought by the person themselves; Good and evil are rewarded, like a shadow following the image.

Composed by Thai Thuong.

Good is rewarded with good, evil is rewarded with evil, don't think that the reward has not yet come, the time has not yet come.

The person who creates merit accumulates good, and will definitely be lucky; If a house does not create good fortune, there will always be disaster.

Horror

tieu_de: Ten merits of publishing scriptures
noi_dung:
TEN MERITS OF PRINTING THE SUTRAS

1. If you have accidentally committed a crime, if the crime is light, it will be immediately extinguished; if the crime is serious, it will be converted into a light one.

2. Often supported by good gods, avoiding all pestilences, swordsmen, robbers, imprisonment, fires, floods, etc.

3. Thanks to the Dharma, those who held grudges against us in previous lives are liberated and thus avoid the suffering of revenge.

4. The evil Yaksha cannot be invaded, hungry tigers, and poisonous snakes cannot be harmed.

5. The mind is at peace, there is no danger during the day, there are no nightmares at night, the beauty is bright and fresh, there is abundant energy, good deeds and benefits.

6. Wholeheartedly serving the Dharma, although not wishing for anything, food and clothing are naturally enough, and the family is in harmony and blessed with eternal life.

7. In words and deeds, heaven and people are happy; Wherever he goes, he is admired by many people.

8. If you are stupid, you will turn into wisdom, if you are sick, you will turn into healthy, if you are in danger, you will turn into peace. If you are a woman, after death you will turn into a man.

9. Stay away from evil paths (hell, hungry ghosts, animals), be born in good realms (human, heavenly) with a dignified appearance, intelligent, outstanding and blessed with more blessings than others.

10. Enough power to create good roots for sentient beings, use the minds of sentient beings to become a field of blessings and will reap many good results. Wherever you are born, you will see the Buddha and hear the Dharma; The three types of wisdom (literature, thought, practice) are expanded, and six supernatural powers are attained (celestial eyes, heavenly ears, other minds, life-sufficient, spiritual-sufficient, and emptiness).

tieu_de: Cause and effect
noi_dung:
INDIAN SONG

Yuan Liufan was a famous scholar who lived during the Ming Dynasty. During his lifetime, he mastered Buddhism and left behind many valuable works on meditation practice. His most famous work is Lieu Pham Tu Huan (titled "The Study of Destiny" or "Mastering Destiny").

This book tells about his life. When he was young, he met Mr. Confucius, who was an expert in predicting fate, and Vien Lieu Pham's entire life, from studies, exams, titles, and benefits, was all clearly indicated without error. Contemplating for more than 20 years, Vien Lieu Pham completely believes that fate has been arranged, no need to try.

Once by chance he met Zen master Van Coc, and Vien Lieu Pham taught him the method to change his fate. This method is truly within everyone's reach, not beyond: being humble, admitting mistakes, making merit, constantly doing good deeds, advising others to do good deeds, respecting superiors and subordinates... Vien Lieu Pham seemed to have lifted the clouds to see the blue sky again. He thoroughly practiced good dharma, helped people, helped life, and accumulated virtue to improve his destiny. His entire life in the following years changed completely, from his career to his fortune, his children also enjoyed great blessings...

In early March 2014, a Buddhist came to visit An Bien Pagoda (Van 244 To Hieu, Hai Phong). When he bent down to worship the statue of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, this person saw below the statue's foot a book titled: "Jade Lich Buu Phieu". He invited me home to read. It turns out that "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" is a book that promotes goodness, teaching people about Cause and Effect - Reincarnation with real stories dating back to the Qing Dynasty (China). In addition, the terrible retribution realms of hell are also narrated very clearly and in detail. Realizing the value of the book, he vowed to print 100 books, but due to economic conditions not yet allowing him, he prayed: "I would like to print 10 books first and put them on Ven Pagoda. May the holy gods bless me to fulfill my wish."

That evening (March 29, 2014), Vajra Master Thich Lien Chieu Chan Buddha Sect had a Dharma lecture at Ven Pagoda. When passing by the bookshelf, he picked up a book and brought it to the Dharma conference. That is "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", so he also had a great relationship with this book before.

In 1977, Venerable Master Thich Lien Chieu (Chinese-Vietnamese, not yet ordained as a monk) crossed the border in the East Sea. Unfortunately, the boat's engine caught fire and drifted aimlessly at sea for weeks. More than seventy people had no food or drink, just lying there waiting to die. At one point, the boat was surrounded by many sharks. During that time of death and death, he suddenly remembered the book he had read since childhood, sincerely prayed to Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva for rescue and vowed to print 500 copies of "Jade Lich Buu Phieu". When everyone has lost all hope, miracles happen. The next day, a large ship happened to pass by and dropped a rope to pull and resupply the boat. However, that night, the sea was rough and the waves were huge. Small boats can sink at any time. At that moment, Master Thich Lien Chieu saw the entire boat surrounded by a white halo of light. Thanks to this light, the boat kept its balance in the storm and safely docked at the Malaysian port. Ten years later, Master Thich Lien Chieu settled in Australia and completed his vow to publish this book.

Previously, when reading the book "The Study of Destiny" by Yuan Lieu Pham, we had the intention of copying the seal. But because the book dates back quite a long time, we wanted to find a story that was closer to home. Now that fate has arrived, we have re-edited the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", keeping the original part intact, in addition to adding a chapter: "The story of reincarnation of cause and effect in Vietnam". It includes real, close stories of cause and effect reincarnation with full images, names and addresses of the characters in Vietnam to increase the book's persuasiveness. With the support of Venerable Thich Tuc Bach (abbot of An Bien - Ven pagoda) and good men and women from near and far, in the first printing, nearly 7,000 books of Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu were printed.

If anyone has the karma to preach generously for others, he will gain immeasurable merit. If anyone has the heart to print this book, they will gain inconceivable merit. May the merits of publishing this book be dedicated to all sentient beings who fully attain Buddhahood, all Buddhists whose minds are strong, when encountering bad things, they become good, their bodies are healthy, and their practice is complete and accomplished. May the merits of publishing this book be dedicated to the country of Vietnam, a prosperous nation, good weather, a strong economy, happy people, and peaceful lives.

Namo Great Compassion Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva
Namo Great Vow Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva
Namo Buddha Namo Dharma Namo Sangha

tieu_de: FOREGOING
noi_dung:
FORESTINES

In early 2013, when I finished reading the book “Three Lives Sutra of Cause and Effect” (Religion Publishing House), I was deeply impressed by the simple words that contained profound principles and meanings of Venerable Thich Thien Tam. After that, the Venerable's words kept echoing in me: "We also have a lot of reincarnation of cause and effect in Vietnam. it's a pity that no one recorded it in a book, so it was scattered. Therefore, writers had to find a translation of stories in China." "That's right!" I suddenly thought : "Our country is rich in historical and cultural traditions, stories about cause and effect reincarnation are not lacking, if if we could collect them and write them into books for everyone to read, it would be great".

I immediately started doing it: searching on the internet, posting calls on spiritual forums, reading books about cause and effect, reincarnation, etc. Every time I collected a story, I edited it and saved it. The first stories to mention are: "Human Face Acne", "The Reincarnation Story of Baby Hoa Binh", "The Man Reincarnated as a Pig" or "The Realm After Death"... But the most surprising thing is, less than a year later, I was assigned by the Venerable Thich Tuc Bach to edit and publish the book "Jade Lich Buu Phieu". All the collected stories are made into one chapter: "The Story of Karma and Reincarnation". In Vietnam", just like my wish last year.

In addition to the Cause and Effect stories available in books and newspapers, there are many other good men and women who have contributed and told them honestly and clearly because they themselves have experienced them. It is these things that have made the book a unique good book: A Vietnamese book “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu” with very special meaning and value. The book's content intertwines ancient and modern stories of Karma and Reincarnation with similar details with enough evidence about characters, images, time, and place to make even the most conservative people nod.

During the process of mobilizing and revising the book, the phenomenon of induction from devoted devotees was continuously reported in countless numbers. One day, while I was sitting at home doing my usual work, a famous medium in Hai Phong (who didn't know I was preparing to publish a book) accidentally passed by my house. She came into the house and, without saying a word, pointed at me and said: "Hey, you're planting a very big blessing tree. The people who are familiar with you will also enjoy this blessing. You must try to nurture it into an old tree." Said. After that, she turned on her heel and left.

Why is it "you're planting such a big blessing tree", is it because what you're doing is giving alms of Dharma - publishing scriptures? But giving Dharma alms is to gain inconceivable merit:

“ Faith is the first step of religion, and the mother of all merits. I hope those who are predestined, when they come to this book, will begin to practice and believe in evil spirits, to believe in the retribution of sins and blessings, the transition to reincarnation, and the epiphany of Dharma. Therefore, Continue to read the higher sutras one after another. At that time, if there is no form, no form, no matter what, you will ask the Buddha and wake up." (Venerable Thich Thien Tam)

This book is intended to help people with predestined relationships to have faith in the Dharma, practitioners to have a strong spiritual mind in their practice, or those who do not yet believe to maintain a neutral attitude and be cautious in their speech, abandoning evil and doing good. I respectfully request you, dear friends from everywhere, to join me in cultivating this small "blessed tree" to become an ancient tree. I have a dream, in which every child in the world, regardless of skin color, race or religion, learns about Cause and Effect as their first lessons when they go to school. I vow to forever preach the cause and effect of Samsara for the sake of others. As long as sentient beings of the six paths do not know reincarnation or believe in cause and effect, I swear I will not become a Buddha.

tieu_de: GOOD MEMORIES CONSTANTLY CHANGE FATE
noi_dung:
GOOD MEMORIES NON-STOP CHANGING FATE

“Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu Khuyen The Van”, Mr. Triet Giang Thieu Tu Kien wrote: “Doing things against conscience in a dark room, the eyes of gods are like electricity, the whispers of humanity, the sky sounds like thunder, from here you can know that the way of heaven is It's difficult to hide, but ghosts and spirits are nowhere to be found. If there is a good thought, there will immediately be a potential blessing, or if there is an evil thought, a divine reprimand will immediately form, and the blessing will come naturally, not far away, just in the mind.

The reason why the field of blessing, that is, the field of mind, is planted is the cause, what is received is the result, the way of heaven is clear, one cup is no different, so there is no need to discuss the path of retribution, but retribution must be in there, why do Confucians always use cause and effect to retribution. The theory of heaven and hell, stupid people, use this principle to say that they like to talk nonsense, such as Thai Thuong Touch Thien, Van Xuong Dan Que Tich, Quan Thanh Giac The Sutra, and other types of true teachings of the gods, are also the teachings of Shinto, knowing that the Shinto nourishes the saints and sages, the royal path is inherently human, Shinto is just the royal path, to put our mind at peace, good is not necessary. If you feel ashamed, you can examine your heart at night, that is the promise of the saints and sages, as well as the Buddhas.

The one-inch-square spiritual platform, that is, the silver and silver bow, the world of lapis lazuli, riches and blessings, I pray for, the place of my body is heaven, why would the demon Yaksha dare to bully me, and the mountain of knives is truly terrifying, a gentleman who knows all four things, is also very afraid that his good heart will not be solid, he will be lost in the dark, guilty of heaven, without anything to seek. Today in this treacherous and deceitful world, if you want to give people's hearts a strand of light and overcome all suffering, you should only read “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu Khuyen The Van” ”

Three years ago, I also read “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu”, after reading it, I deeply felt that this book was great, very helpful. For the sake of humanity, I read this book and deeply understood the determination of the gods to save people, so I spent my own money to print books to give to people, also mobilized some good-hearted monks to print gift books, and directly bought books at the Thoai

Thanh bookstore in Taichung to give to people. The books that I donated, there are over thousands of books, I read this book, with the following feeling:

First, this is a precious book that believes that hell exists. Before the book, no one had talked about the situation of hell in detail like that. It can be said that this book has revealed the secrets of heaven. The condition of hell is inherently indescribable, because hell in the ultimate truth is "existence and non-existence", it can be said yes, it can also be said no, it can be virtual, the true appearance of hell, completely depends on the human mind. I believe there is hell. Why do I admit there is hell, because I live and see it, just like seeing the suffering of hell on earth. Since the human continent has hell, then the underworld and spirit world naturally also has hell.

Second, great academics, great scientists, consider themselves geniuses, there are many people who do not believe in heaven and hell, thinking that it is a religious fabrication, is stupid, is a Shinto religion, is not true. But have they ever thought about it? If people do good deeds, their minds will feel at peace. If people do evil deeds, they will always feel uneasy in their hearts. The phenomenon of a peaceful mind is heaven, but the phenomenon of an uneasy mind is hell. In the invisible, there will be demons and spirits, and these demons are the evolution and feeling of the mind.

Third, although Buddhism does not talk about destiny, there is also the law of cause and effect, each person's destiny has its own side, each person is different, even when born, everyone is different. In my eyes, the trajectory of human destiny seems to be half determined by heaven, especially today I have come to this step, I believe even more in the existence of destiny, because my destiny is truly real. It's truly a feeling of having experienced it. There are many people who come to me to ask for a change in their destiny. I tell them: "changing our destiny is all in our hands. Don't hope to change your destiny. We work all our lives, just don't be ashamed of ourselves, just pray for peace of mind."

Continuous good thoughts can change your luck. If you want to know these principles, read "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu Khuyen Khuyen The Van"! Or read the book “Lieu Pham Tu Huan”. Fate is created by yourself, then naturally you can change it yourself. Now I can only say to everyone, if you constantly have good thoughts, you can change your destiny. You can change your own destiny. If you ask someone else to change your destiny, is that climbing a tree and catching fish? "Reading the book written by Thieu Tu Kien, I feel that the cycle of cause and effect is still a constant retribution, but that heaven and hell, good and evil at a single thought are all changes in the mind. I advise people to do good deeds and my throat is exhausted. I try my best to advise people to do many good deeds, but I myself am laughed at. I laugh painfully, the human mind in the human world is quickly lost, lost.

I wrote: "The great good can feel blue sky. Because heaven has eyes, destiny can be changed. If destiny cannot be changed, then what is the point of trying this life?”

"The affairs of the world are idealistic and conscious only, human destiny is only good and righteous. If good thoughts do not stop, heaven will definitely help. Temporary destiny is like thunder or lightning, light as mist, fast as lightning. If you want to escape the bondage of destiny, there is only one way to rise up yourself. All dharmas, must take good as the starting point, because good thoughts pray to the gods for help. On the contrary, if you take evil as the starting point, then That magic is evil, those who practice magic will surely be inflicted with disaster. Hell is real, please see "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu Khuyen The Van", please see the spiritual book".

(Dharma King Lu Thang Ngan Chan Phat Tong wrote his thoughts about the book Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu in Taiwan 1977).

tieu_de: SHARING WORDS FROM THE BOOK TRANSLATOR
noi_dung:
THE BOOK TRANSLATOR'S SHARING WORDS

The translator of this book is Ms. Thach My Nghi (Phap Dieu), Chinese-Vietnamese, living in District 10 - Ho Chi Minh City. During the translation process, she experienced many miracles. The following is what she shared:

"In mid-July 2005, she accidentally discovered a lump in her chest, so she went to the doctor and was diagnosed with cancer. At that time, the sky seemed to fall, all hope of living was gone. Despair and despair. But she is a very optimistic person, knowing how to accept the truth. She still calmly translated all the documents for the company and then handed over the work clearly and agreed upon. with the company and then began the journey to regain her life. During the treatment period, she still went to work. Usually, after chemotherapy, she took a break for 5 days and then went back to work normally...

One day a Chinese colleague gave her the book Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu in Chinese. During her 5-day sick leave, she read the entire book, including many passages mentioning “printing or reading the book to many people will cure a serious illness”. She thought there were many Chinese books out there. If they could be translated into Vietnamese, it would be great. Because the book is circulated in Vietnam, more people will read and respond. She decided to try translating.

During the time of translating the book, there were many times she wanted to give up because translating this book from Chinese to Vietnamese was too difficult for her ability, so she stopped translating. But it seemed like there was an invisible force pushing her to continue translating and repeating it over and over again, stopping and translating again for 2 years before completing it. To have the motivation to continue translating books, it is impossible not to mention the strange things that have happened:

First of all, when I first translated the book, it was also a time of terrible financial difficulties. A chemotherapy prescription cost 13 million VND, which in 2005 was a huge amount of money. When she didn't know where to get the money for treatment, a generous friend happened to volunteer to help her financially.

After that, there were stories that she only secretly wished for in her heart but were satisfied. That was when her husband suddenly quit smoking without her saying anything. Or there was a time when some neighbors fought because of a disagreement. She stood up to stop her. The neighbor ran out and hit her in the head with a wooden stick. The stick was about to hit her. She thought that if she hit her head, she wouldn't die but her head would break. Yet this person suddenly tripped and fell and she was unharmed.

In 2007, she was diagnosed with recurrent cancer, but thanks to early detection, she was cured. In total, she underwent 2 surgeries, 1 radiation treatment, and chemotherapy and is completely healthy until now. When she finished translating the book in 2008, she dreamed that Buddha Tathagata gave her two hands full of seven-colored relics. She heard that just seeing the relics was a blessing, but she was given two handfuls full of them. In 2012, she had an accident on the way to work. The car crashed and her head was crushed, but she was completely unharmed. In addition, there are many other difficulties in life that were strangely overcome smoothly. When I remember, I will tell more..." (Lien Hoa Thai Duong recorded according to Ms. Thach My Nghi. She was born in 1966, lives in Ngo Gia Tu Apartment Complex F3 - District 10 - Ho Chi Minh City. Facebook Thach My Nghi.)

tieu_de: RECOMMEND THE Dharma POPULAR AND PROPAGATE
noi_dung:
PREMIFIED THANH Dharma POPULAR PROPAGATION

“Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu” is a book “The Law of the Sound” that has been passed down for many years. The author of this book is an enlightened monk. In fact, it is recorded in the classics of Buddhist schools in ancient China, and in the classics of Taoism. “Ton Giam Fairy” was also rewritten. Later generations, Mr. Yu Thich Dao of the Three Teachings also had a famous master to serve as proof, when this generation of high-ranking monk Thich Tinh Khong took the promotion effect of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" very seriously and personally wrote the title of the book to worship. In May 1996, our country also published a book containing the old version of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", so the spiritual experience was witnessed, the effects were seen quickly, so the history of writing and printing was limitless.In order to make this book easier to read and understand, we have repeatedly compared it with the ancient version, completed the translation, corrected the current errors in the current version and added real recent events about retribution, expanded the content of the chapters, approached the readers after reading and introduced many friends to read it together, hoping that society will be understanding, have the wisdom to be honest, have the wisdom to establish morality to become a gentle gentleman, have awareness and immediately take action. Good believers who have the good fortune to encourage and encourage them have the conditions to reproduce, print, circulate, and spread to the masses, so that everyone can unanimously walk on the pure path, save people like water and fire, lead sentient beings to the good path, so that society can be peaceful, for our country to build the spirit of culture and civic morality, so the practice of good deeds is very great!

Tran Minh Qua

tieu_de: PROCEDURE FOR THE EMPEROR'S Blessing Forest Price
noi_dung:
THE ORDER OF THE EMPEROR'S Blessing of Lam Phu

Currently in society, humanity's behavior and nature are increasingly shallow, and they soon do bad things, leading to a decrease in moral character, crime rates are constantly increasing, society is not stable, and it is difficult for people to be at peace.

Compassion for Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha Vuong and the Gods discussed together, wanting to turn the truth of retribution into a book that would be passed down to the world, giving humanity the understanding to turn evil into good, to be blessed with benefits, to stabilize society and people's hearts! In Heaven's mercy, he quickly approved this report and compiled it into "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and distributed it to inform the world: everyone complies with the content of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", those who know how to repent and correct their mistakes, will be especially lenient, and punishments will be exempted from them. I hope that humanity will feel the sense to correct the wrong things they have done, not do bad things, and awaken to the truth.

Currently, unbeknownst to humans, every Canh Than day of the lunar calendar, the rulers of the gods in the cities and hamlets - Than Thanh Vuong and Than Dia Dia, will send deities such as Than Duong Duong, Than Than Duong Duc, Than Tao Quan... to locations and households to patrol, survey and take note of the good and evil deeds of humans in the world and the status of compliance with "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to report to heaven. Everyone who donates money or tries their best to print and spread this book of Buu Dien will be blessed in heaven, allowing them to enjoy glory and wealth forever; Also because of incurable diseases and diseases that have not been cured for a long time, printing and spreading this book will help that person be cured and have good health; If there is a situation such as disharmony between husband and wife, resentment among relatives, bad fortune, unfilial children... if you print and spread this book, the family will be in harmony and fortune will also be good; if you want

If you go abroad to do business, study or go to another country to work, if this book is printed or spread on the right path, you will avoid traffic dangers and robberies along the way... unfavorable events, and your work will go smoothly; If you can cross the mountains and rivers, enter the villages in the remote mountainous areas, spread the word and advise humanity to follow the meaning and content of this book, all kinds of demons, demons, poisonous snakes, and wild beasts will not dare to trespass, and besides, the merit will be immeasurable, blessings will come quickly! The merit of circulating, printing, and promoting the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" can not only liberate the souls of ancestors and be exempted from punishment in Diem Phu for the sins one has committed, but can also create many blessings and benefits for people living on earth. This is a very happy and joyful thing for mankind.

tieu_de: THE PRINCIPAL OF THE HAN CHAN PEOPLE RECOMMENDS OFFERING "BUU PHIEU JEWELS"
noi_dung:
THE ORDINARY OF THE HOLDER'S ENCOURAGEMENT Offering “JADE OF BUDDHIEU”

In the depths of the universe, Buddha, Bodhisattva and the Divine Spirits have left behind many sutras for sentient beings to save, many of which have content referring to the karma and transformation of hell. However, there is no book like "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" that shows details about the things humans have done and the corresponding retribution events and also no book like "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" that deals with large and small tragic events in hell and real suffering situations. There are 38 points in the book, enough for people to wake up and correct their mistakes. The book has great merit for this world. The mentality of humans in this world is uneven. People with noble wisdom clearly understand the principle of cause and effect, about good retribution, about evil retribution, try to cultivate morality, so that their own spirituality is pure, thoroughly enlightened to the truth, and transcends the three worlds. These people do not need to

Preach morality and blessings to them so that they can voluntarily follow the law of cause and effect to create blessings and enjoy. People with intermediate intelligence, because they attach too much importance to material things, do not know, do not understand, have not yet authenticated, have not realized the non-materiality of the spiritual world, and even mistakenly consider it superstitious, do not understand that it is an inevitable part of the universe, so they have random gestures and words, do not hesitate to do evil things, act without conscience, and do not understand the painful retribution they receive when descending to hell?

From ancient times until now, generals and princes have often suffered the torture of retribution because of a split-second mistake. For example: famous general Bach Khoi of the Qin court during the Spring and Autumn Warring States period, in the Truong Binh war zone, killed four hundred thousand enemy soldiers. Therefore, in his next life he was reincarnated on earth as a chicken, snake, and hiss, all of whom were struck by lightning and died. The bodies all have his name "Bach Khoi". While in hell, he was often immersed in filth and endured all kinds of torture, all of which were tested. Prime Minister Ly Lam Bu of the Tang Dynasty built a "Uyen Nguyet" room at his house to kill officials when they disagreed. When he died, he spent seven lives as a prostitute, nine lives as a buffalo, and was reincarnated as an aquatic animal for humans to slaughter, tease, and cook. The Song Dynasty general, Cao Han, after taking over the city, killed many innocent people in the city. When he died, he repeatedly warned the people in the city in his dreams: "I was once majestic but killed everyone in the city, so in a hundred lifetimes, I must be reincarnated as a chicken for people to slaughter. After this retribution ends, I will still fall into hell." Alas!A human life is not very long, but half an hour in hell is extremely long and difficult to pass. In the Buddhist scriptures, it is said that animals, hungry ghosts, hell, once in the three evil realms last as long as a thousand

eons, the sentient beings reincarnated there are truly pitiful.

Confucianism, Christianity, and Buddhism all guide people to be good as the basis, can control dishonest thoughts, distinguish the difference between saints and evil people. These three religions all carry the idea of ​​pity for living beings and compassion for the world. Confucius once said: "Bad things should not be seen, heard, discussed and communicated, much less done. This is the key to deciding whether a person becomes a sage or a commoner." Confucius also said: "It should not be for one's own benefit. If one can truly do this, then that person is no longer a virtuous person but a saint." Mencius said: “Confucius's views are very precious!” These concepts define the difference between humans and animals. If you regularly do good deeds, your next life will definitely be prosperous and prosperous, and this life will be favorable.

In Buddhism, it is said that everything depends on causes and conditions, ultimately returning to emptiness. Contemplate your mind and be awakened; The method of Taoism is to adhere to the path of moderation, to persistently follow objective laws and principles without acting according to one's own subjective ideas. In short, in human life, ambition, desire and controlling and controlling them are the key to determining life, death and local misfortune. Therefore, can humanity not read, comply, adhere to the "Jade Lich Buu Phieu" and be wary of the evil cause and effect?

In heaven, there is the virtue of eagerness for rebirth, specifically approving the leader of the Yama Temple Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to announce a number of provisions related to humanity repenting of their mistakes, granting the "Jade Lich Buu Phieu" to circulate in the world, and agreeing to allow those who have made mistakes to reform as human beings after death. You can also go to heaven or enjoy your blessings in peace. Therefore, this book is also called "Tu An Ngoc Lich". People in the world base

According to your ability, in front of the God of Kitchen Gods in the kitchen (if you have not yet worshiped the God of Kitchen Gods, you can worship in any direction), or in a clean room, or Buddha hall, or outdoors, regardless of the first day, the tenth full moon, or the thirtieth day, sincerely vow to print, spread, and propagate this book, so that the public can know, everyone abandons evil and does good. Thus, society will be peaceful and stable, and your family and yourself will be prosperous and prosperous.

tieu_de: Bodhisattva's true birth order
noi_dung:
Bodhidharma Chan Nhan Xia Tu

The saints help and transform the wishes of sentient beings, just like the heaven and earth universe, there is no end, it is boundless! Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and the Gods of the Ten Halls of Hell pitied the sentient beings suffering in hell, so they reported to the Jade Emperor so that this book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" would be circulated in the world, to awaken the world's people to practice goodness and accumulate blessings. When reading this book, it seems like I am in hell, surrounded by judges, demon soldiers, and disaster scenes in hell. This cannot help but awaken people; Reincarnation of life and death is inevitable, it is absolutely not wrong for those who do bad things to suffer terrible retribution. The book talks about the morals of real events that do not change no matter how much time passes. The book clearly states in Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism the ideas of cause and effect and retribution of good and evil and the concept of compassion and redemption, allowing those who do a lot of good deeds in this life or the next to enjoy blessings, and also being able to pardon those who have made mistakes to correct and repent, which is the basic content of this book.Therefore, this book is different from other good books. There are some people who do not understand, consider this book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu"

to be a wrong view, think that as ancient people often said: "No evidence" (not enough evidence), or think that it is a superstitious book. In fact, people who are ignorant, despise and despise the gods but have the will to do good can easily fall into hell. Nowadays, it is often said for good believers who want to have this book re-compiled and published: the person who prints and spreads the book is good, all things are great; Enjoying blessings for life after life, let alone printing and circulating the precious book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" like that? People who develop good intentions and good intentions will sublimate their morality and reach the heavenly realm. However, we do not know how great the good deeds will be, but if we know that the good deeds are boundless, then the blessings will also be boundless.

tieu_de: CHAPTER 1: BACKGROUND OF “BUU PHIEU JADE”
noi_dung:
CHAPTER 1: THE BACKGROUND OF “THE JADE OF BUDDHA”

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva teaches sentient beings in the Hellfire World. On Christmas day, the King of Hell and the Ten Halls of Gods and Gods from everywhere came to worship and congratulate the Bodhisattva.

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Bodhisattva said compassionately: "I rely on the power of my compassionate vow to save sentient beings. On the day of the astral body, I always give instructions, amnesty or remission of punishment to the demons who commit crimes, releasing them to the six realms. Unfortunately, people in the world, doing very few good deeds, many doing evil, one person goes, another comes, while the salvation has not ended, the punishments in the underworld are truly miserable, bothering you to consider carefully. To be exact, if there is a criminal who knows how to repent and who, while living on earth, advises people to do one or two good deeds, the punishment can be considered lenient or reduced. Therefore, we must take advantage of any good method, so that people in the world believe in cause and effect, repent of their sins, stop all evil deeds, always practice good deeds, cultivate their minds towards Buddha, allowing people to gradually move away from the cycle of life and death Hell. On the other hand, is it possible for sentient beings in the underworld to rely on the merits of future generations to be able to quickly escape?

After the discussion of the Ten Halls, King Yama told Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva that if people on earth were honest from a young age and constantly accumulated merit, after death they could go to heaven without immortality; Those who have merits and sins parallel to each other, after death can be exempted from entering the three evil paths of suffering, allowing them to be reincarnated as humans, ending the old relationships and gratitude of the previous life; Those who do little good deeds and do many bad deeds are led to hell and suffer torment. Then, based on the actions done in previous lives, consider the beginning

to become a rich person or a poor person, or a long-lived person, or a lifeless person, or a lifelong illness or disability. Therefore, to re-examine their good and evil dispositions, those who increase their goodness will be transferred to places of blessing, those who commit evil karma will be transferred to the torment of suffering, or let them go to places that are both miserable and poor, living but having to endure disasters, after death they will have to sink deep into hell for a long time. forever. Some people make up the false argument that when the dead person has stopped breathing and no longer feels, how can he still know the pain of torture? People on earth will not know that even though the body is dead, the soul still remains. When alive, you do evil things, and when you die, you still have to be punished. All those who spread evil ideas about cause and effect and cause future generations to misunderstand will also be pushed into hell to suffer eternal torment.There are some people who know that ancient saints and sages and religions that advise goodness and abstinence still think it is normal and not true. It is truly a betrayal of heaven and earth's kindness. Such people, even though they know it, persist in violating it and are repeatedly educated without correcting it, so they must be severely punished and given additional punishments. Currently, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has kindly advised, waiting for the study to discuss and report: all men and women on earth, whether healthy, old, weak, sick... who have done bad things in the past, if on the day of the gods' souls, the Bodhisattva and the Ten Halls of Hell can practice vegetarianism, vow to repent, ensure that they will not do evil in the future or resolve to do one or two charitable deeds, after death they will be exempted from going to the underworld. miserable floor. Except for those who are disloyal as gods, disloyal as sons, commit suicide and plot to harm good people in the world, they will be punished.

He was killed by lightning, died in water, died in fire, was killed by wolves, tigers, and snakes, and was taken to the hells to be examined to determine whether his merits were more or less, balanced, and then exempted from suffering to redeem good deeds. In addition, we must also investigate and gather information to see what mistakes we committed while on earth, which hells we went to, what punishments we received, and then use common words to make it easy for the worldly people to understand, for those who have morality to spread to the world and encourage the worldly people to understand.

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva said: “Yes, then do so, very good, very good!”

Thus, on August 3, he brought the prepared reports and regulations along with the King of Hell and the gods and presented them to the Jade Emperor. When the Jade Emperor finished watching, he was very happy and said: "Very good, very good!" Later, when all the gods supervise people on earth, if there is a person who swears to be good, while still alive, they repent, rectify a wrong thing they have done, do not commit it again, and be approved for exemption and atone for the punishment of two wrong things they have done; If, after repentance, you are determined to accomplish more than five things, all punishments will be pardoned; Men will be reincarnated into merit points, and women will be reincarnated as men. If, after rectification and repair, they perform more than five charitable acts, they will be allowed to represent their ancestors to enjoy blessings on earth, to pray for the souls of their relatives to escape suffering. You should quickly arrange things according to the process and method in the report compiled to "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to make known to the gods in the lower world below the people such as Than Thanh Hoang, Than Tho Dia, Than Mon, Than Tao Quan.From now on, you must seriously comply and respectfully comply with the laws in the book.

tieu_de: CHAPTER 2: THE PROCESS OF PLAYING “THE BUU PHIEU PEARL”
noi_dung: CHAPTER 2: THE PROCESS OF HANDLING “JADE OF BUU PHIEU”

tieu_de: 2.1 How was "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" transmitted to the world?
noi_dung:
2.1 How did “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu” spread to the world

“Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu” was transmitted by a poor monk who practiced ethically, named Dam Tri. The following is a true story that he personally experienced.

The time was in the year of Thai Binh, the fall of the year of Canh Ngo, the ninth day (Thong Cuu), the day of Mau Thin. Dam Tri climbed high mountains alone, strolling and wandering among the mountains and forests. For a moment, I saw a stone stele, on the stone stele was engraved a seal letter in the style of the verse, a total of 32 large words:

Without the great path, the heaven knows the love
Without the shortest match, the ghost sees the human form
The mind speaks in the same language, the ghost hears the human voice
Full of It is forbidden to violate, the land will confiscate people's souls

Surprisingly, I turned around and saw a sparklingly decorated palace. In front of the red door, a yellow nail hung a sign with four big words written on it: "Birth and death." While he was standing there looking bewildered, out of the red door came a messenger dressed in green who pulled him from the corner of the door inside, to the red steps to worship. After bowing, go down the steps.

In the main hall, the lights were bright, the candles were shining brightly, filled with joy. It turned out that the people were celebrating the life of the Great Emperor Phong Do, the Ten Halls of Hell King in the underworld, leading the judges of the realms to the main hall to celebrate the life of the Great Emperor.

After congratulating, the Great Emperor Phong Do said: “Ksitigarbha is compassionate

Bodhisattva wants to liberate all the ghosts in the underworld, so that the people in the world Don't do evil anymore, don't be in hell to suffer

image of suffering. Therefore, the grace for all ghosts, even though they have committed many mistakes on earth, but sincerely repent, reform and do more good deeds, will be able to replace the bad karma they have committed, can be forgiven to reduce their sins, and not suffer much torture and suffering. For this favor, the gods and goddesses gathered and reported it to the Jade Emperor. The Jade Emperor Great Emperor issued an edict to compile and write in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", granted permission to publish and spread it to the lower world, and to comply with it. But since the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" has been distributed to this temple for many years, I have not met a person with a mortal body on earth who has cultivated his mind and practiced virtue to be able to go to the underworld to bring this book back to earth to announce to people in the world. Currently, a cultivator named Dam Tri stands on the steps, completely capable of being assigned this responsibility and spreading it to the world. Once you have found the person, please ask the judges to quickly hand over the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and the fortunes of the gods, and copy it into a book.

Next, Phong Do Dai De said: "Before copying, follow the instructions of the Jade Emperor: the reports and traditional sentences before and after and the biographies of the gods, the full names must be erased. Only write Mau De Vuong, Mau Bodhisattva, Mau Dien Vuong, Mau Judge, or synonyms, then narrate the discussions and rows of sentences. Each sentence must have a clear semicolon, no sentence breaks are allowed. Yes It can be easily understood by men and women on earth, and hopefully be followed and implemented. In addition, it can also be passed down to justify other literature on earth. In the spring of the Year of the Horse, the third month of Giap Thin, he will present a report to the Jade Emperor and write it as part of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu".

tieu_de: 2.2 Justifying the wrong worldly parts
noi_dung:
2.2 Justifying the parts of the world that are deviant

2.2.1 Cause and effect of the city of unjust death

Phong Do Dai De said that the city of wrongful death rotates to the right in the palace.

People on earth mistakenly believe that the ghosts who were injured and died unjustly all refer to this city. False propaganda rumors are everywhere, each place is different.

In fact, those who died unjustly, how can you add unjust punishments to them? The truth is that the ghosts who died unjustly, have to wait until the murderer who murdered them dies and is taken to the underworld for questioning, seeing with their own eyes the perpetrator suffering torture, the hatred in their hearts can fade.

But these ghosts who have died unjustly, wait for the day to be reincarnated before bringing out the murderer, escorting them to the hell of the temples, depending on the crime, imprisoning or sending them away to endure torture. Not all ghosts who have died unjustly are gathered into the wrongful death city to be punished.

If they are loyal and filial people, soldiers who sacrifice for their country and people who sacrifice for the public, these people have good reputations and show signs of heroic spirit and have already become gods, then at least they will have a dignified face and perfect limbs to go to a blessed place to be reincarnated. There is no moral reason to send these people down to an unjust death to suffer a painful punishment.

2.2.2 Cause and effect of the lake of dirty blood

The lake of dirty blood is set up at the back, on the left side of the palace.

People in the world listen to the haphazard talk of witches and monks and misunderstand that all women who bleed during childbirth are dirty blood and are guilty. After they die, they all have to go into this lake of dirty blood to suffer torture. What a big mistake! A woman giving birth is a natural thing, even if she has difficulty in giving birth and dies, she does not have to be put into the lake of dirty blood for this reason.

The sins that must be put into this lake include:

1. No more than 20 days after giving birth, going near a well or kitchen to wash clothes, drying dirty clothes stained with dirty blood, exposing them to the open air, causes disgrace to the gods. This crime is attributed to the head of the family 3 parts, the woman accounts for 7 parts of the crime.

2. Regardless of whether male or female, do not abstain from having casual sex in front of the Buddha statue, near the Buddha statue, or do not taboo the day and time, for example: on the 14th and fifteenth full moon days of the fifth month, the third and thirteenth days of the eighth month, the tenth day of the tenth month, on these five days it is strictly forbidden to have sexual relations in the bedroom.

For people in the above two types, the gods will give that person an evil disease that will cause them to die, and after death they will have to suffer torment in hell. In addition, you have to permanently immerse yourself in a lake of dirty blood, making it difficult to lift your head.

3. Regardless of whether they are male or female, living on earth or killing animals, allowing blood to pollute the kitchen or altar of the Buddha hall (a house with a Buddhist hall that kills living beings), scriptures, books, literature, papers with words and objects of worship.

These types of people, after suffering painful punishments in hell, are escorted to the lake of dirty blood, immersed in the lake, not allowed to go up easily.

4. If relatives on earth could make an oath, on behalf of this person, they would abstain from killing animals and buying animals to release. Wait until a certain number of animals have been released, you must eat vegetarian food, take care of Buddha's deity, repent, and read the scriptures to neutralize the contamination of dirty blood. At this time, it is possible for them to escape the torment of hell.

2.2.3 The fate of the mountain crystal water monster

Men and women on earth who commit the following crimes will be reincarnated as the mountain crystal water monster:

1. Seeing and hearing someone in distress asking for help, while feeling like they had all the strength and conditions to help, but did not come to the rescue.

2. There are people who receive favors from others but intentionally forget them, and even create resentment and want to harm the benefactor.

The above two types of people, if they accumulate merit, recite Buddha's name, and give alms to the poor, hope that thanks to these merits, when they die, they will be taken to the Immortal Path. Buddhists will be exempted from being sent to the hells to suffer the punishment of suffering; But they must also be punished to become ghosts, goblins, tree spirits, water monsters, wandering souls or have that soul enter the body of a wolf, bear, or poisonous snake, sometimes for several decades or hundreds of years.

If one can wake up from previous mistakes, try to help people in trouble, be grateful to repay virtue, borrow merit to cultivate, then in this life one can return to one's nature and reach the blessed place of reincarnation.

On the contrary, after being punished, after being punished He became a mountain crystal and water monster without cultivating his mind, but also took advantage of magical manifestation to fascinate the worldly people, or scare the worldly people. Thus, when the day of his heinous crime ends, he will definitely be struck by lightning and die. Will be transformed into a "tep" (a ghost who dies and becomes a tep) will never be able to escape.

2.2.4 Causes and conditions of ghosts and spirits appearing

People on earth always mistakenly perceive ghosts and spirits that often appear as true gods. Therefore, to respect and worship was a big mistake.

Actually, these are mostly people who live in this world and keep their money buried underground. After death, they regret their wealth, and ghosts always hang around the place where their assets are buried. Due to fear of being dug up by people, ghosts often appear to scare people. Therefore, people misunderstand that it is the phenomenon of spirits appearing.

Some people with weak spirits and weak positive energy are often frightened to the point of illness or sick to death.

Actually, these ghosts are often officials or nobles of the Tang Dynasty. Because of their eternal confusion, they cannot understand the principle of impermanence in the world, so they are so stubborn. The gods and demons in the underworld thought that they were people who were still alive when they were born on earth and did not commit any crimes, so they allowed them to preserve the treasures left behind from their previous lives. They are truly ghosts with a reputation for greed for wealth.

It is necessary to wait until they hear the principles of Buddhism clearly stated and taught to understand that in the end, not only the body is not their property, including objects with shapes and colors, all feelings of happiness and sadness, thoughts of good and evil, all actions and consciousness of distinction, will eventually disappear and no longer exist. Only then will they wake up and understand that the body is not the last thing that can be owned, let alone money and treasure. object? Therefore, if you let go of the money of your previous life, then you can be reincarnated to a blessed place.

There are still some wealth-hungry ghosts who are still fascinated and stubbornly hold on to it until death. After turning into a "poor person", they have no choice but to let go. Wait until someone who has accumulated good fortune appears and will naturally get these assets. People in the world, if at the place where they just saw and heard the ghost appear, can make an oath of respect and swear, adding the words: "Agree to take that property, divide 1/3 to do meritorious deeds, use it to do good deeds, accumulate blessings and get more

Another third goes to buy animal life to release; 1/10 is given as a gift to the poor, the remaining 1/3 is kept for yourself. After taking such an oath, if you take the money for yourself, you will be blessed by the gods. If you swear, you will ensure that when using this property, you will no longer be afraid of being punished by the devil.

2.2.5 Retribution is the difference between dying as a soldier and when being beaten to death as a robber

All people who live on earth as soldiers, unless they obey orders to send troops to the battlefield to fight The enemy and the enemy, if they are loyal and try to fight the enemy, will never do such sinful things as rape, adultery, or burning down the homes of people of all nations. Although these people died on the battlefield, their bodies were separated and broken, even though they had committed mistakes in the past, in the underworld they were still exempted from all punishments, still allowing them to fully restore their bodies to their original form. From the first hall, after taking roll call, immediately hand over to the tenth hall, leading to the blessing point, reincarnating as a man or woman, peace of mind throughout life, death in a peaceful place.

If they fight, kill each other and die, or are robbers and are beaten to death, these types of people after death will be charged with additional crimes, based on the crimes committed in previous lives, and sent to hell to suffer painful punishments.

2.2.6 The misconception about eighteen levels of hell

People in the world say that in the underworld there are only eighteen levels of hell, this is a mistake. Actually, it should be called the eight great hells.

Like the great hell in the second hall; the great hell "black wire" in the third hall; The great hell "meets" in the fourth hall; the great hell “calls

to” in the fifth hall; The great hell "screams loudly" in the sixth hall; the great hell "old heat" in the seventh hall; the great hell "great heatman" in the eighth hall; The great hell "A Ty" in the ninth hall.

In addition to the eight great hells, there are also sixteen small hells, plus in the hall there is a lake of dirty blood, into unjust deaths, large and small, a total of 138 places. In addition, there are also bronze pillars and burning fires as points to distinguish and enforce the punishment of crimes.

All the guilty were scattered to places of torment, although they were burned until their flesh was burned, their skin was cracked, their bones were broken, and their blood flowed so profusely that they shivered; If you are still escorted to another hell to be punished, you will completely return to the way you were when you first died, you will be subjected to physical tortures, you will have to endure suffering again, every temple, every hell will be subjected to the same torture.

Don't think there are only eighteen levels of hell. A life of a hundred years is very easy to go through. If you compose and propagate obscene literature, erotic novels, describe and draw obscene pictures, film or copy obscene films, provide services, abortion drugs, or charms. As long as the originals, paintings, photos, and films like the above are not destroyed, it will be difficult for thousands of eons to escape the painful punishments in the hells of the underworld.

The above documents were completely copied by the Ten Palaces of Hell, distributed to the judge, copied into books, and compiled into the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu".

tieu_de: 2.3 Compilation and dissemination of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu"
noi_dung:
2.3 Compilation and dissemination of “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu”

The Yan soldiers of the Ten Halls and the owners of the dirty blood lake, the judges in the cities who died unjustly presented their accounts, gathered to form “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu”.

Since the distribution of “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu” until now, against criminals When the demons in hell investigated, they only heard people in the market and in the crowd talking about cause and effect. Although they were not sincere in propagandizing and educating, they could still use the excuse of conversion and sometimes meet virtuous people. After hearing the awakening warning from your heart, slowly correct one mistake, two things, three things, four things and more. It is a great merit, based on good virtue, when advising people to repent, to balance and reduce punishments for crimes.

There are a total of 50,480 such ghosts, the Ten Palaces of Hell will gather and decide where they will be reincarnated, distinguishing reincarnation as male or female, poor, sick, all will be reincarnated to earth to suffer and descend to become descendants of evil houses.

After that, everyone was pushed to the stage of oblivion, immediately had to drink oblivion soup to prepare to be reincarnated and would list out all the lists and present them to Phong Do Great Emperor for review.

After Phong Do Great Emperor finished reviewing and signed the documents, he ordered the martial arts judges to summon all evil criminals, lead the demon soldiers to disperse in all directions, take the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and read it once to make them remember the main content. weak.

After the demon soldier finished listening, he realized that it was because of the crimes he had committed in his previous life that he was being punished like today. At the same time, thank the Phong Do Great Emperor's great amnesty to let them know the content of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" which can be brought to the world to preach to humanity to atone for their sins.

Each demon soldier swears: "In the future when they come to this world, as long as they are not deaf, not blind and have some knowledge to hear and see "Ngoc Lich

Buu Phieu" will swear to definitely obey "Ngoc Lich Buu" Phieu" which thoroughly implements and amends, and at the same time accepts responsibility for promulgating and propagating."

tieu_de: 2.4 Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva gives instructions and promulgates merits and spreads the word "Jewel Lich Buu Phieu"
noi_dung:
2.4 Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva gives instructions and promulgates merits and deploys spreads "Jewel Lich Buu Phieu"

When the criminals and demons finished their oath, they immediately saw five brilliant colors everywhere, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva descending from the sky, the Great Emperor and the Ten Halls of Hell came to the palace steps, bowed their heads in reverence and worship. ceremony.

The Bodhisattva appeared with the blackened face of the demon king, a green-golden staff, a solemn dharma appearance and said: "The Great Emperor Phong Do and the Ten Halls of Hell, you and the gods in the underworld, when reporting the granting of "Jewel Calendar Buu Phieu" are obeying the vows of the great compassion Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha. Therefore, please bestow the "Jewel Calendar Buu Phieu" to men and women in the world. Once they have committed evil deeds, when they know it, they can practice and not do it again, allowing them to atone for their past mistakes and be free from suffering. The reason why they put down the knife and become a Buddha is precisely this meaning. If they can do that, I will be very happy."

However, thanks to Dam Tri returning to Tran Duong to spread "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" said:

1. Whatever you plant, you will get that reward: if you plant squash, you will get squash, if you plant beans, you will get beans. The laws of cause and effect and retribution cannot be changed even by Buddhas and Tathagatas.

2. The retribution of cause and effect is not that if you plant one, you will get one, if you plant ten, you will get ten, but like a farmer who cultivates, in the spring sowing a tube of seed, in the fall he will harvest a hundred tubes of rice.

3. For the retribution of cause and effect to be mature, it must also borrow the support of cause and effect. Just like seeds, they must rely on supporting conditions

such as sunlight, rain, wind, soil, season... after being ripe, they can germinate, bloom, and bear fruit.

4. The practice of following the evil does not change, just like ripe rice, the collected seeds are replanted to become new rice. Thus, there is a related cycle and karmic fate, from those crimes arise future sufferings, which will definitely be four thousand times more serious than the consequences of one tube of seed sown producing one hundred tubes of rice. When these newspaper articles arise, it is no longer a normal number that can be calculated.

5. Although Dam Tri knows: currently, what is known about the tortures in hell is not much, just enough for those above to know and be cautious in thinking and acting. In fact, with as many crimes as there are in the world, there are correspondingly as many evil retributions in hell. Whether the retribution is quick or slow depends on whether the conditions are ripe or not. The types of evil retributions in hell are entirely based on a person's evil thoughts and evil actions while alive, increasing or decreasing, to repay the number of crimes he has committed.

6. Good and evil in the world are formed at the same time as corresponding blessings and disasters, they always circulate and correspond to each other. Those who do good deeds will be blessed, but after receiving blessings, they will cause new sins, and having new sins will cause more misfortunes. Thus, blessings and disasters, good and evil, change continuously and will never end. Therefore, if you do not find a way to escape the cycle of birth and death, you will forever be reincarnated like that. I hope to advise men and women in the world to be enlightened, develop Bodhi mind, maintain faith, and follow the correct path of Buddhism. Try to popularize and convey the morality of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". Then, take a step forward to pursue Buddha Dharma, benefiting yourself and all sentient beings, so that hell will become empty.

Thus, that person will definitely attain unsurpassed enlightenment. The Great Wind Emperor and the Ten Halls of Hell, the Gods who heard the teachings of the Bodhisattva all clasped their hands and said: "Definitely become Buddha!".

The Bodhisattva spoke again and said: "In this world, if there are good men and good women who, after seeing and hearing the "Jewel Lich Buu Phieu", can live, sit, and sleep between places, regularly control their own delusions and develop Bodhi mind, encourage sentient beings with predestined relationships with them, so that everyone knows how to repent, study the Buddha Dharma, have an equal heart, and help all sentient beings, that person will definitely achieve all kinds of achievements. wisdom.”

At this time, the crowd clasped their hands and said: “Definitely become a Buddha!”.

tieu_de: 2.5 Final words of advice
noi_dung:
2.5 Final instructions

After Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva's complete revelation, he returned to his original form with a compassionate face, sprinkled three times with nectar water, and the clouds ascended to heaven. King of Hell also said goodbye and returned to his own prefecture, the Great Emperor retired.

The mandarin put the golden words of the Bodhisattva as above and the answers of the Gods into this book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", and at the same time asked Dam Tri Taoist - who was standing next to the mandarin's table - to write it down himself. The judge checked it once and then handed it over to the Taoist Dam Tri, who took it with him and will pass it on to the earthly world to benefit sentient beings.

When leaving, the Judge said: "A number of Gods and ghosts are holding positions under the Hell Palace, many of whom have recently died in this era, and there are quite a few that you also know. When you return to earth this time, you must not reveal our real names. For fear that the men and women on earth will know there are any. Ancestors and relatives are currently working as Gods and holding positions under Diem Palace. Every time they get sick or encounter an accident, they should repent

repent, do good deeds to make up for bad karma. Not only did they not do so, but on the contrary, they also killed living beings, worshiped, and rioted to burn the toon (offering paper) to pray for blessings. The halls under Diem Phu will increase many useless misfortunes and be plotted against. Besides, following the instructions of the Jade Emperor, erasing the records of the Great Emperor's palace and the gods, let alone the names of our Judges? That's why people's hearts are hard to predict these days. If our name is taken advantage of to deceive us, it will cause chaos. Thus, it will be difficult for you and us to escape God's punishment. Thousands of warnings must not be neglected."

tieu_de: 2.6 Later records of Pho Dao Nhan
noi_dung:
2.6 The Aftermath of the Fu Daoist

Dam Tri's disciple, Pho Me Taoist (in ancient times, people did not distinguish between religions and were all called Taoists), while preparing to print "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", recorded a part of Dam Tri's saying and his thoughts. He said: "I was in the year of the Dog in the summer of June, when I traveled to Sichuan, on the outskirts of Song Luu district, I met my master, the Taoist Dam Tri. My master instructed: "I have personally entered the six paths of reincarnation, from life to death, people who have returned from the underworld, you can inform the world that, in the world, the old and young, the disabled, the seriously ill, women, these people have committed crimes. can atone for sins as prescribed by law. There were times when the Emperor granted him a special pardon, which could reduce or eliminate torture. Even just a few contacts or meeting a benevolent judge can erase some crimes, waive them or escape part of the punishment. Events like this, from ancient times to present, are many, but in hell, all sins are not overlooked; At the same time, there is no possibility of amnesty or remission. Only through one's own remorse and doing good deeds can one's sins be eliminated and atonement."

Unfortunately, people in the world have an inaccurate view of this matter, leading to this or that person starting to destroy evil thoughts, forming reincarnation between humans and animals, sinners will forever wander in the animal path.

In the past, among those who had committed crimes, out of 100 women, there were one or two people who came to their senses and repented; Among 1,000 men, there is not one who knows how to wake up and repent. What's even more pitiful is that there are people who are about to die and still refuse to repent, willingly waiting for Diem Phu's punishment. Fortunately, now, thanks to Bodhisattva's compassion, the Jade Emperor granted grace and allowed the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to be published to atone for his crimes. It can be said that this is the underworld opening the door of compassion. I now warn people on earth to know that reincarnating into a human body is very difficult. While you are still alive, you can repent and turn towards goodness. This is something that really needs to be done and must be tried. Because you have the mind to warn people to do good deeds, now I will teach "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to you. You must quickly spread this book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to the world."

After listening to my master's teachings, I knelt down to receive this book. Not long after, my master became enlightened and left. I rely on the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to constantly copy it, constantly giving it to others, to warn humanity to repent of their karma, to work together towards goodness.

Every time the holidays of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva come, I will swear to repent of mistakes, practice goodness and will print this book and spread it to expand and encourage people in the world.

Only need to encourage one person to practice.

Only need to encourage one person to practice. If you practice good deeds, your sins will be reduced, and you will have great merit.

I hope that after watching and listening, men and women in the world who have done unvirtuous and unconscionable things must immediately rectify themselves; If you don't have it, don't increase your pity. Don't wait until you're in hell to repent, it's too late. If you want to beg for a new human body, it's impossible.

On the full moon day of the seventh month, which is the Buddha's joy, the Fu Daoist respectfully recorded the above content.

In the summer of June in the year of the Dog, Pho Meo Taoist gave "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to Dong Vuc to prepare and print. On the Mid-Year Festival of the Year of the Dog, when he came to Tam Truc to burn incense, Pho Meo Nhan gave this book along with the holy days of the saints, and gave it to Vo Lam to print and circulate.

He hoped that good men and women would happily donate money to print and expand its dissemination regardless of whether it was necessary to help print ten thousand books, thousands of books, hundreds of books, dozens of books or a few books, and then spread it everywhere, awakening humanity. Knowing how to repent and change is truly immeasurable merit.
