tieu_de: CHAPTER 3: CONTENTS OF THE BUU PHIEU JEWELRY INTRODUCTION TO THE PUNISHMENT OF THE TEN King Yama PENALTY
noi_dung: CHAPTER 3: CONTENTS OF THE PUNISHMENT OF THE PUNISHMENT OF THE TEN DIEN KINGS

tieu_de: 3.1 First Palace: Qin Quang Vuong
noi_dung:
3.1 First palace: Qin Quang Vuong

The function of Qin Quang Vuong is to specialize in governing longevity and premature death in the people, the civil status lists of birth and death dates; unified management of demons and auspicious judgments. The main hall (the working place) is located under the sea, on a reef, with a dark path in the golden stream on the west side.

All good people, after completing their lives, will have the fate of being led to heaven, some will be led to the Western world of bliss.

If they are male or female with merits and sins, each equal, after death they will be delivered to the tenth palace, still allowing them to be reincarnated on earth. Some men transform into women, some women transform into men depending on the actions they did while alive on earth. Due to causes and conditions, there are different distinctions in receiving retribution on earth.

All those who, while living on earth, did many evil deeds and few good deeds will be led to a high platform on the left, in the palace, that platform is called Kinh Nghiep platform. The platform is one meter high, has a mirror as large as ten people turning around and hugging, the mirror hangs on the east side. On the glass was written a horizontal line of seven words: "In front of karma, there are no good people."

The demons were escorted to the stage, looked into the glass, naturally as if watching the movie of their lives, recording the cruel and dangerous scenes and all the bad things they had done while living

on earth and after dying, they had to suffer tragedies in hell. Only at this time did I realize: ten thousand taels of gold bars, all kinds of money, jewels, and all the benefits, fame, and enjoyment could not be brought down here, only one's own karma would follow to hell.

After finishing the mirror examination, he was escorted to the second palace, and began to separate the prisoners to the hells; Use torture tools to make those who do evil things suffer all kinds of painful punishments. The detailed penalty and conviction are as follows:

(1): CRIME OF SUICIDES

If there are people on earth who don't think about heaven and earth giving birth to humans and the nurturing grace of parents but having a body is so precious, as important as a mountain; kindness to parents; Those who have not repaid their kindness to sentient beings, the king, the Three Jewels, and other types of kindness, and have not received the call in the underworld, voluntarily commit suicide, using methods such as hanging, jumping from buildings, drinking poison, jumping into the river... to commit suicide. Except for those who sacrifice their lives because of filial piety and righteousness, and after death can become Gods, if just because of a small resentment or doing bad things they commit a crime and are discovered and commit suicide, then their crimes are considered to have been committed and do not result in a death sentence; or those who want to harm and cause harm to others, leading to their death from the fake to the real. In situations like the above, Than Mon and Than Tao Quan will escort them to the main palace and put them in prison for starvation.

These suicidal ghosts, every time the day of the Dog or Pig comes, completely suffer like when they died, all the painful scenes, based on the original death, reappear again. For some, after 70 days, for some after one to two years, their souls were escorted back to the place where they committed suicide, suffering very miserable torture and remorse. However, they are not allowed to receive offerings such as rice, soup, paper money, and gold and silver. If the ghosts who commit suicide repent, are willing to hide, do not appear as ghosts to scare people, and do not look for people to substitute for them. Thus, waiting for the time when the person they caused has been implicated and freed from involvement and suffering, Than Mon and Than Tao Quan will escort the ghost criminals to the first palace, then transfer them to the second palace, then check their past and merits, increase the punishment, move to the next palace, and send them to hell to be punished.

If the ghost has appeared, the ghost has appeared to scare people and has the intention of finding a substitute or using strange words. words that threaten or deceive people, even though they have not resulted in the death of a person, even if they have previously done good deeds, hell still does not allow them to be exempted or reduced from their punishments.

If, after committing suicide, you die and, without hiding it, appear as a ghost, scaring people to death, then that ghost will immediately be taken away by demon soldiers with green-faced fangs and go to hell to suffer a painful punishment. After 100 days, sent to Avici great hell, forever chained and hung up, unable to escape.

(2): CRIMINAL WHEN RECOMMENDING SUTRAS WITH OMISSION OF WORDS

All monastic monks, Taoists, receiving money from others, worshiping and reciting sutras on their behalf, missing words, or page numbers will be taken to the main temple and taken to the temple. They went to "So Bu Kinh" - the room to preserve prayer books, in a dark room. Apart from the missing words they recited, they were all copied clearly and recited clearly.

This place has an oil lamp burning, storing ten kilos of oil. You can only use a small heart to burn, when it's light or dark, it can't be done in one breath to make up for it quickly.

(3): CRIMINAL PRACTICES CORRUPTION OF WORSHIPERS WORSHIP

If a person becomes a pure monk or a Taoist monk, gets greedy, tries to beg for money to worship and enjoy, he must also come to this place to make up for the sutras.

(4): BENEFITS OF PEOPLE WHO PRACTICE AND EXPAND Buddhist Dharma

Some good men and women cultivate their minds at home, very sincerely, their thoughts and speech are like one ground, reciting all sutras, mantras, holy names, even if there are errors and omissions, but focus on sincerity and not on words. For those who sincerely cultivate this mind, the Buddha will give instructions, without needing to make up sutras, on the first day of each month, their merits will be recorded in the book of good deeds.

People in the world, if on the first day of the second month of each year, practice a pure vegetarian diet, face the North, and sincerely make a vow: do not do evil, do good and accumulate virtue, due to this concept of good will, you will be exempted from entering hell; At the same time, we spread good books, helping many people to repent and turn to good things. If you try to recite the name "Namo Amitābha Buddha", make a big vow, pray that in this life you will be able to reach the Western world of ultimate bliss, and will practice good deeds to recite the Buddha's name and return to the pure land. Thus, after the end of life, this person will die, immediately order the green-clothed pupil to be taken to the Western world of ultimate bliss, or immediately be accepted by Buddha and Bodhisattva to the place of ultimate bliss.

tieu_de: 3.2 Second Palace: So Giang Vuong
noi_dung:
3.2 The second palace: So Giang Vuong

So Giang Vuong presides over the bottom of the sea, under the rocks to the south of a great hell. This hell is eight thousand meters across. Below are built sixteen small hells:

1. Small hell Hac Van Sa.

2. Small hell of soil, feces and urine.

3. Five-pronged little hell.

4. Little Hell is hungry.

5 . Little Hell is hungry and thirsty.

6 . Small bloody hell.

7. Small bronze hammer hell.

8 . Small Hell has many bronze hammers.

9 . Small hell because of iron (grinding and cutting).

10. Small hell Bin (ancient country name).

11. Little chicken hell.

12. Little hell of dark lake.

13. Little Hell hammers, picks, and shovels.

14. Little Hell's sword stabs.

15. Little wolf hell.

16. Small cold hells.

If on earth you commit the following crimes, you will be imprisoned in these hells:

1. Deceiving young men and women.

2. Defrauding other people's property.

3. Destroying and injuring other people's eyes, ears, limbs.

4. For the sake of privacy, it is unethical to recommend ineffective doctors and medicines.

5 . The servant, having reached adulthood, did not allow his family members to redeem him, making it impossible for them to restore their freedom.

6. While discussing marriage between two families, for the sake of the other person's money and status, he intentionally hid his true age to deceive the marriage.

7. Before the two families are married, it has been determined that the male or female partner already has an illness, serious illness, or adultery, theft, or low reputation. Because they want to enjoy the brokerage money, they put aside their conscience, hide it, do not tell the truth, and affect the happiness of the other person.

In the above criminal events, survey to see how many crimes have been committed, how long they have been committed, whether they have caused disasters or because the things they have caused have led to serious consequences. important. If there were, they would command cruel and ferocious demons and send them to hell to suffer a painful punishment. In addition, depending on whether the crime is big or small, they are sent to Hell to be executed. Once the above punishments are completed, they will be communicated to the third palace to increase the punishment and sent to the hell of this palace to suffer.

All good men and women in the world, if they have the following good deeds:

1. Often preach the content of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to others to let them know how to be alert.

2. Or give the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to print and give away to expand circulation.

3. Seeing someone sick, help them find a doctor for treatment, or give them good medicine, hoping they will be healed soon.

4. When meeting poor and difficult people, cook rice and porridge, buy food, buy food to provide for them or give alms money, to help many people.

Those who have done good deeds as above, if at the same time they know how to repent of their past mistakes, will be specially given credit to atone for their sins. At the transfer,

will be brought to the tenth palace, these people will be brought to the path of noble people to be reincarnated.

If you know how to pity living beings, do not have the heart to kill animal creatures; instruct and advise children not to kill small animals such as insects; On the first day of the third month make a vow to abstain from killing and release animals. If you perform the above three types of good deeds, after death, you do not need to go to all the hells, you will immediately be transferred to the tenth palace, leading to a blessed place of reincarnation.

tieu_de: 3.3 Third Palace: Song Emperor
noi_dung:
3.3 Third Palace: Song Emperor

Song Emperor is the ruler of the ocean floor, dominating the great underworld under the rock in the east. There is a hell about eight thousand meters wide, and there are also sixteen small hells set up:

1. Small hell with salt bait.

2. Small hell with chains.

3. Small Hell piercing ribs.

4. Little Hell slaps his face in unison.

5. Little Hell slaps his finger.

6. Little hell with heart and liver clamp.

7. Little Hell gouges out his eyes.

8. Little Hell sheds its skin.

9. Little Hell chopped off his feet.

10. Little Hell pulls out fingernails and toes.

11. Blood-sucking little hell.

12. Little hell hangs upside down.

13. Small hell separates bones.

14. Little hell maggot bites.

15. Little hell disjointed.

16. Heart-piercing minor hell.

If you commit the following crimes while on earth, you will be sent to this hell:

1. Not recognizing the virtue of being the leader of the Kingdom, the ruler, and the lives of people, most importantly: those who are officials with positions and salaries of the country, not loyal to the authorities; or have a traitorous mind and refuse to pity the lives of subordinates (subordinates).

2. Those who perform public duties, when they see benefits, forget morality and responsibility, lacking patriotism and love for the people.

3. The fate of being a husband is not being virtuous, the fate of being a wife is not being kind in words and actions.

4. As an adopted child, he received the long-term nurturing and nurturing grace of his adoptive parents, but when he received property, he forgot his gratitude and returned to the arms of his biological parents.

5. People who hire, work, or accept entrusted work but do not fulfill their obligations and act against it.

6. Employees and military officers, betraying their supervisor or supervisor.

7. Working for the owner but with colleagues ripping off the owner's finances.

8. Commit a crime to prison and escape from prison; when escorting soldiers signed bail for criminals being escorted to another place, in the middle of their escape; leading to consequences for the officers and their relatives, over a long period of time, without repenting to their bosses, and without compensating for losses. Even if you do many good deeds in the future, you still have to be sent to hell and suffer punishments in hell.

9. Because of attaching importance to feng shui and the year of the year, it prevents the bereaved family from holding funerals and burials for deceased relatives, preventing the dead from entering the earth peacefully.

10. When digging holes or building graves, when you see coffins and remains in the ground, do not immediately stop, complete the treatment, or change to another grave, causing damage to their remains.

11. When helping others work, you steal other people's money and food.

12. Ancestors' graves are not worshiped and cleaned, causing them to go missing for a long time.

13. Seducing others to break the law, causing more scandal, causing chaos, deceiving people, filing lawsuits and disrupting their peace.

14. Covering up identity documents to slander others.

15. Recording announcements, writing nonsense, destroying other people's reputation.

16. Fake evidence of annulment to help them divorce.

17. Making fake transaction contracts or documents to defraud other people's assets, debts, and belongings.

18. Forging signatures and making fake stamps, fake documents to increase or decrease, alter books, causing damage to others.

People who commit the above crimes, when investigated for serious or minor crimes, first give the devil the power to push them into the great hell to suffer and then, based on the related crimes, put them into the small hells to suffer. When the time limit has expired, the person communicates with the fourth temple, increases the punishment, and goes to hell to pay for the crime.

People in the world, if possible, make a vow on the eighth day of the second month, never to do it again. After death, it allows them to be transferred to another place of blessing, without having to go to hell to suffer their sins.

tieu_de: 3.4 Fourth Palace: Ngu Quan Vuong
noi_dung:
3.4 The fourth palace: Ngu Quan Vuong

The Ngu Quan Vuong governs the underworld under the sea, under the rock to the east, where the Great Hell is located. This hell is about eight centimeters wide, and also has sixteen small hells:

1. Small hell waterfall (very strong water flowing from the rock crevice)

2. Small hell meditation (prolonged kneeling and worship).

3. Little Hell is hot and burning.

4. Little Hell slaps his face and his face swells.

5. Little hell breaks tendons and breaks bones.

6. Tiny hell with thin skin.

7. Little hell fried skin.

8. Small stinging hell.

9. Iron shirt little hell.

10. The small hell is crushed by wood, stone, earth and tile.

11. Little Hell pokes its eyes.

12. Small dusty hell.

13. Little hell filled with bitter medicine.

14. Little hell got slippery with oil.

15. Little hell stabbed its mouth.

16. Small hell with crushed stones crushing the body.

If you commit the following crimes while on earth, you will be sent to:

1. Tax evasion without paying.

2. Intentionally not paying rent.

3. Selling underweight goods to deceive people.

4. Making fake drugs to sell as real drugs, causing more illness in people.

5. Rice that is damp, moldy or degenerated, still sold to people as good rice 6. When buying goods, use fake money, or leftover money that does not rot.

7. Selling some illegal goods to seduce buyers such as perfume, powder, silk, etc...

8. When walking or walking, you see elderly or disabled people, pregnant women, do not give way.

9. Appropriating some profits from uneducated people in the countryside, or the elderly, children and low-income street traders.

10. Undertaking to send letters to others without quickly delivering them to the other person, causing work delays.

11. Stealing bricks or street lights, creating traffic hazards.

12. Poor people are not content to follow the right path but have unexpected greedy intentions.

13. The rich mercilessly help the lonely elderly, and do not aid the poor.

14. If someone comes to ask to borrow money, at first they agree to lend money but at that moment they refuse, hindering their great work.

15. When you see someone sick, there is medicine in the house, but you don't give it to them.

16. There is a good remedy to treat the disease effectively but hide it and do not pass it on to others.

17. Decoctions or garbage, broken machinery, left lying around on the street or walkway, affecting vehicles and pedestrians.

18. Unnecessarily raising donkeys, horses and other animals, allowing waste to affect the environment and pedestrians.

19. There is land that is not cultivated and is not rented to others, leaving the land abandoned.

20. Destroying other people's fences.

21. Using magic and incantations to motivate demons to harass people.

22. Making up horror stories to scare people.

People who commit the above crimes: examined for serious or light crimes, first sent to demon soldiers to push them into the great hells to suffer, and then, based on the crimes involved, sent them to the small hells to suffer

the crimes. When the time limit has passed, contact the fifth office to check and examine their past merits.

If people in the world can, on the eighteenth day of the second month of each year, make a vow to repent and not commit the same crime again, they can be exempted from entering the halls of hell to suffer punishment. Suppose we copy and print "Ngoc Lich Bieu Phieu" or continue to increase the events of cause and effect and retribution, based on the sayings of the palaces, to advise humanity to do good, pass it on to future generations, so that they can read it and repent, and not violate it again, then the merit will silently arise.

tieu_de: 3.5 Fifth Palace: Emperor Yama
noi_dung:
3.5 The fifth palace: Emperor Yama

Emperor Yama said: “Actually, I am the manager of the first palace, out of pity for the sad souls who died unjustly, I will bring them back to earth to clear their name, seek justice, so I was demoted to rule at the bottom of the great sea, in the underground rocks to the east of the great hell calling, and manage 16 small lands. Hell.”

All the demonic criminals, when brought to this temple, have undergone punishment in hell for quite a long time. Before going through the above four palaces, each person must be escorted to the main palace according to the seven-day time limit. These people, in this palace, did not find out any crimes. Their bodies did not decompose after five or seven days.

These evil criminals say: "On earth there is still unfinished good fate." Some say, repairing and building monasteries, bridges, and streets; widen canals and dig wells; or compile books advising on good deeds and good deeds, etc. that have not been completed; or the number of animals released is not complete; or have not completed the proper burial arrangements for the parents; or there is a favor that has not been repaid. Because of things like the above, they begged for them to return to earth. Therefore, he made a vow and will definitely be a good person.

After hearing this, Emperor Yama said: "When you were still on earth, you did many evil things, the ghosts and gods understood very clearly. Right now, like a boat approaching the middle of the river, it is discovered that it is leaking, and if you want to fix it, it will be too late. Showing that, in the underworld, if there were no wronged ghosts, there would be fewer people who hold grudges in the world. It is very difficult for people on earth to want to cultivate their hearts. virtue.”

When the demons come to the temple, after looking through the mirror of their karma, they naturally know that they are evil. No need to say much, I will be escorted to a high level by the head of a buffalo and the face of a horse to look back at my homeland!

The reason why the high steps were built was called Vong Huong Dai. The ground of Vong Huong Dai has a semi-circular shape, projecting to three directions: East, West, and South. This high platform has a curved surface of 81 mm, the back of the high platform is as flat as a shooting bow. In the North direction, use swords to build a wall with a 49-foot high platform. Use a knife to slope the mountain, making 63 steps. Honest people do not need to go to this high platform; The person who has half the merit has given it away to reincarnation.

Only people who have done a lot of evil things will let them go on this station to see their homeland as if it were right in front of their eyes, everyone in the family, the sayings and actions of their loved ones, can see and hear. Seeing that everyone, young and old, did not comply with his instructions before dying, all his decisions were completely changed, all his assets, which he had saved with great difficulty, were all cleared away; husbands marry concubines, wives marry other husbands; Land and assets were all divided; The books that were once handled seriously are now embezzled and have no money left; Debts to the dead and the living are difficult to overcome; The living owe me, due to the loss of all evidence, there is nothing left to pursue; All mistakes and crimes are blamed on the dead;

Father, mother, wife, all relatives in the nation commented and blamed me; Everyone's children are selfish; loss of trust in friends; There are some close relatives who remember their love and respect when they were alive, still crying for a few hours, turning around and laughing mockingly. When he was alive, he did evil deeds, and gradually evil retribution appeared; A son who commits a crime will be sent to prison, or will be corrupted by bad friends; Daughters become sick or are raped; Careers will collapse, houses will be pawned or sold, assets large and small will all be destroyed.

Actually, doing evil will be rewarded with evil, it's not just about sad souls? There are some people on earth who also suffer from their own evil.

All the evil criminals, after watching the above scenes, were escorted into the great hell. The gods and demons judge what crimes they have committed before scattering them to small hells to suffer painful punishments. In the small hell, there are dangerous traps in places; Use copper snakes as chains; iron dogs to make piles of dirt. Put them in, tie them up, press down their arms and legs, use a small knife, cut open their stomachs, take out their hearts, cut them into pieces, the hearts will be fed to the snakes, and the intestines will be fed to the dogs. Thus, after enduring the torture until the end of the period, the pain stops, the body recovers perfectly, and is escorted to the next hall to the hells to suffer the punishment:

1. Little hell cuts out the hearts and minds and doubts cause and effect and does not respect gods and demons.

2. Little hell cuts out its heart because it kills lives.

3. Little hell cuts out its heart because it has not completed a good deed but goes to do evil first.

4. The little hells cut off their hearts because they approached evil, acted wrongly, turned against the righteous principles, and had a selfish mind and greed for profit.

5. Little Hell cuts off his heart because he oppresses good and fears evil, and has an evil heart that wants others to die quickly.

6. Little hell cuts people's hearts out just because they value fame, fortune, and gossip to bring disaster to others.

7. The little hells cut out the hearts of those who rape women, scheme to lose women's virginity, seduce women to satisfy their lust or, regardless of whether they harm people or animals, commit adultery with women.

8. The little hell cuts off those who have the heart to harm others and benefit themselves.

9. Little hell cuts out the hearts of greedy people who refuse to give alms to the poor and help those who are about to die.

10. Little Hell cuts out the hearts of those who steal, rob other people's property, hide their consciences, and refuse to pay debts.

11. Little hell cuts out the hearts of those who forget to be grateful. Repay kindness with resentment.

12. Little hell cuts out the hearts of those who are eager to win and love to gamble, causing harm to others.

13. The little hell cuts out the hearts of those who, for fame and profit, deceive and seduce living beings.

14. Although the little hell that cuts out people's hearts does not personally cause harm to others, it evilly guides others to commit crimes.

15. Little hell cuts out the hearts of the jealous and the honest.

16. Little hell cuts out the hearts of those who do not know how to repent.

If you commit the following crimes while on earth, you will be sent to this hell:

room. There is a passage leading to the East, all the male and female demons are escorted here and brought into the rooms. There are cups in the room to tell them to drink that medicine, whether they drink a lot or a little.

noi_dung:
4.1 Memoirs about "Cau Tu Tap Duong" recorded

4.1.1 Five children who passed valedictorian became famous

In Dai Hung district, there was Mr. Hoang Phuong Chau, who during the Qing Khang Hy dynasty, worked as a mandarin in Hoi Duong district, and his wife often did good deeds and accumulated virtue to do meritorious deeds.

When he was in office, he worked as a mandarin in Hoi Duong district. The mandarin once donated money to print dozens of books such as "The Diamond Sutra", "Thai Thuong Touch Magazine", "Am Dinh Van Quang Nghia" and his wife also happily donated money to print a thousand copies of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to give as alms. Furthermore, regularly buying fish and birds to release, the number is over hundreds of thousands, the couple has five sons: Thuc Lam is Tham Hoa of the Khang Hy period, Thuc Kinh is a doctor, Thuc Ky is a bachelor, Thuc Hoan is also a doctor and Thuc Tuyen is also a baccalaureate professor, all of whom have achieved fame and have very high academic ability.

4.1.2 Children and grandchildren have been promoted

Mr. Liao Quoc Duy was from Jiangsu district, a doctor during the Ming Dynasty, but he stayed at home and did not work as an official. Every day, he often buys good books about cause and effect and always copies them to give to others. For torn books, they are repaired by hand to make them complete. One year, when there was a drought, the grain crop failed, and many families suffered from hunger and thirst. He immediately gave alms and took out the food in his house to help the villagers; Seeing an outbreak of disease in the village, he immediately bought effective medicine to save people, and opened his heart to treat the villagers for free.

Therefore, the whole family continued to show kindness. In the year of Dinh Mui, his son Hue Vien and Thuan Tri passed the exam to become a doctor, and his grandson Lieu Dan passed the exam to become a poinsettia at the end of Dinh Mui year; son of Lieu Dan

Nhut Thao is the label of the year Dinh Mui. Mantra Lieu Dan Lieu Ky's son is Han Lam of the Year of the Ox; Nhut Thao Chi Nhon's son was an academic of the Qianlong period; Don Nghia is a doctor in the last year of Binh Thin. His descendants are all glorious and wealthy, all of which are retributions for his good deeds. At Duy Duong, the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" was circulated, which contained a copy of Lieu Dan's copy.

4.1.3 Consecutively winning the poinsettia, forever rich and noble

Mr. Bang Nhat Am in Truong Chau is a virtuous person, and when the harvest is not good, he will definitely try to help; when seeing books that are useful in guiding people to practice virtue and benefit society; He will definitely print it as a gift. His son, Mr. Bang Dinh Cau, also did good deeds and copied hundreds of books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to pass down. After that, he was elected to the post of poinsettia. Mr. Tu Khai Phong's great-grandson also passed the bachelor's degree exam and became a candidate. Up to now, the descendants are still rich and wealthy.

4.1.4 The third noble son is crowned with glory

Mr. Tu Truc Dinh in Xuan Son was a colleague of Mr. Nghiem Van Tinh. At that time, To Giang and Triet Giang provinces were flooded. The people were suffering from hunger and thirst. He proposed to his superiors to open a reserve warehouse to aid his people, saving many lives. His son's name is Khai Te, he works at Minh Thi temple. Encountering robbers who imprisoned more than a hundred women in the Tu family's house, he asked Mr. Khai Te to keep watch. As a result, he secretly gave money for the women's tolls and released them, and even burned his own house to prevent the robbers from becoming suspicious and from having to run and chase them. When he set the fire, he held the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and led his whole family to escape the robbers and go to Thai Khang district. Throughout his life, he printed many books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu".

4.1.5 Lam Chung ascended to heaven, descendants bean poinsettia

Mr. Thai Boi Lam in Ho Chau is normally very respectful to his parents, charitable to everyone, lives frugally, and loves to give alms to help the poor. Whenever he met poor families with sick people, he would definitely donate medicine; If poor single families came to ask him to lend money, he would not make a profit. On the way, he encountered women and children who lost money and did not dare to go home to meet adults. He tried to make up for them.

One day, he discovered that the content of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" could advise and warn the world's people, so he donated money for the clerk to copy and give to everyone to advise the world's people.

He lived to be eighty-four years old, and he walked in the posture of meditating and reciting Buddha's name. A neighbor saw that he had met a fairy and led him to ascend to heaven.

His great-grandson, named Ton Khai Tuan, was the prime minister of the Kangxi dynasty in the year of Canh Mau.

4.1.6 His descendants joined the family today.

Mr. Tu Van Kinh in Han District, worked as a high-ranking official at the royal court, was familiar with the principles and rites of religious practice, and liked to research about Thich, Dao, Confucianism and the stories of the three teachings of saints and sages. Every day she often collects documents and publishes books such as "Practice with Respect and Faith" to guide people in good deeds.

Lady Thai chants Sutras every day and respectfully recites the name of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva thousands of times, and also likes to discuss cause and effect with everyone. He once translated books such as "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and "Tri Bao Toan Tap" for the Middle East in the hope that people will repent and do good. In years of crop failure and grain loss, he will definitely donate money to help his relatives.

His son named Bong achieved a master's degree. Another son named Ky is a military patrol officer; His grandson named Hao also held the position of mandarin and another grandson named Han also held the position of mandarin. All of his descendants passed the examination to enter the armor department.

4.1.7 Three noble sons passed the doctorate exam

Mr. Truong Man Ky, holds the position of chief mandarin of Ha Nam province. He serves in office with integrity and grace. What he enjoys most is printing books such as "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", "Am Dinh Van Quan Nghia", "Literary Master Lien Tri Abstinence from Killing".

What he hates most are comic books, pornographic materials, gambling objects, abortion, sterilization, and adultery material. Every time it was discovered that someone had invented or published these objects, he increased the punishment; For those who capture the above subjects, he will reward them handsomely.

When any family suffers from famine or thirst, no matter how far they have to go or to different villages, he will always come to the place to provide relief. When his wife heard of a place needing to print or copy Sutra books and books advising good deeds, even if she had to sell her things and jewelry, she was determined to donate.

The couple had five sons, the eldest son named Hoc Duong was a doctor of the Ky Suu department, the second son named Ung Tao was a doctor of the Ky Mui department, the third son named Thieu Hien was also a doctor of the Ky Suu department; The fourth son, Xi Linh, is a bachelor of Tuat Ty faculty; The fifth son, named On Chanh, is a baccalaureate in the Quy Mau department.

4.1.8 Printing good books as gifts for wealthy children and grandchildren

Mr. Tuong Xuan Pho in Truong Thuc, although his family was rich, lived a very modest and simple life, a very ordinary person.

When he saw books or literature promoting charity, he

would definitely ask his children and grandchildren to copy or print them, never sparing money, truly a man of noble virtue. His descendants also followed the merits of their ancestors, and never refused to do good deeds. Such as printing books such as "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", "Thai Thuong Touch" and books on abstinence from killing, propagating and giving respect, the number is countless.

The grandson's name is Phuc; have a reputation; Great-grandson named Y, passed the doctoral exam during the Kangxi period in the year of Quy Suu, great-grandson Tran Tiet, passed the doctoral exam in the year of Giap Suu; Dinh Tiet, in the year of the Goat, also passed the doctoral degree exam; Due to his belief and printing good books as gifts, his descendants all passed the doctoral exam, became rich and prosperous.

4.1.9 Donated medicine to save people, had the honor of being appointed to the position Thanh Vuong

In the middle of Gia Thien year, Mr. Hong Thieu Dinh at Nam Xuong Phu Tay Giang, when he was young, studied medicine in internal surgery. At the age of nineteen, he read the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", and when he read in the second palace, there was a content that said "only lower the status quo" (i.e., examining the patient was only superficial and not thorough), taking medicine to treat the disease to gain benefits, and was transferred to a small hell to continue suffering. Believed and admired, he donated medicine to treat many people's illnesses and copied the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to tell people in the world to understand, hoping that everyone will be alert and know how to repent. While developing great trust, treating illness does not count money, does not discriminate between rich and poor. When he met someone who was critically ill and had to use ginseng, if that patient was poor and could not afford to buy it, he would cut the ginseng into small pieces, mix it with other medicines, and sell it cheaply to them to treat their illness. Take advantage of the bonuses earned by the rich and provide relief to seriously ill people who are difficult to cure. If you encounter a year of poor harvest and hunger, you will not sit in a palanquin but walk to examine the people. His wife is very talented and always complies with her wishes

The husband's kindness. In winter, even if you wear clothes made of rough fabric, you won't regret it. On the day of celebrating his eightieth birthday, he suddenly saw a red banner hanging from the high ceiling of the living room, with yellow letters on it: "Feng Thien De Mang", Hong Thieu Dinh came to Thanh Hoang of Fujian province to perform his duties. Three days later, in the temple, he changed his clothes and bathed, and he passed away in a sitting state.

All of his descendants in his career were very successful and famous.

4.1.10 Lighting a rescue lamp, I entered the middle of the road

Mr. Tran Tien Sinh was a nobleman of Hai Ninh district. In the evening, he often lit oil lamps and hung them on the streets, making it convenient for late-night travelers. At the same time, we give alms and medicine to people with difficult-to-treat illnesses, and build cemeteries and graves for those who die without relatives to bury them, to avoid bodies being left in the wilderness. He also regularly spreads the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and other books to promote charity.

God's reward for Mr. Tran's family is also very great: His descendants are wealthy, there are many who hold the positions of doctorates and masters in the middle class. Up to now, it has a very good reputation in Triet Giang province.

4.1.11 Four great families, virtuous Khanh family

In Zhejiang in Hangzhou, famous for its wealth and prosperity, during the Qing Dynasty, there were four great families: Quan, Vong, Ton, Trieu. Their families all belonged to people who specialized in taking advantage of all things and benefits, helping people in distress, not complaining, not depressed.

Speaking specifically about the Quan family, like Quan Quy's grandfather, when he was promoted. As a mandarin, he still continued to write and add notes to the charity book "Dan Que Tap".

The Vong family gave alms, donated "Tu Ha Dan" and always gave alms of medicine to the poor. For several generations, it has not stopped.

The Ton family often gives away the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to awaken awareness to the world.

The Trieu family respectfully follows the instructions in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". Printing and giving away the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and giving alms to coffins to help poor people who have no money for burial when they die. In the winter, they also give warm clothes to people with colds.

The four great families above always consider helping people to be an extraordinary thing. Therefore, not only is the family now rich and wealthy and many descendants are also wealthy, have accumulated good deeds, and are blessed by heaven, the above events are a real proof. I am very sincere and sincerely write down what I see and hear, so that people can trust me to do more good deeds.

4.1.12 Dedicated to printing good books and getting promoted

Mr. Tien Duong Du once said: This book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" is a book about the cause and effect of the world. My grandfather, Mr. Van Kinh, used to print this book as a gift to extend his kindness, and God received many blessings in return. Last fall, there was a classmate named Ha Huu Kieu. In his dream, he received an initiative and had to print hundreds of books as gifts for others. He also gave me a book. When I read this book, I felt very emotional and wanted to print it and give it away to expand my merit but did not have enough capital to practice. In the spring of this year, he was fortunate to be unexpectedly promoted and received congratulatory money from close people. He used that money to print five hundred books to satisfy his desire.

tieu_de: 4.2 Memoir of the three good deeds of “Kha Nhuan Duong”
noi_dung:
4.2 Memoir of the three good deeds of “Kha Nhuan Duong”

4.2.1 Printing “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu” passed the exam consecutively

My compatriot, Mr. Tran Trong Truong, has long admired the good deeds in the book “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu”. But thinking that

near these areas, it is impossible to buy this book, I regret it very much.

One day, he went to an ancient temple in Suzhou city to burn incense, and was very lucky to be given a book as a gift. After reading it, he was so surprised that his hair stood up. Therefore, he told a monk he knew: "There has never been such a good book in the world. Not only will people with wisdom read it, but they will be enlightened after reading it, but some popular people will still clearly understand the principles inside, and will also be careful about their actions. And repent for what they have done wrong." Sincerely hope that everyone on earth will gather with the good path.

Three years after printing, his son Buu Kiem, participating in the exam in the province and district, passed the bachelor's exam in the year Giap Tuat. Participating in the exam, he also passed first place, bringing honor to the whole village. That is God's blessing on good people, it can be said to be very big, very fast and very clear.

4.2.2 Selling treasures to rescue the Minister of Justice

Mr. Ung Dai Hien in Triet Giang Taizhou, when he was still studying books in a mountain village, one day, while lighting an oil lamp to copy the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", suddenly heard a group of demons talking and said: "Over there, There was a woman, because her husband hadn't come home for a long time, her husband's parents forced her to marry someone else. But this woman lived a very chaste life and was not satisfied. Tomorrow if she was forced too much, she would hang herself. We will find a replacement."

The next day, Mr. Ung Dai Hien went to find out and it was true as I heard yesterday. He returned to his reading room and secretly took the instrument and antiques his grandfather left for him to sell.

four taels of money. Using her husband's identity, she wrote a letter to comfort the other woman and her parents, who had just sent that money to their family. When their parents received letters and money, believed that their son was safe, and stopped forcing the woman to marry another man, she naturally would no longer want to hang herself. Not long after, her husband returned to reunite with his real family. Comparing with each other about the above story, they did not know who had done such a good deed.

Not long after, he heard the ghosts say to each other: "As usual, we can find someone to replace us, but because this baccalaureate sabotaged his good deed, a ghost stood next to him and said: "Why not cause trouble for him to take revenge?"

This ghost said again: "He often copies "Ngoc Lich Buu". Phieu" to advise the world, and also have compassion to help people, God ordered him to be Minister Am Duc, can we still cause trouble for him? " Later, Mr. Ung Dai Hien was actually promoted to become Minister.

4.2.3 Abstain from eating beef, civet was promoted to military officer

Mr. Chau Thuan Phu came to Lu Chau, was highly educated but unsuccessful in his career, often failed to pass exams, and accidentally passed the age of forty.

One day, by chance, he discovered the tragedy of dissecting cattle and buffaloes and read the content in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" about the memoirs in the sixth palace. Among them, there was something related to abstaining from eating beef and civet meat, so the whole family swore to not eat beef or civet meat anymore and to copy and spread the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" for people to be aware of.

In the same year, he enrolled in exam preparation school, and not long after taking the exam, he passed the exam. Up to now, the descendants are rich and wealthy.

In the book, there is a note: the three stories mentioned above are all true, seen with our own eyes and heard, not fabricated stories. From there, it shows that the wealth and glory of human life also affects the good deeds that come from it, because we have silently created a breed of blessings, especially proposed and advised the world to sincerely follow the rules in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu".

tieu_de: 4.3 Chronicles of the salvation of the mother and the experience of the wife
noi_dung:
4.3 Memoirs of saving his mother and his wife's experience

Doan Duc So ​​is the son of Mr. Doan Canh An in Tay Duong Chau, Sichuan province. Orphaned his father at the age of 7 but his family was wealthy. His mother, whose last name was Thieu, saw that he was weak and often sick, and was very worried. One day, I saw a cooking instruction book; Using chicken stew soup can replenish vital energy. From now on, every meal he would slaughter one or two chickens and stew them into soup for him to eat. Furthermore, he raised a lot of chicks, dug up insects every day to feed the chicks, waited for the chicks to grow up and then slaughtered them.

When Mr. Doan Duc So was fifteen years old, his mother suddenly fell ill with a skin disease, her whole body felt like it had been eaten by worms, the chickens pecked into one spot, the treatment was ineffective, the pain was so painful that she could not sit up, but because she did not understand the principle of cause and effect, she still sent someone to slaughter chickens.

Duc So read a lot of books and saw her mother Lam Lam. Using many methods to treat the disease still does not cure the disease, understanding that this is the retribution of karma. Immediately strictly forbade people from slaughtering chickens and took her mother to her childhood home, where she saw a pile of garbage like a small mountain of chicken bones and feathers. But the mother did not believe it.

The mother was ill for a long time but still did not improve, suffered for seven years and then tragically died. While dying, his throat made sounds like a rooster crowing and a worm screaming, and he used his hands to scratch his own skin, in pain until he died.

Mr. Doan Duc So saw this tragic scene and thought in tears: "For the sake of nourishing my body, I killed so many living beings.

My mother had to suffer such a tragic death penalty. I am truly an ungrateful son, I decided to abstain from killing for merit. To atone for his unfilial sins, he swore not to kill anymore."

One year later, a girl named Linh was married to the Tien family, but died of hemorrhage during childbirth. After death, her soul was summoned to the first palace. The King of Hell looked at Ms. Linh's records in the notebook and decided that her life was indeed committed to death due to difficult birth. After that, the demon soldiers prepared to escort her to the second palace to face the crime.

At this time, an official, after reviewing the file, proposed and said: "After re-checking, this Ms. Doan advised her husband's parents three times not to burn the insects in the withered trees and advised her husband to take the opportunity to print the book "Abstinence from Killing, Wonderful Flower Sutra" of five thousand copies, and donate money to support the printing of the book "Fish Basket of Quan Yin Releasing Life Sutra" of three thousand copies, their family's Mr. Cao Quan reported to heaven. The family agreed to extend her life by thirty-five years."

After hearing this, the King of Hell joined hands and said: "Okay" and immediately ordered the blue-shirted demon soldiers to bring her back to life.

Just stepped out of the main hall, went to the red door, heard a pitiful cry: "Miss Linh" help me!

When Ms. Linh calmed down and looked back, she saw a woman with unkempt hair and bloody flesh calling for her, Looking closely, I realized that it was Mrs. Thieu, Doan Duc So's mother, crying and saying: I was punished in the underworld very painfully. When I return to life, I must tell my son Duc So that he has done many good deeds to alleviate my crime, I will see him in my dreams to prove it. Having finished speaking, a person with red hair and a sharp knife in his hand stabbed her in the throat and pulled her away.

Miss Linh panicked, her soul returned to her body, suddenly awakened, and immediately told Doan Duc So ​​what she saw in the underworld.

Mr. Duc So ​​immediately prayed for her mother's soul and sincerely prayed to Buddha. Every first and fifteenth full moon, he lit incense and prayed to the Three Jewels Buddha to help his mother escape the suffering. But for the past nineteen years, she has not been able to see her mother in her dreams.

Mr. Duc So's wife's family name is Thi, her family's ancestors are very fond of abstaining from killing, or printing Sutra books. One day, Duc So ​​came to their house as a guest, and suddenly found an ancient copy of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" in the bookshelf. He was very happy and took it home to copy it, making a total of one hundred and twenty copies. When giving away one hundred and eight books, it was just the Nguyen Tieu Festival of the year Canh Ngo.

While resting, I dreamed that my mother used her hand to stroke the back of my hand and said: "Duc Sister, you are very filial! Today I was able to escape the suffering in hell, entirely because of your merit in spreading the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", there are 4 men and women on earth, when they read your book, they fully awakened. Now, the King of Hell in the underworld has allowed me to dream for you, to witness. Prove your virtuous actions and allow my soul to return to the burial place, (within the deadline of 11 p.m. to 1 a.m. on the eighteenth day) to the blessed place to be reincarnated. Thanks to this merit, the Sister can increase her longevity!".

The Sister cried and asked where her father was reincarnated. Mother replied: Because your father was rich when he was alive, he enjoyed too many blessings, so he was reincarnated as a poor scholar. Because he always explained and wrote books about cause and effect from childhood until adulthood, he has now become rich and wealthy. Again, what province do you live in? Which district? Didn't hear an answer but felt pushed away and woke up.

Seeing his wife sitting next to him, telling her all the details of the dream, the wife did not believe it and said: "Because you sit all day writing the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and are possessed by ghosts in your heart, you have such strange and strange dreams." When morning came, the Sister, wanting to prove the truth, went and stood in front of her mother's grave, lit incense and prayed, saying: "Yesterday I dreamed of meeting my mother but I don't know if the dream was real or not. If I could dream one more time to prove it, I would have more faith." That very night, Duc Sister met her mother again in her dream, very angrily pointed at her daughter-in-law and blamed "the person who blames her husband for spending all day copying the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" for not having time to take care of her and having secretly torn up five copies, her good deeds may be about to be destroyed by her. Now, the disaster will not be far from her, and she still dares to doubt the scene in her husband's dream! You are really a bad woman!". When Duc So ​​woke up, he asked his wife about tearing up five books of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". She defended and said, "Duc Sister, you are truly possessed.

There are three things about your story that I cannot believe:

+ First: My family abstains from killing, never buys living animals and animals to cook in the kitchen, pure and clean like a monk.

+ Second: My family burns incense today, will also light incense tomorrow, and invited Taoist monks to chant sutras and worship. In my opinion, eating vegetarian and reciting Buddha's name is a waste of money and has no effect at all. Why do some people die for more than ten years and still have to endure torture in Hades? Only thanks to the merit of copying a few good books was he able to save his mother. It looks like the charitable face of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, very funny!

+ Third: Say I tore five books of "Jade Lich Buu Phieu"? Those books he copied. He also wrote it down with his own hand,

gave it to people in person, and locked the rest with his own hand.

After hearing this, Duc Sister was half convinced and half doubtful. On the evening of the seventeenth day, Mrs. Thieu again gave a dream to her daughter-in-law's family and Miss Linh. She said: "The reason my son doesn't believe much in my words is because of the influence of his wife."

Next, Mrs. Thieu's ghost returned home, entered Duc Sister's dream and called his daughter-in-law to come to him, blaming him and saying: You despicable thing! On the sixth day of the seventh month of last year, you and your neighbor - Miss Chau Phung, who was working as a maid in my house, secretly put a copy of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" into a model shoe. The next day, she was angry because she did not allow Ms. Chau Phung to enter the house, and angrily tore up five copies of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". The next day, on the morning of the eighth day, her younger brother, named Thi Phuc, came home and discovered what she had done. He secretly used cloth to wrap up the torn paper, then told Duc Sister to distribute it to others. When he got home, he carefully glued each piece of paper together. Fortunately, the book was not torn and the content was lost. That was Thi Phuc's kind gesture. In the underworld, it was recorded in the book to make a great contribution to Thi Phuc about this matter. After that, because my son Duc So ​​hid the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" carefully, it did not let it fall into her hands and be destroyed. Now, are you still lying about your husband's three unbelievable things? Her crime is very serious. Mr. Tho Dia in the house no longer hinders the evil spirits from entering the door to wreak havoc, her disaster is right in front of her.I don't have the heart to see you suffer!

After saying that, she walked over to the bed and disappeared. Duc Sister had already woken up from her sleep, Thi Thi was also startled and raised her eyes. Duc So got out of bed, put on his clothes, turned on the lamp and asked his wife again, if something like that happened, the wife still stubbornly replied, "If you believe it, yes, if you don't believe it, it doesn't exist"

Just after saying that, suddenly she saw a pile of black color rolling into the bed, the wife was so cold her whole body trembled, her mouth numbly said to her husband: "From now on, you must conscientiously copy many books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu"! I'd rather believe that there is something than that. No. After listening, Duc So learned that his wife had indeed destroyed the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", so his mother's dream was also true; she was truly happy and worried

tieu_de: 4.5 Ten miracles to overcome dangerous illnesses
noi_dung:
4.5 Ten miracles to overcome dangerous illnesses

4.5.1 Rescuing his wife from rabies

Mr. Cao Nhan of Nhan Hoa reported:

My aunt in Ha Huu Kieu, last year participated in the bachelor's exam in the village. On September 11, when the admission was announced, I went to congratulate my aunt and uncle on her admission and heard him mention the story of the miraculous effect when printing the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" as a gift and describing the event in the dream. After listening, I was very surprised. At this time, my son, named Dinh Tang, had been suffering from scarlet fever for three or four days and still had not recovered. Fifteen days later, my wife Thi Phung and daughter also got scarlet fever; Not long after, a student and a servant girl also got sick.

There is a risk of illness in the house. The next day, I burned incense and wrote down a letter, praying for repentance and making a vow to print 400 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", and buy 300,000 souls to release. In less than ten days, four people were cured. Only Dinh Tang, due to poor health, did not quickly eliminate all the toxins in his body. The tumor on the left ear also slowly healed. The most miraculous thing was my wife Thi Phung. Scarlet fever was supposed to be just a normal disease. Because she normally worked too hard, her body was seriously injured, so the doctor was afraid of negative complications. But after I read the letter of prayer, my wife sweated three times, the rash completely disappeared and was cured.

 The belief in Gods praying for Buddha's blessing, the whole family is safe, has shown the effectiveness of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". The experience was as quick as hearing it in my ear, so I really believed in the thrilling event in Mr. Huu Kieu's dream. There was really no mistake.

4.5.2 Experience of saving a child with leprosy

Mr. Quach Vu Dien in To Chau said:

Ha Huu Kieu is a famous bachelor in Han Chau. In the year of the Tiger, when he came to my house as a guest, he gave me a book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". When I read the sentence "hell in the underworld is the hell of the human heart", I felt very surprised and thought it made sense. Because of understanding cause and effect, not because of superstition. In the Year of the Cat, my eldest grandson fell seriously ill. I burned incense from morning to afternoon to pray and vow to print this book. As soon as he finished making the vow, the eldest grandson's condition changed for the better.

In February of this Tan Ky year, the eldest son, Dan Luong, fell ill with a serious sore throat (an ancient name for leprosy). The condition was very dangerous. In an urgent situation, he did not know how to handle it. He could only burn incense and pray to God for rescue, vow to print gift books, and pray to be cured quickly. When he finished praying, the eldest son sweated, the danger turned into peace, the effect was very miraculous.

To thank God for his blessing, I asked my friends in Hangzhou to print 300 books and gave them all away. Next, I printed 300 more books and sent them outside the province to give away to promote and circulate. Taking advantage of this opportunity to announce it to the benevolent gentlemen, they should spread advice and advice, respect this book, and receive boundless blessings.

4.5.3 Preventing people from printing books as gifts, ghosts of the underworld come to harass

Mr. Yin, lead the whole family into the sutra. One day, along the way, he met a woman wearing a pink shirt and said to him: "When I was on earth, I wanted to print 100 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". At that time, you said printing this book had no effect and was hindering me, making it impossible for me to escape the punishment and suffering in the underworld after death." After speaking, he blinked and disappeared.

After a moment of surprise and reflection, Mr. Luu remembered that Trinh Ma Ma was the person who had previously worked for his family. Panic! When I got home, I got sick. When he was sick, he often dreamed that Trinh Ma Ma's ghost came to harass him. Thi Khuong's wife learned about the situation and quickly vowed to print twice the number of books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to spread the word. Mr. Luu Hac Trieu's mouth emitted a voice exactly like Trinh Ma Ma's and said: "The master's illness is due to the end of his life. So, on the one hand, I came to warn him of the incident, on the other hand, I came to lead him down to the underworld. Now, because I agreed to print the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to spread the word, I will rely on this merit to report to the underworld to receive blessings, to be able to escape, and to be reincarnated as a human in the next life. If It is possible to increase the number of copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", perhaps the owner can increase his lifespan."

Thi Khuong donated money to print 400 more books and distribute them to all over the world to promote charity. Half a month later, both husband and wife dreamed that Trinh Ma Ma came to give thanks and respectfully said: "Thanks to the spread of this good book, I am very fortunate to repent for my past sins, the underworld has allowed me to be reincarnated as a human. Besides, the master's life was also extended and the mistress's merits are also many, in the future she will definitely be rewarded with thousands of blessings."

After the couple woke up, they reported that the events in the dream were the same. Furthermore, Mr. Liu's condition also improved and he quickly recovered.

4.5.4 Repenting of the past, the ghost is freed

In the book "Praying for the Path of Self" there is a passage that Mr. Khau Dai Vinh told Mr. Lam Xuan: My father is Mr. Khau Phuc Chu in Nanjing, living very filial piety with my grandparents. My mother passed away early. I am his son named Khau Dai Vinh. I am also very filial and like to do good deeds. But my father Khau Phuc Chu did not believe that there are ghosts and gods and hell.

In the year of the Rat, I went to Suzhou to do business and brought back a book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", which my father and I read together. My father laughed and said: "What a myth!". As soon as he finished speaking, he threw the book into the drawer. But I was very respectful and wanted to find someone to print and give away to spread, but was afraid that my father would scold me if he found out, so I gave up. In the Year of the Ox, when my father fell seriously ill and lamented to his son: "Recently, I often see demons gathering in my house and wreaking havoc. I truly believe that there are ghosts. In my opinion, there must also be hell. I regret not believing in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu".

After hearing what my father said. All the sadness in my heart disappeared, and I immediately vowed to print 300 books to spread the word. At this time, Phuc So heard the devil say: "Even though he was about to die, Than Tao Quan wrote on his forehead the word "Thuan Tuan" and heard other demons screaming and saying: "The jade chi is about to come, I quickly leave this place, otherwise I will be punished." Phuc So's illness certainly did not take long for him to recover, the effect was so fast, it is impossible for people to not believe in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu". Phieu".

4.5.5 Printed as a gift the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", serious illness cured suddenly

In the notes "Nhuan Duong Tap" by Thi Ha said:

Mr. Luu Dac Thien in Canh Lang district, Ha Bac, gave birth to a son named Thien Du, just one day old, Thien Du was very sick, all the medicine was ineffective, Doctor said, Thien Du: "Even if the crane is reincarnated, it will be difficult to be reborn, it cannot be saved." but I have to endure it. After completing the request, a miracle appeared. In the blink of an eye, the son's body slowly recovered and became stronger. Even the doctor who had treated him was surprised and said: "How could this be possible, how could it be like that?" How the illness can change so dramatically from morning to afternoon is truly unbelievable. Thus, after 10 more days of treatment, his son was completely cured. The book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" is truly a great blessing.

 Mr. Tran Khac Hoan in Thuong Nguyen district heard that his relative named Phan Canh Phong was seriously ill and feared he would not survive. Khac Hoan advised him to print and give away "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to spread the word, to rely on this merit to eliminate unjust debts and harassment. At this time, Mr. Canh Phong was in a dying state, unconscious and unable to speak. A gloomy cloud flew over and guided him to the underworld. In the underworld, he met the Great Spirit of Avalokiteśvara that he remembered at home saying: "Your lifespan has ended. If you want to prolong your life, you must print over 10,000 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" as a gift."

Canh Phong was very happy, regained consciousness, and narrated Avalokiteśvara's great words to his family. The people in the house felt very surprised, turned their faces to the sky and promised to make a vow to print "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". But the family was very poor and could not quickly print the required quantity. Mr. Canh Phong urged him every day, but his wife was a woman and his daughter was a child. Even if you want to copy, it is difficult to complete the request. So, I cried and prayed to God, not knowing what to do

how. They did not know that the number of vows they had made could be divided into several batches for many years to be printed as gifts, and it did not necessarily have to be completed at the same time.

Because they did not know how to pray to be divided into multiple batches to complete, it was ten days late. Canh Phong naturally complained and said: just now the great man of Avalokiteśvara said: Ten days have passed in the underworld, and not a single book has been circulated. Therefore, there is no merit that can prolong my life, there is no way to save it."

Later, when I heard the news of Mr. Canh Phong's death, I asked about the matter, it was an endless regret.

Thus, this event was known to the whole Kim Lang district. During this past year, when anyone fell seriously ill or encountered a difficult situation, they made a vow to print and donate the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to anyone who requested it. response.

Mr. Khac Hoan did not dare to talk nonsense, so he made this event public, to demonstrate and advise the world.

4.5.7 Donate to print for "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" dream of healing

Mr. Tuyen Hoan Chuong in Buu Son, suffered from hemorrhoids for a long time, all treatments were ineffective, and he was very miserable. In the third month of the Year of the Dog, he suddenly read the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", and he immediately became convinced. He immediately stood in front of the Temple of the God of Kitchen Gods, making a vow to print the books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and "Regretful Chu Thuyet", "Tap Kinh Tao" etc... praying to eliminate hemorrhoids.

Some time, after silently praying. One evening, he dreamed of a monk, holding an iron sword, walking in front of him and saying: "Let me cut off your hemorrhoids!". After speaking, he raised his sword and slashed

once, he woke up in panic. Not long after, I discovered that my hemorrhoids had also disappeared. This is a recorded event reported by Mr. Luu Buu So to Mr. Quy Luong.

4.5.8 Serious illness about to die, in "Buu Phieu" was cured

Mr. Lo Thieu Hong in Tu Chau, because his mother was seriously ill, invited a doctor to come treat her. The doctor said: "Your mother's illness is very serious and cannot be cured." So he sincerely prayed for Buddha's mercy and blessings and vowed to print 200 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", praying for his mother's illness to be relieved and cured. As a result, in less than half a month, he actually recovered without needing medication. The above event was personally recorded by Mr. Thieu Hong to Mr. Quy Luong.

4.5.9 Evil deeds reduce fortune, good deeds eliminate sins

Mr. Tran Quan in Nhu Tuyen district, 39 years old this year, works as a professor in Vong Giang district. On June 11, Canh Tuat year, in a dream, he came to the door of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Pagoda in Nhu Tuyen district.

In the temple, there was an official dressed in black. He led him to the main hall and saw that the main hall was full of incense smoke. Outside in the hallway sheltered from the rain, demon soldiers stood bustling. Tran Quan stood under the steps, suddenly, he heard the solemn voice of the Bodhisattva declaring to him: "Your family has always lived a very happy life, especially your mother, chaste and pure, filial to her parents, and respectful of the Buddha's Gods. Such good deeds should have blessed you to pass the baccalaureate examination for the Ming Sutra department, and also have a chance to be admitted to the first round of doctoral studies in the Department of Armor. But because you often live in an arrogant manner, without any good deeds, you have long since passed. Let the gods take away all the blessings he enjoys. After he is forty years old or older, he will gradually suffer the evil consequences he created. In the past, the most unforgivable thing was that not long after, someone gave him a book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and he did not believe in it, and he hid the books that others asked to spread, hindering that person's good deeds. This crime will be very serious for him in August, it is impossible to be exonerated!”.

Tran Quan was startled and woke up. Thinking back to when he took the exam in Kim Nang, a son of professor Huynh Vinh Tang once gave him the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", asking him to pass it on to the two candidates in the same room. Due to the upcoming exams, I couldn't transfer it in time, so I brought it back to Vong Giang district, put it in the bookcase, I had forgotten about this for a long time, only now did I remember, it's over. But the things in the dream, both dreamy and real, cannot be believed, so in my heart I half doubted and half believed. On the 1st day of the Dragon month (Morning from 7 am to 9 am), he suddenly felt cold in his hands and feet, his heart was in turmoil, and his body was sweating like rain. In his reverie, he finally believed that his previous dream was real and not a fantasy. But think again, even though the crime is serious, repentance may be able to avoid disaster. Thinking like that, I feel much more comfortable inside. Therefore, I swear to repent for what I have done in the past and make a vow to print and donate the books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", "Am Dinh Van Quang Nghi", etc. After finishing writing, he read it three times, then burned the paper to worship the gods.

That night, he dreamed of a god, leading him to a large palace. The servant of the god outside the door came in, apparently conveying his repentance. After a while, he came out and asked him to leave temporarily. He felt as if he had just been freed from death and advised him: "Once your vow has been made, you must resolutely practice it and not let it go or forget it!" The above events were recorded by him personally.

tieu_de: 4.7 “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu” resolves injustice and turns enemies

4.7 “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu” exonerates the enemy

4.7.1 Murder without admitting guilt, ghost takes his life

Mr. Nghiem Trac Lam is a man of Vi Chau, twenty-one years old. His uncle used to help with the trade at the shop in To Tung Mau town, Trac Lam also went to study the trade. His uncle was staying at the ancestral house of the On family. Trac Lam came here every night to stay.

One evening, he suddenly went crazy and shouted loudly and said: "My last name is Vuong, my name is Vuong Thuy, I entered the body to confess my injustice: In the past, my husband also had the last name Vuong, his name was Vuong Vien, a person from Triet Giang. Nghiem Trac in his previous life was named Ngo Dieu Tran, a person from Triet Giang, Gia Han district. When Ngo Dieu Tran came to be a guest in Triet Giang and became acquainted with Vuong Vien. The two had a very good relationship. Vuong Vien once entrusted Ngo Dieu Tran with a thousand taels to do business with each other. A few years later, when Vuong Vien came to meet Dieu Tran to reclaim the money, he did not expect that Dieu Tran had

denied that he took that capital from Mr. Vuong Thuy. Making Mr. Vuong angry, he took out a knife and wanted to kill Mr. Ngo Dieu Tran. Mr. Ngo Dieu Tran caught the knife, turned around, killed Mr. Vuong Vien, and fled to Nam Xuong. I, Vuong Thuy, went to Gia Khanh district to denounce Mr. Ngo. I took the relevant documents along with the envoy to Nam Xuong, arrested Mr. Ngo for trial, then interrogated him to determine the crime and punished the entire army. That was the story of the 59th year of the Qianlong period. After 6 years in Gia Hung, Mr. Ngo Dieu Tran was pardoned by the Emperor and released home. I, Vuong Thuy, lost my husband, had no money, and had no one to rely on. When I heard about Mr. Ngo's return, I went to his house to ask for a thousand taels back. But Mr. Ngo still refused to return a penny, and even closed the door to not let me in. I was alone, homeless, and in anger, I hung myself in front of Mr. Ngo's door. When Mr. Ngo Dieu Tran saw it, he was very scared and fled to another country. In less than two years, he died.

In the 19th year of Gia Khanh, Ngo Dieu Tran was reincarnated into the Nghiem family, which is Ngem Trac Lam today. My unjust soul, Vuong Thuy, wandered in the city of unjust death, refusing to be reincarnated. For thirty years now, due to holding injustice in my heart, I have always wanted to find an opportunity to take revenge. A lonely soul, I searched all over but could not find it. Today, I went to this town and let me find it. I must take Nghiem Trac Lam's life to bear the crime, to clear the injustice."

Every evening, Thi Vuong possessed his body several times, causing Nghiem Trac Lam to punch his neck with his own hand, or bite his own hand, causing his head and arms to crack and bleed profusely. Everyone who saw him was extremely scared.

At that time, there was a man named On Dinh Lang, who is over seventy years old this year, learned about this and went to Mr. Nghiem's house to advise

explained to Vuong: "After hearing this, I know that this story is true. However, the injustice has been resolved but it cannot be ended, the injustice is repaid, the cycle is endless, it does not know when it will end. As said, the gold money has not been paid, the unjust soul has not been gathered. I agree to invite high monks or Taoists who have practiced, to pray for blessings under Diem Palace, on the one hand to save Nghiem Trac Lam's life, on the other hand, to pray for salvation for the person who comes. place of blessing, is this good for both of us?"

Thi Vuong reluctantly agreed and said: "I came with my husband, the boat was parked right on the river near Mr. Chau's house. Thank you very much for clearing our case, but you have to send us off to our destination, you have to make me a big boat, two inches thick, and the money is up to a hundred thousand. In addition, before getting on the boat, you have to pray to the gods and ask the water god for help."

Thus, Mr. On followed Thi Vuong's instructions. After completing the task in less than two days, Thi Vuong reincarnated into Mr. Nghiem's ​​body and said: "Wuong Husband Vuong Tien, has received orders to be reincarnated, because he is in the middle of being reincarnated, he must wait for instructions from the underworld to be released to reincarnate. My unjust life has not been ended yet, today I come, I must take Mr. Nghiem Trac Lam's life back." After that, the situation became more and more serious every day. When he saw that Mr. Nghiem's life could not be saved, fortunately there was a man named Thiet Canh who, after hearing this story, came to discuss with Mr. On Lang Dinh: "I see that such an unjust conviction cannot be resolved without using the method of printing the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". In the past, I printed 500 of these books to pray for my mother's salvation. And I dreamed that my mother had been reincarnated as a human; Mr. Thieu Tu Van once died for his mother. If you are sick and vow to print 500 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", you will be cured.

So, this can be done. Even though Mr. Nghiem Trac Lam's money is not strong enough, we can help each other", so on behalf of Mr. Nghiem, he wrote a letter, burned it and vowed to print and donate 500 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", plus "Relieving Suffering Chan Sutra" and "Phong Diem Khau" to relieve his grief.

 Not long after, on the night of June 28, Thi Vuong entered his body again and said: "The Jade Emperor has passed away." The dispatch board came, I was rescued, reincarnated in this province, between my injustice and Nghiem Trac Lam's I was freed." On the first day of the seventh month, Mr. Ho Thien Boi led a group of people and invited a practicing monk to recite the Sutras for Mr. Nghiem. On the sixth day, the recitation of the Sutra is completed. That very day, while Mr. Nghiem was sleeping, Thi Vuong's soul followed Thi Vuong to the presence of the gods. After receiving 30 lashes, Thi Vuong personally accepted the unjust conviction. When Mr. Nghiem woke up and faced the crowd, he saw that his thighs were red and swollen, and the marks were still there. From now on, the unjust soul of the Vuong has disappeared.
