I will divide it into many batches of gift books. After praying, his wife suddenly recovered and a few days later could eat, drink and walk normally. So he invited a few more good-hearted friends to contribute money to print books such as "Avalokiteśvara Sutra" 1,200 books, "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" 900 books.Because I didn't have enough money, the remaining amount was divided a little each year, until I had completed the amount I had made a vow.

4.10.5 Printed as a gift the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", everything was agreed upon

My name is Tieu Hong Dao, my family background was very poor. When I was 3 years old, my mother passed away and was raised by my father. At the age of 14, I was able to enter the school to study

 and at the age of 20 I joined the army, from soldier to group leader, joint leader, then deputy commander, feeling very comfortable. Unexpectedly, he was framed and was demoted to group leader, and it took a long time to regain his position as joint leader. During these years, my mind was suppressed, my spirit suffered, my body was tired, and long-term therapy was still ineffective. Later, when I went to the house of a friend who read the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", I contributed money to print 50 books and prayed to God and Buddha for blessings. When I did my private work, everything went smoothly. It shows that the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" has a response and the miraculous effect of printing good books as gifts is very clear.

4.10.6 Rescue and cure illness, good health and well-being

My name is Ly Tu Chinh, 72 years old this year, living in Son Hai Quan. Because my legs were sick, I had trouble walking. Knowing that the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" was magical, I stood in front of the altar of Than Tao Quan and repeated my vow to print 100 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". A few days later, my leg pain disappeared and I could walk like a normal person. Next, go and pray for good health. Peaceful family, respectfully donated 200 more books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu".

My close friend, surnamed Duong, last August fell seriously ill and often became critical, so he prayed to Than Tao Quan and made a wish, agreeing to print 100 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", and recovered that day. The eldest son had a sore leg and the younger son was weak or sick, so each of them printed 100 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to pray for peace, and all were satisfied. Right now, the whole family is safe and sound, which is also the miracle of printing charity books.

4.10.7 Record of longevity when printing the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu"

Mr. Tran Uu Dung in Dai Nghia village, Fujian province, four brothers are traders, Tran Uu Dung works as a gas agent, he knows

A friend had the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and borrowed it to read. His mother was 82 years old. In May 1992, she became seriously ill. The doctor declared it incurable, so he went home quickly to prepare her funeral. He remembered his mother's kindness, was very sad and could not do anything, suddenly he remembered the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" which recorded some very experienced records of praying for longevity and healing. That evening, he stood right in front of the altar of the God of Kitchen Gods and prayed sincerely, willingly printing the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to pray for his mother to increase her longevity. Two days later, one evening, Mr. Tran Uu Dung dreamed that he was going to a mandarin's palace, somewhat similar to that of the City Emperor. Uu Dung saw her mother walking back and forth in there. There was no one in the hall, only one person was holding a notebook, calling Uu Dung's name and telling him, it's getting dark, the door will close. Uu Dung was very panicked and shouted loudly for her niece to come pick up her mother. That person stopped him and told him not to speak up. Uu Dung thus led her mother back home.After waking up, he went right to his mother's bed to look. Before Uu Dung opened her mouth, her mother told Uu Dung about her dream in a weak voice. Unexpectedly, their dreams were completely the same. From now on, the mother's condition gets better and better, and later she is completely healthy again. The whole family was very happy, vowing to print more books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" as gifts

4.10.8 Print books of filial piety to relatives, healthy illness

 My name is Chau Tri An, from Ba Nhien, a group leader in the 18th army. Last year, returning home from Ha Li Ban, halfway there, someone gave me a book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", after After reading it, I saw that many miraculous events were recorded in the book. I thought of my elderly and weak parents who had been sick for many years and couldn't recover. When I got home, I immediately went to the Temple of the Kitchen God to burn incense and pray, and became successful.

I made a vow and wanted to print 100 copies of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" as a gift, hoping to bless my parents with good health. Unexpectedly, not long after I finished printing the book as a gift, my parents' old illness was cured, their health slowly recovered and improved. I felt that "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" was very miraculous. I didn't give much, but the effect I got was both fast and great. So, I decided to print 100 more copies to give away, hoping that my wife's difficult illness could be cured. Not long after, my wife's illness was cured. A family with three mouths can all enjoy the benefits of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". Therefore, I report this true event and show it to all believers. Never consider the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" as a superstitious book and lose the opportunity to do good deeds and avoid disasters.

4.10.9 Make a vow to support book printing, quickly get confirmation

My name is Ly Yen Quynh, my son's name is Hoang Kien, he wholeheartedly wants to study abroad. I entrusted a company specializing in making study abroad applications to handle the process. Even though all the conditions and procedures were met, it has been two years since I heard that it was not approved. I have gone through many efforts and still cannot get confirmation. In mid-November 2003, layperson Tuong Tran asked me to help print the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to pray for this. I went to the Buddha hall in my house to burn incense and pray, making a vow that if I could get a certificate for my son, I would like to contribute 1,500 VND to print the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". Unexpectedly, it was only in early December that I received the certificate to study abroad. Therefore, I sincerely thank the Bodhisattva's virtues, and at the same time, my husband and I each donated 600 VND to help print the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu".

4.10.10 Transmit to borrow the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", change destiny

Mr. Kim Minh in Yunnan, did not pass the high school graduation exam, waiting for a job at home, has had nothing to do for two years, very sad. One day, he went with his friend to visit a temple. In the reading room, he saw and read the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". I felt that the book could improve my life, so I asked to take a copy home.

He wanted to imitate the book and recorded about printing and giving books to pray for better luck, but his family was poor, he also had to feed a younger brother, he didn't have any income, and his parents didn't necessarily trust him. Therefore, he wanted to lend the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to others to read. On the first day, he went to the Kitchen God temple, said his wish, within 3 months he would show this book to 50 people to read. He also ran to the back of the house, looked up at the sky and said loudly again. In his heart, he also begged himself to change his spirit and become more enthusiastic, showing confidence in life and destiny.

From now on, he specializes in lecturing and lending books to his classmates and relatives about the content of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", after reading it, he lends it to others. When he knows that an acquaintance or friend has a sick person or is in trouble, he asks them to make a wish to print and donate the book Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu to pray, which is indeed effective. Later, someone borrowed a book for a long time without returning it. He only had one book left in his hand, which affected the speed of his book lending, so he went to the temple to ask for another copy of Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu. That way, he can turn around the work of spreading the word more effectively.

After two months, he had spread and lent it to 37 viewers. At this time, a friend came to find him. This friend's relative worked in Shanghai. He said that Pho Dong was urgently recruiting all kinds of talents. He asked him to quickly find some compatriots to work as security guards. The monthly salary was 800 VND, with accommodation and no meals. This friend first thought of it. him.

Mr. Kim Minh feels that the opportunity is hard to come by, and the book Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu is definitely starting to be effective. So he said goodbye to his parents, took the book Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu along with a few friends and left for Shanghai. While on the train, he had plenty of time and took advantage of the opportunity to introduce the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to the passengers on the train and gave these two books to two compatible guests.

After stabilizing his job, he took advantage of his time off to go to vocational school to add a career in electrical and water repair and obtained a certificate. Furthermore, he also adheres to the principles in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to work and help people to be happy, so he has a predestined relationship with everyone. After two years, someone introduced him to a foreign-invested enterprise to work as an electrician, with a higher monthly salary and better working conditions. To thank the heavens for his blessing, he continued to introduce the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to everyone who understood, calling on his parents and younger brother to believe in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", he also prayed for his younger brother to be able to pass the university entrance exam, and made a vow to print 1,000 as a gift. the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". 2 years later, his younger brother actually passed the university entrance exam smoothly, the whole family was happy with the merit of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", thank you very much.

4.10.11 Sharing the book donation of Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu, you quickly heal

Mr. Tran Thieu Thu in Fujian was sent by the company to Shenzhen to discuss work. While on the train, the person sitting next to him was holding the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and reading it passionately. During lunch, Thieu Thu asked him about the content of this book. He said he could lend it to him after dinner. He glanced at it, feeling half-confident and half-skeptical, but didn't feel anything special.

After coming to Shenzhen to work, he was taken around by a local friend to visit and have fun. At the place where Buddhist scriptures were propagated, he also saw the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" but did not ask to take it. The next day, return to Fujian.

After half a year, his son became seriously ill. After two months of injections and medicine, they were still ineffective. He was very impatient. At this time, he remembered the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" so he burned incense for 3 consecutive nights for Than Tao Quan and made a wish, wanting to donate 30 books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to pray for his son to recover quickly from his illness. He called his friend in Shenzhen again and asked him to come to the temple to buy 30 copies of "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and send them to him quickly. A few days later, the book was sent back. He immediately gave it to his friends, relatives, and colleagues, and advised them to read it once. After distributing 20 books, his son's condition stabilized a lot. After that, I found an Oriental medicine teacher, took some herbal medicine, and my illness was cured. The whole family couldn't believe it, so they reported this experience to spread the word.

4.10.12 Dedicated to printing and giving away books to escape from rivers and seas

In 1940, when I was in office in Fujian, Mr. Ma of the tobacco company gave me a book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", after reading it, I felt it was a tonic to save the world, very precious. Two days ago, when I was sending my wife off to Shanghai, I dreamed that a person wearing a black suit said to me: "This book is very good. If you could print and donate 1,000 thousand, it would help you a lot." When he woke up, he told his wife, after returning to Shanghai, to print gift books as gifts.

At that time, the Giap Giang river was blocked by soldiers due to the war, those who took the boat had to go to Phuc Thanh port to board the transport ship, and those who went to Shanghai to take the sailboat filled seven sailboats. Among them, 6 ships encountered storms and sunk, only the boat that his wife was on was able to sail safely. It's unbelievable

. It is truly blessed by God and Buddha. Just as it is said in the book "Tai Thai Thuong Touch": the concept of kindness taught in my heart, even though it has not yet been implemented in action, has already been blessed. It is not wrong at all. I give the story that I have personally experienced. If there is even half a lie, I will be sent to hell to suffer a painful punishment.

4.10.13 Vows to print books and be revived

My grandmother's name is Uu Quynh Phan, 78 years old. She had a stroke and was paralyzed for twenty years. Recently, she was diagnosed with diabetes. On May 9, 2004, she went to the hospital in Le Duong town for a medical examination. Not long after the infusion was given, a state of discomfort appeared, followed by a pale complexion and incontinence. Both eyes rolled up, unconsciousness and coma. First aid was ineffective, so she was transferred to Uy Hieu hospital for emergency treatment. After about 2 hours of emergency treatment, the doctor said she had stopped breathing, half of the treatment was over, and asked her family to prepare her funeral. Start, unplug the oxygen tube, clean up the emergency equipment. At this time, I received a phone call from my younger brother, telling my grandmother that she couldn't do it, and to quickly return home. At that time, I remembered many events in the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", I had the idea to try it, I immediately walked to the kitchen table and prayed to the Jade Emperor, the God of Kitchen Gods, and the Gods and Buddhas to bless my grandmother from danger to safety. And vowed to print 100 books and try to spread them.Unexpectedly, in just the first moment, the grandmother still lying in the hospital bed seemed to have just woken up and let out a weak scream. Sure enough, I woke up! The doctor also found it very thrilling so he started treating her. Not long after, she was discharged from the hospital. This is a true event that I personally experienced, not a single lie.

tieu_de: 5.1 The evil retribution when Phan Nguong Chi disgraced "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu"
noi_dung:
5.1 Evil retribution when Phan Nguong Chi disgraced “Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu”

Phan Nguong Chi is an educated person in Que Dong district, often slandering and destroying good books, or making false statements "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", when he read the point in the first chapter with the sentence "I saw a dead devil with handcuffs", he took a pen and wrote next to a sentence with 3 words "la chi chi": he used a black pen to erase the word "Saturday power", then used a brown pen to add 2 words "laughable" next to the word "alcoholic", using black pen to write more. The words "women seek their own deaths" have nothing to do with men in the words "return to reincarnation", using a brown pen to write down the two words "speaking nonsense". In the words "The Godmother, Mrs. Man", I used a black pen to mark out a few lines of words. In the sentence "cheap and painful, hard to break" circle 4 words. If the following content is not crossed, it will be erased. When you reach the paragraph "pink light filled the sky when Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara descended to earth", for some reason, the house suddenly burst into flames. Terrified, he jumped out the window and ran away. Once outside, he suddenly crawled with his hands on the ground, his legs turned upside down, he overturned the wooden chair, he couldn't move, it was like he was tied up. His wife, Thi Tin, woke up in a frightened dream, ran naked for her life, and walked over Nguong Chi, so that he could see her bad state.When his son heard the screams, he bewilderedly walked out holding the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and handed it to Mr. Lao's neighbor, but he went back inside to get his property and was burned to death by fire. At that time, Nguong Chi was caught in the fire, knowing that his karma was very heavy and difficult to escape, he took a deep breath and said to the crowd: "People in the world should not be malicious like me, claiming that there is no cause and effect, should not slander and destroy good books like "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", so that they have to suffer disaster and evil retribution like I am now." After speaking, he stopped breathing. The flesh on his body was burned to pieces by the fire, and was bitten by fighting dogs.

His wife, after escaping, felt she no longer had the face to stay in this place so she left. On the way to stay, she had promiscuous sex with a beggar. She was only 33 years old, her beauty was okay, but because she had committed adultery with a beggar, no one dared to remarry and even her close relatives wouldn't look. Not long after, the beggar passed away, and she and her former servant moved to a distant country. From now on, no one will know anything about her. The above events were recorded in a part of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu".

tieu_de: 5.2 The evil consequences that come when monks hate and destroy Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu
noi_dung:
5.2 The evil consequences brought about by monks' hatred and destruction Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu

There was a monk named Dat Vien who lived in a local temple on Tay Huong Si hill. One day, he and a Taoist priest of Am Thuan Duong named Quan Tien saw the contents of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" discussing rules about monks, nuns, and Taoists who made mistakes: The first palace said: "When monks receive money, they replace people in reciting repentance Sutras, losing words and numbers of pages. When they come to the main hall, they must supplement and recite the sutras that they have recited, and cannot recite them all in one breath..." In the tenth palace. There is: "Buddhist monks chant Sutras, take them to the underworld, and recite the scriptures to be executed in hell..." Dat Vien told Quan Tien: "You and I have both recited a number of Sutras. When it's time to change lives, we naturally know how to balance the situation to take advantage of it. Besides, my current life depends on reciting Sutras for my master, offering repentance to maintain my life. If this book were to be circulated outside, then my business income would definitely decrease. But my life is definitely reduced. But If we burn them, how many books can we destroy? When will we burn them all? Quan Tien replied

and said: "I have to use tricks, pretend to invite a great saint to reincarnate, and spread slander about the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" to believers of the same religion. As long as someone comes to ask the Gods, I will make up some nonsense rumors, to make people not believe in this book. So, why are you afraid that your sutra chanting profession won't make money later?". Dat Vien and Quan Tien spread the news to the four directions that in Thuan Duong Am Mieu there was a Taoist priest with very high magic who could invite the fairy bird Loan to enter his body and ask about some things about luck, luck, and fortune, which was very effective. Today is April 14, Patriarch Lu Thuan Duong comes, just by offering a little money in incense and lights, you can know about the luck and luck of the world.

Early in the morning of April 14, Quan Tien and Dat Vien made an offering table, burned incense, and arranged decorations.

At sunset, a number of monks, good men, and faithful women came and walked in, knelt and worshiped outside, waiting to inquire about the matter. A moment later, the person inside reported: "Chim Loan is moving!", called the disciples, put him on a table with a sand tray, and began to draw words. Again, call a literate person to read the words written on the sand tray, write down the words "I am Thuan Duong, the real person has come, if you want to ask something, come quickly and ask." After the people kneeling outside and listening to the people read the words, they all came up to ask about their future blessings and disasters. The fellow monks did not let the others ask first, only for Venerable Dat Vien to approach him and kneel down and say: "Please tell me how many things are there in this world, how many of the best things are there in the world?" Quan Tien said: "Chim Loan is moving again, you must not make noise, be quiet and wait for me to write!". I asked a man to guess the words near the temple to change the oil lamp. Not long after, I saw the teachers and students standing on the platform drawing haphazardly.

pause, he guessed the words, after replacing the incense and lamps, he stepped onto the altar and saw many neat lines written on the sand tray such as "First, you must respect the Taoist, secondly, you must respect the monks and nuns. Taoists can report things to heaven, can preserve eternal life; monks can pray for the salvation of the dead soul, can send them to the Western world. He awakens the world. Saying only needs to improve and repent, all his sins and evils are evil." In this world, I'm afraid that if I don't give alms money, incense, lamps, or amulets to worship, then I'll have a fatal accident. Currently, there is a book disguised as a good book, titled "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" circulating to warn the world. Just by improving and repenting, all the sins I have committed will be erased and reduced many times over. In the underworld, there is no such thing as an easy thing. Recently, there have been many people donating The money to print this book is to spread it, causing so much harm to so many ignorant people, all men and women... when you see this book, quickly burn it. Great merit."

He guessed that the words had just reached this sentence when suddenly he saw a stream of jade green light entering. Mr. Quan Tien felt cold and sneezed. He came down from the altar, his mouth distorted and his eyes askew, his face pale and he crawled next to Dat Vien and knelt together. At this time, the man guessing the words suddenly widened his eyes and was bewildered, unable to speak. He stood up for a moment, then said: "I am Tien Lieu, who was taught by the ancestors: people currently living in the world do not know how to accumulate virtue and practice, and often commit crimes. Fortunately, the Jade Emperor Great Emperor approved the Bodhisattvas and Gods, bestowing "Jade Lich Buu Phieu" to advise the world, so that the world's people know how to correct their previous mistakes, change evil into good, and in addition to granting more. grace, and were also exempted from some of the crimes they committed. Dat Vien and Quan Tien were jealous of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", which hindered their business.

Because they wanted to slander them, they used the excuse of gods to incarnate and deceive people's hearts. The crimes of these two people deserved to be placed in hell to suffer the punishment of suffering and based on their evil thoughts, they were reincarnated into corresponding evil realms. After the test, after completing the term, he will be tortured in hell and then be reborn in Avici hell and never be able to escape. Later, there were also monks and monks who jealously slandered and destroyed the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", and still treated it in the same way as Vien Dat and Quan Tien's retribution." After speaking, people saw the fortune teller retreating and bowing his head to thank the Patriarch. At this time, the male and female believers all walked to the altar, knelt down, bowed their heads, and prayed to the great immortal to give them a cure. Only to see that the sand tray on the table did not push but shook on its own. After writing, the lights gradually became brighter and clearer, the lights gradually became brighter and clearer. A literate person stepped up to see, on the sand tray was written:

“Mental illness must be treated with the mind, eat less fishy meat;

In the book there is Po Lo Mi, you can escape the wrongful crime.

Noon, Tien Lieu left.”

There were 33 words in total. The man guessed the words, bowed his head and said: "I wrote the words on the sand tray. When I wrote the sentence: The person with the greatest merit, in a dreamy dream, I saw with my own eyes a stream of jade green light, blowing up on the floor. Should have been at the Patriarch's dharma body's side, there was a fairy sitting: Blue face, brown lips, pure white eyebrows, golden eyes, body wearing a green shirt, large sleeves, left hand holding a jade vase, holding a jade vase in his left hand. I had to hold the fairy's beard, step on the lotus flower, and tell me to pass on the words of the founder. At this time, I unconsciously followed the instructions. Waiting for the deity to stand up and leave, I could only bow my head and say goodbye. When you came up to ask for a cure, the deity had already left the worship floor."

When it was midnight, all the good men and women stayed in the temple, standing on the brown painted steps, waiting. to heaven

morning. The monks, nuns, and associates in the temple waited to ask questions about the situation. They felt disinterested and left. Dat Vien and Quan Tien were kicked out of the temple. For the next three days, Dat Vien and Quan Tien could not eat or drink, screaming and bloating to death. From now on, all men and women in the village will not fail to respect the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", and also add this event to the book to spread to the world, so that everyone knows that disasters are created by themselves, no one can take away their good deeds, to serve as a historical reference for future generations who want to destroy the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" and will have to bear the disaster themselves.

tieu_de: 5.3 Memoirs of a prison sentence by Thoi Mong Luan
noi_dung:
5.3 Memoirs of prison sentences in hell by Thoi Mong Luan

Duong Khai Chieu, from To Cuong district, because his family's crop failed this year, he left his hometown to find work in the capital and found a job in Khanh Trung Duong. Straightforward personality, likes to drink alcohol. One spring of the fourteenth year of Gia Khanh in the Qing Dynasty, he found a banknote in front of Chan Vo temple, the value of the banknote was eight thousand dollars. When I went to the Ho Dong black sesame complex, I saw someone grabbing a teenager and punching and kicking him very fiercely. Ask the reason, ask more carefully about the amount of money they lost that matches the one you just picked up, then immediately return the money to them. When I (Cui Mong Luan) heard this story, I couldn't stop praising it. But I haven't gotten to know this person yet.

In September, Khai Chieu, through an introduction, personally came to my house to recount all his experiences. Because I wanted to prove cause and effect, I questioned him carefully, only to find out that he had typhoid fever last March. While in a coma, he met his deceased father who led him to a magnificent palace. On the palace door were three large words "Dong Nhac Phu", on both sides were written two opposite lines:

The reason why the world is so majestic and natural is because of me;
Who has the underworld retribution of the past up to now spared anyone?

The golden-colored handwriting looked very splendid. When I walked in, I saw an official, who turned out to be my deceased father-in-law, Mr. Chuong. Mr. Chuong used to be a baccalaureate in Ha Giang. He said: "My life should have only lasted until 59 years old, but because I married a woman with a husband and children as a concubine, my life was reduced by 10 years; later, the policy of letting aunts in the family remarry shortened my life by 10 years. When I died at the age of 39, because I had not committed any other karma, I was sent here to work as a criminal record manager in the underworld," when Mr. Chuong finished speaking, Called the demon soldiers to lead Khai Chieu to the underworld to watch the torture scenes in the underworld.

When I came here, I saw a woman tied to a pillar, having demon soldiers cut open her chest, take out her heart, screaming very horrifyingly. Looking closely, it turned out to be the wife of the housekeeper at Khanh Gia. Going to another place, I saw a person tied hand and foot lying on the ground, there was a demon soldier holding a stick and burning that person's back. Khai Chieu remembered that this person was the gatekeeper for Khanh Gia. Going to another place, he saw a person with his shoulders tied and hanging on a pillar. There was a flag on his head, reading: "National tax evasion smuggler Huynh Nhat Long", because his body was hung up and pushed around, he screamed very painfully. This person Khai Chieu also knew him, he was a smuggler named Huynh Ngau Chay, but did not know that his name was Huynh Nhat Long. Next, he saw Mr. Lam, a relative of Khai Chieu, with two iron nails tied to his shoulders. Not long after, I saw a big bell, very big, the bell hall had just been built, the pillars had not yet been roofed with tiles. Khai Chieu went there, wanted to hold the bell with both hands to test the weight of the bell, only to discover that there were many people's names engraved on it. Looking closely, he saw his own name in there, "Duong

Khai Chieu helps the silver coin", on the side it is also written "guiding the good direction of Thoi Mong Luan". Going to another place, he saw a person riding on the back of a cow, using a whip to hit the back of the cow, the person riding on the back of the cow screamed in pain, he said to himself that karma was retribution because he liked to eat beef in his previous life. Another place, the interior decoration was very decorative and dignified, on it were hung "Vajra Sutra", "Heart Sutra", one book each. Countless good men and good women were chanting sutras in their hands. Walking to the back door, they saw a high mountain. When they looked up, they saw the black sea and sky. They were very surprised. They felt like they were on fire and couldn't sit still. At this time, they saw a jar of clear water. There was a ladle on the water. I picked it up and drank a sip of water. I felt very fresh and penetrated to the bottom of my heart. I woke up and opened my eyes. It turned out that I had been sleeping all the time 17 days and nights.

Thinking back on what he had seen in the underworld, he went to ask: "How is the housekeeper's wife now?", the family member replied: "She has a heart attack." And asked: "What about Mr. Han?" Answer: "He had a malignant tumor on his back, and he passed away within a few days." In mid-July, people in the village asked about Mr. Huynh Ngau Chau's condition and said he was dead. But his illness was very strange: "Every night he screamed in pain, had to ask someone to tie him with a rope and hang it on a pillar to feel comfortable." He also told Mr. Lam that when he was in the underworld, he saw him with two nails stuck in his shoulder. He is now a mandarin in Ho Quang. At the end of July, his family sent a letter saying: in the spring, he suffered a major illness and passed away. All of the above events happened. It's just that I don't understand what it means to have a name engraved in the bell. After he recovered from his illness, he thought about the bell having my name engraved on it. He thought that if he thought about it, he would come to ask me and it would be clear, so he personally came to visit me, wanting to ask what cause and effect this was? At first, I didn't understand anything,

Later, thinking about what happened 3 years ago, the temple planned to make a bronze bell. I only received a notice from the temple to spread the charm everywhere and bought 2,000 dong of Buddhist scriptures. But at that time, I didn't contribute any money, I just announced everywhere to do good deeds, so in the underworld my name was written on it, it could show that the cause and effect of good and evil were repaid, so scary and respectable.

tieu_de: 5.4 Proverb "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" was robbed and his arm was broken
noi_dung:
5.4 Sarcasm "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" was robbed and his arm was broken

A typist at a printing factory with the surname Ha, while arranging the manuscript "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" quipped, "This content is all created by believers to deceive people, in truth there are no such things..." She also mocked a friend who donated money to help. book printing: "You give me money, we can still go out for a meal. You are so superstitious...". Two days later, she was walking on the street when her new cell phone was snatched away; A few days later, while driving on the road, the car fell into serious damage and broke his arm. It took a month of treatment and he still hasn't recovered, and he's still disabled in the future. So here, I would like to warn those who like to speak haphazardly: "Regarding books and literature that encourage people to turn from evil to good, even if you do not clearly understand or agree with them, you should not satirize or ridicule them to destroy them, and you should not hinder others from doing good and accumulating virtue, so as not to suffer retribution."

5. 5 Sentences in Tu Thang Am

's hell

5.5.1 Sangha did not propagate the Dharma, suffered from malignant boils and died

Mr. Long Hung in Thong Chau, working as Tri Phu, strongly believed in "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". Within the scope of his administration, there is a temple called Dong Nhac, which has always been very magical. Rumor has it that every time it gets dark late at night, the sound of a whip can be heard. One day, early in the morning, Long

Hung went to the temple to worship but was quiet and silent. The servant said: "Very respectful, take advantage of the night, you can definitely hear it." Long Hung did as he wanted. As soon as he opened the door, he saw a ghost soldier lighting a red brazier, burning the monk's back. Long Hung asked the demon soldier: "Who is he?", replied: "This person is a monk of a temple. Because he stole money from people's offerings and spent it on alcohol, meat, sex, gambling, and travel, not using it to repair temples, print scriptures, aid the poor and propagate Buddhism, he must suffer such punishment." The next day, Long Hung sent someone to that temple to investigate. Sure enough, the monk had a malignant boil on his back, and he soon died.

5.5.2 Proficient in sutras and mantras, changing lives and receiving punishment

Mr. Re-Bac Nhan in Ngo Huyen, often causes a lot of karma, but he worships Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva very sincerely, every day he constantly chants the "Great Compassion Mantra". One day, he fell ill and died. A few days later, a neighbor passed away at the same time he died, but soon came back to life. He said: "My life expectancy should have ended, but because three days ago I was able to console a harmonious couple like before, my life was extended by 12 years." He also said that I once met Mr. Bachelor in the underworld, his body was strangled by the ankles, and the officials in the underworld said to him: "Based on your sin of sexual immorality, you should have suffered the torture of being put in an oil pan! At this time, a demon soldier came carrying a large pan and used a high fire to cook. The oil boiled and pushed Bachelor into the pan. He was scared and had no choice but to open his mouth and chant the "Great Compassion Mantra" loudly. When he recited the mantra, he suddenly saw a vibration in the temple, the oil pan melted, and white lotus flowers sprouted from the ground and he said to the complaining ghost soldiers:

“He knows how to chant mantras, hell cannot hold him for the time being, let him be reincarnated!”But the demon soldiers resolutely refused to let him go. Quan Diem Palace said: "Mr. Ngo in Gia Hung, has done many evil deeds. Recently, because he wanted to pray for a son, he had done some good deeds, so he let him be reincarnated into the Ngo family. Wait until he has finished enjoying the glory and wealth on earth, reincarnated, and after forgetting the "Great Compassion Mantra", at that time, he can be punished." This time I was resurrected and wanted to go to Gia Hung of the Ngo family to see if they could give birth to a son." Later, they went to Gia Hung together to inquire, and sure enough, the Ngo family had just given birth to a son.

5.5.3 Taking bribes and misjudging the case, turning into a donkey

There is a doctor with the surname Truong, who holds the position of security and order manager in Shandong province. One day, two brothers, fighting over their ancestral inheritance, filed a lawsuit. The brother gave two hundred taels of gold as a bribe to Mr. Truong, asking him to win the case; The younger brother gave him three hundred taels of gold as a bribe, also asking him to win the case. Mr. Truong collected all the money from both sides. Because the younger brother gave more than a hundred taels of gold, he was considered the winner to enjoy the inheritance left by his ancestors. The older brother became angry and fell ill, not long after he passed away. Later, Mr. Truong also passed away. In the village there was a gentleman. Three days after he died, he came back to life. Call someone to invite Mr. Truong's son, tell him: "When I went to Diem Phu, I saw your father, he was about to be reincarnated into a donkey, now, he will be reincarnated into a certain house.", Mr. Truong's son did not believe. The gentleman said: "While my father was a mandarin in Shandong province, because of accepting bribes, he wrongly punished someone. The bribe money was through the servant of the recipient's house. If you don't believe it, you can go back and ask." When asked, it is indeed so. The gentleman said again: "Your father asked me to pass it on.

back to you; must definitely return the bribe money, and at the same time print the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" as a gift to alleviate his crime." After hearing this, Mr. Truong's son immediately followed his father's instructions and went to the place where his father was reincarnated, bought the donkey, sent it to a breeding hermitage in Duong Chau, and hired two people to take care of it. After three years, the donkey died.

tieu_de: CHAPTER 6: BAC THIEN HIEU TIEN PHUC IS WINNING
noi_dung: CHAPTER 6: Blessed Thien Hieu Tien Phuoc Wins

tieu_de: 6.1 The old monk opened his eyes and tried his best to be filial
noi_dung:
6.1 The old monk opened his eyes and tried his best to be filial

Duong Pho is from Thai Hoa district, An Vi province. He heard that in Sichuan there was a highly virtuous monk named Vo Te, so he said goodbye to his parents and went to Sichuan to visit the Great Master and seek enlightenment. Having just arrived in Sichuan province, he met a monk with a very gentle face. The old monk asked him: "Where do you come from? What did you come to Sichuan for?". He replied: "I came from An Vi province to Sichuan and wanted to ask about the great monk Vo Te Great Master and study the Great Dao Dharma." The old monk said: "It is more difficult for you to meet Great Master Vo Te than to meet Buddha." Duong Pho asked: "I also want to see Buddha but I don't know where. Please, old monk, give me instructions, okay?". The old monk said: "Okay, now you quickly return home. You see a person with a large blanket on his shoulders and shoes on backwards. That's Buddha." Duong Pho after hearing the old monk's words, without any doubt, rented a boat to go back to his hometown, traveling hard for a whole month on the way.The day he returned home, it was late in the evening. He knocked on his big door, calling for his mother to open the door. His mother heard that her beloved son had returned. She was so happy that she jumped from the bed. She didn't have time to get dressed. She only took the blanket over her shoulder. In her haste, she put on her shoes backwards. She quickly went to open the door and welcome her beloved son. Duong

Pho saw his mother's slovenly situation and realized the old monk's words that his parents were the living Buddhas. From now on, be filial to your parents, materially, try to guide your parents to believe in vegetarianism, reciting Buddha's name, and cultivating your character. Later, old Duong Pho lived to be 86 years old. At his deathbed, he recited four verses of the "Vajra Sutra" and passed away peacefully.

In Buddhism, the "Great Collection of Sutras" says: "If there is no Buddha in the world, treating your parents kindly means treating Buddha kindly." There is an ancient saying: "On the main hall there are two Buddha statues, who do not know how to be angry with the world, do not need to be made of gold, that is, the parents of the present and also Shakyamuni Maitreya, if treated with respect, there is no need to ask for other merits." Buddha in the "Forty-two chapters of the Sutra" said: "To seek blessings from heaven and earth, demons and gods, one should respect one's parents, be filial to one's parents and bring many blessings, very effective." From the above Buddhist Dharma scriptures and ancient sayings, it can be seen that what Great Master Vo Te told Duong Pho is very reasonable.

Currently, there are many people who do not respect and nurture their parents when their parents are alive, and even do many ungrateful and unfilial things to their parents, causing their parents to feel sad and sad. When the parents passed away, they went out of their way to spend a large amount of money to check feng shui, build spacious graves, burn lots of paper money, gold and silver offerings, and kill animals to worship. These things are not only useless and paradoxical acts, but also increase the guilt of the deceased parents. When their parents were alive, they did not give them a drop of water. When they died, they unjustly dug thousands of streams. So let the people of the world think and listen!

tieu_de: 6.2 Filial piety repays gratitude, gathering blessings on the right path
noi_dung:
6.2 Filial piety repays gratitude, gathering blessings on the right path

Lam Thanh My is from Fujian. When he was young, he lost his father. His mother definitely refused to remarry and devotedly raised him to adulthood. When Thanh My grew up, she thought that her parents' gratitude was difficult to repay, so she cried day and night. There was a Zen master who told him: "A filial child remembers the kindness of his body. Just crying is not beneficial, so he must find a way to repay it to be beneficial. In ancient times, there was a saying: "Doing good to the body is beneficial, doing evil to the body brings sorrow." If you want to repay your parents, only by abstaining from killing and liberating captive animals (life release), spreading negative virtue, is the filial response." Thanh My heard this and felt it was very reasonable. From now on, he should abstain from killing and release living beings, and practice good deeds to save the world. Later, the old man lived to be 96 years old, and his children and grandchildren all studied successfully and had fame.

Ancient people often considered their birthday as "mother's day", the mother was 10 months pregnant, her body was heavy and in pain, her heart was always worried about the fetus, the day of giving birth was very painful, the more fear and anxiety. Therefore, mother's gratitude is great. The Buddhist scriptures say: "Those who still have a mother are the rich, those who have passed away are the poorest; the mother who is still alive is pure every day, the mother who has passed away is like the sun descending from the mountain." In the Buddhist scriptures, we are also told: "Respecting and being filial to your parents is like worshiping the Buddha, both of which bring you the same blessings."

Many people have spent large sums of money traveling thousands of miles to pray for blessings, fortune, or praying to the east or west to hope for good luck. You don't know, every house has a Buddha statue, there's no need to go far to beg for bail.

People in today's era, every time their birthday comes, they race to slaughter chickens, ducks, fish and meat to treat guests to celebrate. This is against Heaven's decree of repaying kindness and gratitude. Doing so will not increase blessings, but on the contrary, it will destroy blessings and fortune.

network. Therefore, on your birthday, you should go buy animals to release them, or remember the kindness of your parents, or give alms to the poor, print charity books, or recite Buddha's sutras and do good deeds, which is the right path to do good for heaven and earth.

tieu_de: 6.3 Try your best to be filial to your mother and your child will be kind
noi_dung:
6.3 Try your best to be filial to your mother, and your child will be kind

Toi Hao, since childhood, has been innately filial. His father passed away very early, and his mother cried too much due to grief and sadness, causing eye disease. Cui Hao sold all the assets in the house and went everywhere to find a doctor to treat his mother's illness, but it was still ineffective and her eyes were blind. From then on, he very respectfully took care of his mother, thirty years seemed like one day. All of the mother's clothing items were purchased according to the hot and cold weather. The mother's daily life was very comfortable, with no shortage at all. Whenever the weather is nice and the air is fresh, I will definitely take my mother out on an excursion to breathe the fresh breath of nature. Although the mother's eyes were blind and she could not admire the picturesque scenery, Mr. Thoi described the natural scenery as flying dragons and dancing phoenixes, telling the mother with great interest all the news events that occurred during the day, discussing with her in joyful laughter, relieving the sadness of old age, forgetting the suffering of blind eyes, and being very happy. Later, Mr. Thoi grew older, his officials were honored, and together with his children and grandchildren planted fruit trees in the garden such as peaches, plums, persimmons and other trees so that all seasons could have fresh fruit to eat.When the mother passed away, to repay her kindness, towards the end of her life she became a vegetarian. Because of Mr. Thoi's noble conduct, he was able to hold a high official position, and Mr. Nhuoc Phoi's son also became a general in the next life.

In the episode "Records of Touch" it is said: Filial piety to parents, should not be cold to parents, should not let old parents have to worry about worries,

should not let parents be afraid, should not let parents be sad, should not let parents have difficult to express feelings, should not Let your parents have hatred. If we can do such filial acts, heaven and earth, humans and ghosts will respect us. Being a child, using material things to provide for you, and taking care of your spirit to stabilize the mind of the elderly, is the most basic act of filial piety; Try your best to study, sincerely respect your karma, to become a useful person for society and the country, to ascend to glory for your parents, and be a great filial person; Leading elderly parents to study Buddhism, advising them to recite the holy phrase "Namo Amitābha Buddha" to pray to the pure land in the Western world of ultimate bliss, forever free from the suffering of reincarnation, is the most perfect great filial piety in the world.

tieu_de: 6.4 Filial piety to the mother-in-law will cure the whole family of epidemics
noi_dung:
6.4 Filial piety to the mother-in-law, the whole family neutralizes epidemics

  During the Qing Dynasty, the third month of the year Giap Ngo, Vo Tien district, Jiangsu province, a resident of Thanh Dong, Wei Thanh's son married Miss Thi Tien as his wife. One time, Thi Tien went home to visit her parents. Not long after, her husband's village had an acute epidemic, spreading very widely. The disease killed many people. Everyone was afraid of being infected. Close relatives did not dare to visit, worried that they would not be able to escape in time. Unfortunately, Wei Thanh was also infected with the epidemic. Later, their entire family of eight people were all infected with the epidemic. Thi Tien in the girl's village heard that her husband's parents were infected with the disease. She couldn't wait to go home and ask about her illness. Her parents loved their child and were afraid that their daughter would be infected when she returned to her husband's house, so they advised their daughter not to go to her husband's house at this time. But Thi Tien understood the great cause, she said: "When a husband marries, he wants his wife to help take care of her husband's parents. Now her husband's parents are critically ill, if I have the heart to not return, then how is that different from an animal!" Finally, don't listen to your parents' objections, don't be afraid of contagion

of the epidemic, she returned to her husband's house on her own. When Thi Tien returned to her husband's house, Nguy Thanh and his wife and all eight family members miraculously recovered from their illness. The people in the family at that time believed that the whole Wei Thanh family was saved from the death of the epidemic because of Thi Tien's filial piety, and was moved to receive divine inspiration.

Currently, in society, there are very few children and grandchildren who are filial to their parents, but it is even more difficult to have a daughter-in-law who is filial to her parents-in-law. The cause of the disease is bacterial infection, but lowered immune function in the human body is also an important cause. Megigan University in the United States conducted a 14-year follow-up trial on 2,700 people and discovered that people who regularly practice good instincts have very strong immune systems. Research at Ha Phat University in the United States once let students watch a memoir about an American woman who spent her life going to India to help the poor and sick. The students were moved by this memoir. Next, the scientist took each student's saliva and conducted an experiment, discovering that the standard of immune white blood cells increased more than before watching the movie, setting a record. This reaction is due to Thi Tien's great righteous spirit, courage, and filial piety, strengthening the whole family's resistance, making it difficult for disease bacteria to have a place to arise, so they were saved from death. Cause and effect stories are truly in accordance with the principles of science.

tieu_de: CHAPTER 7: RESPECTING THE GODS
noi_dung: CHAPTER 7: RESPECTING THE GODS

tieu_de: 7.1 Scolding the gods and deities brings bad luck to the body
noi_dung:
7.1 Scolding heaven and earth, bringing bad luck to the body

I am from Shandong, and have been very smart since childhood, and was born to look very handsome and lovely. Although my family background is poor, I have a different temperament and personality than the children around me. My academic achievements are always first-class. I am always the focus of teachers, classmates and neighbors. Many sophisticated fortune-tellers and physiognomists all have the same prediction: my life will be prosperous and prosperous.

But from 1988 onwards, for unknown reasons, my fortune deteriorated seriously, as if falling into a thousand miles of abyss. I started to get sick, my memory gradually decreased, my head turned dark, my body ached all over. The sudden illness has been with me for 15 years. Whether I went to university or worked at a unit, it was very arduous and difficult. For the past 15 years, I have tried every way to do all kinds of things but still failed. Things related to my future, even though I tried my best, were still ineffective and unachievable. In recent years, I kept thinking, why is my destiny so dark?

After taking refuge in the Buddha's path, due to the progress of my practice, there were a few changes in all aspects but still no fundamental changes. I began to console myself, my fate was probably caused by the cause and effect of my previous life. Later, when I read the Ksitigarbha Sutra, I learned that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has great divine power and can make sentient beings know the cause and effect of previous lives to eliminate cause and effect. So starting this month of 2003, I began diligently reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra and cried in front of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva lamenting my miserable life for the past 15 years, asking the Bodhisattva to let me awaken.

After 20 days, something I did 15 years ago suddenly appeared in my memory. It seemed like I had the feeling that I could understand it but I didn't dare to confirm it. Until November 2003, I had just finished reciting 200 pages of the Ksitigarbha Sutra. On that day, I met a monk who gave me the book Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu. After reading it, I felt like I woke up from a dream and suddenly understood the situation. Finally, I found out that the reason why I have been tormented in pain and hardship for the past 15 years is not caused by negative karma from my previous life, but mainly because, in this life, I have committed disrespect to

The gods of heaven and earth caused it.

On an August afternoon 15 years ago, because I was shocked by a family matter and couldn't handle it, I ran out into the yard, pointed at the sky, stomped my feet profanely, and used all the spells and words I knew to curse heaven and earth. From that moment, less than 100 days later, all my body ached, starting 15 years of my bad luck. From the day he started getting sick to November 2003, it was just 15 years. Ten seconds of cursing heaven and god, in exchange for 15 years of extreme bad luck. What a horror! I can only bow my head, admit my guilt, repent and resolve to donate money to print and spread the book Ngoc Linh Buu Phieu, to respect the gods. Unexpectedly, when thoughts arose in my heart, vowing to be friendly and kind, in less than a week, the workplace unit issued a document and I was promoted. Since I started working for an unimaginable period of 8 years. Even more strange, two days ago my palms started itching. At first I thought it was caused by mosquito bites. Looking closely, I discovered that my palms that had been broken for 15 years had now reconnected. It was so magical and miraculous, I couldn't believe it!I do not ask for anything from Bodhisattvas and Gods, I am just determined to repent and vow to print charity books and spread the book Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu, which is truly an unusual book!

tieu_de: 7.2 The miraculous process of Than Tao Quan
noi_dung:
7.2 The spiritual progress of the Kitchen God

The above event is an example of how I personally felt the spiritual effectiveness in the content of the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu". As for the story below, I was inspired by the "Christmas Saints" in the book "Jade Lich Buu Phieu".

The day of worshiping the Kitchen God God is one of the five days of worshiping the spirits in traditional Chinese culture, and is still popular among folk and overseas Chinese. In my old hometown in Shandong, it is said that "Small New Year falls on the twenty-third day". The first day of the New Year is the big New Year, and the 23rd of December is a small New Year. When you wake up early in the morning, the dream of that day will represent the fate of the next year. Every family makes their own very sweet sugar, called apple sugar or called troi nuoc sweet soup, to worship the Kitchen God, to ask the Kitchen God to come up to the Jade Emperor and say more good words for their family.

One winter in 1994, I was about to take the university graduation exam and was worried about career orientation after graduation. One time, I met a high-ranking official in Beijing. After discussing, he had a very good impression of me, felt that I had many good qualities and also expressed his desire to work at a State agency. I am a child of a poor family, I have no circumstances to push me, it is only because of fate and blessing that I have such a wonderful fate. In August 1988, I pointed to the sky and cursed the gods. I didn't expect that my reputation would be "isolated." Even if I had a good opportunity, it wouldn't have any effect. In the end, I couldn't go to Beijing. Later, he arranged for me to work in a capital city in an ethnic minority country, to hold an official position in a unit with very good benefits that local people could not dream of. However, due to the evil retribution for my evil words and cursing at God, I was often pressured and overthrown by the unit's powerful leaders, my bonus was forced to the lowest level, I was often criticized and made difficult, and under mental pressure, I once again felt that God is very admirable;Anyone who dares to resist heaven and despise the gods will suffer on earth due to "Resistance to the heavens" and such a situation continues for up to seven years. All the events that happened in the dream of December 23, 1994 woke me up.

In the dream, I climbed a very high tower, about to reach the top floor

Most of all, there were people standing below, all looking with admiring eyes. At that moment, I don't know where a giant came, about twenty stories high, grabbed me, pulled me down, threw me to the floor, threw me on a pile of bottle shards, and turned me into an insect with a broken leg. I woke up scared, this dream left a very deep impression on me. But only now do I understand that the dream on the morning of December 23, 1994, not only predicted my destiny next year but also predicted my destiny in August of the following year. In which, "climbing to the top floor" means that I meet a nobleman who is about to go to Beijing. Being thrown into a pile of broken bottles is a prediction that I will be envied and harassed by some people during my work; turned into an insect with a broken leg, predicting that I would be pressured and trampled by others until I had no place to stand, and my body would become sick; That giant is an angel who gave me magic to destroy my good deeds.

 From then on, I dedicated myself to preaching the Dharma, warning sentient beings on earth, to revere Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Holy Spirits, to admire the "Jewel Lich Buu Phieu", not to pay attention to the sins created by my body and speech, to practice good deeds and accumulate more virtue, and I will receive blessings and dispel disasters. Buddhists do not depend on themselves to satirize the book "Jewel Lich Buu Phieu", without knowing that the highly accomplished monks respect the dharma-protecting spirits. If there are Buddhist disciples who dare to rely on their position to look down and despise "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", and even increase criticism, it will not only lead to evil retribution in this life, but also slander the awakening of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and extradite Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. Slap.

tieu_de: 7.3 The nature of god worship and morality of demons and gods.
noi_dung:
7.3 The nature of god worship and morality of demons and gods.

We know that in the immediate future, the place of human existence in reality has only two states: if there is heaven then there is earth, if there is sun then there is moon, if there is white sky

there is night, if there is man there is woman, if there is life then there is death, if there is earth and yang then there is underworld, there are living people There are ghosts and gods, there are mandarins on earth, and there is the King of Hell in the underworld. Yin and yang are in balance to create all things. This is the principle of nature, also the principle of heaven and earth, all things exist in harmony with each other.

The story about Gods, although on the surface it seems a bit vague and unrealistic, from past to present, history and the present have many events that prove it to be true, with examples to follow. The so-called intelligent and honest people are gods, worshiping gods is only because of worshiping the spirit and personality of the ancestors, in order to educate future descendants, effective methods, this will be rich spiritual food. Ancient people in ancient times had noble personalities, for the sake of the country and the people, they devoted a lot to guide the future generations. After death, erecting statues and building temples to commemorate them has educational significance, which means that nowadays, building temples, memorial houses, and monuments to remember, just need to clearly understand the facts about reincarnation and immortal spirits, then we will understand the morality of respecting gods and feeling each other.

In developed Western countries, up to 95% of people have religious beliefs, they also recognize heroic or famous people who set up monuments in parks and temples to commemorate them. Only China, according to ancient customs, often builds temples and pagodas using the method of burning incense and worshiping. Therefore, from ancient times to the present, the teaching of the gods still exists in the people, building statues and building pagodas to create people with respect and high thoughts is often demonstrated, plus there are effective events that make people follow the main customs, follow the promotion and education, not just to pray for blessings but worship. Nor is it a crime to commit a crime by not burning incense and worshiping. As long as you wholeheartedly revere in your heart, it is:

Holding evil thoughts and creating evil things without repentance
Even if you worship or worship, it is useless;
Cultivating a good heart, accumulating virtue and reverent karma,
Not bowing, not serving, one thought with sincerity is still effective.

People in ancient times said: "Respect God as God appears!" Therefore, many people bring food, incense, and money to the temple to show their sincerity. However, based on the scriptures, the best way to worship Buddhas is to follow them and study, take concrete actions to implement their ideas, study them with a spirit of compassion and forget themselves for the sake of all sentient beings to seek blessings, study them to enlighten humanity, contribute wisdom to humanity, study them to have all kinds of good virtues, righteousness, loyalty and filial piety. Only then can one quickly receive the blessing of God and Buddha, step forward to improve one's own Enlightenment morality, become a noble person, a person free from low-class interests, a person useful to the world, with a spirit as if a god appears, feels and is of the same mind, which is an absolutely accurate and effective method of praying for blessings.

People in today's era believe that the retribution of good and evil is not due to the influence of gods and demons. It's just that evil people receive evil retribution because they caused it themselves, not because of divine punishment. According to the theory of Buddha Dharma, this is indeed a truth, self-harm and self-suffering do not go against God's punishment. For example, a criminal being arrested and imprisoned is essentially his own responsibility, but it does not completely deny the victim's prosecution or allow him to make an investigation and the court's decision. Not to deny that being punished is completely misleading. Therefore, "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu" is a book that goes together with heaven and earth respecting the rules of "Heaven's Law and Earth's Law".

tieu_de: 7.4 Coexist with glory, unite to save the world
noi_dung:
7.4 Coexist with glory, unite to save the world

In the immediate future, some Buddhists only accept that Buddha exists, do not accept that there are angels and fairies. In the scriptures, it is said that people who practice the ten good karma will become angels and fairies after death; but there are also some Buddhists who do not know the spirit of self-realization and enlightenment of Buddha and Bodhisattva, the higher realm than angels, but consider Buddha and angels to be on the same level. The ways in which Gods and Buddhas do not differentiate between Immortals and Buddhas show that they not only cause Buddhism to be degraded but also cause society to be offended. Buddha in scriptures repeatedly mentioned that angels and fairies are not at the same level as the gods of the six paths. Master An Quang monk repeatedly explained to people that they must know how to respect demons, heaven and earth, fairies, Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, etc., showing that a true Buddhist of Buddhism never fails to respect the morality of gods and goddesses. Therefore, between heaven and earth, there are invisible laws of nature, how can we not respect them? Buddha is the highest meaning in the world, all virtues follow!

In addition, some believers often like to scorn and defame, but also curse and insult other religions (having committed evil karma), and soon often look down on them as "heathens", and even make the mistake of making heathens on the same level as heretics. When Sakyamuni, when he had not yet become a Buddha, he had prepared to learn 96 types of heretical sects to achieve liberation. Later, when he finally awakened to "There is no law in the external mind", he became a Buddha. When he was practicing the Bodhisattva path, he many times used the pagan religion of Ba Da Mon, the image of an immortal, to save sentient beings. Literally speaking, not only being a follower of Buddhism or other religions, not cultivating from within is called paganism. True religion often instructs people to practice good deeds and accumulate virtue, to save the world and help others. There are only differences in methods, tactics, aspirations, and causes. Buddha's treatment of people of other religions is absolutely never advising them to give up the religion they believe in and come to study Buddhism (unless it is a pagan religion), but rather to act in the world, preach the truth, and proclaim the teachings.Buddhism is based on the basis of filial piety. After studying Buddhism, you must be more filial to your parents, love your God more and admire your teacher more, that is the Buddha Dharma. Therefore, Buddha Dharma is respected by all human beings, Buddha is honored as "World-Honored One". In

the book Pi Diem Che La Bodhi Tap, it is said: "If human beings trample on paganism, they will be far away from Pi Diem Che La (ie the cause and effect to become Buddha)".

The founder of Pure Land Buddhism in China was Master Huiyuan of Dong Tho Lo Son. He and the current Taoist Master Luc Tinh Tu, famous Confucian scholar Dao Khuyen Minh, were very close, often came together, discussed mystical principles, and preserved in history the beautiful story of "Tiger Khe Tam Tieu". He not only lectured on Buddhist principles, but also taught Confucian classics, studied in depth the essence of family religion, and continued to study Confucianism throughout his life. The high-ranking monk of the dynasty, the Zen master of Hoa Nghiem Five Patriarchs Quy Phong Ton Mat in the book Reasons for Causes, said: "Confucius, Laotians, and Shakyamuni are all saints, depending on the situation, teaching and receiving disciples, mutual love from home and abroad, and benefiting all living beings." The great monks of today - Dharma Master An Quang and Dharma Master Dam Thu respect all major religions and gods equally, and Tan Kien Dan, the great achiever, often practices along with Protestantism, Catholicism, Taoism, and Confucianism throughout the United States.Currently, in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and the United States, major religions often gather to organize charity activities to exchange together. Protestantism, Catholicism, and Taoism invite Buddhist people to churches, ceremonies, or palaces to recite "Ksitigarbha Sutra", "Vajrapani Sutra" and perform Buddhist songs. Buddhist Buddhists also read the books "Holy Bible", "Ma Thai Gospel", "Tao De Kinh", "Tao Thuong Touch Tap",... like Close relatives come and go together, it's very harmonious and friendly, but while practicing, it's still the same religion that practices that religion. From here, it can be seen that for hundreds of years, in Buddhism, the Four Great Gods Protector of Dharma, Cuu Hoa Son of Taoism, is famous as "Ngoc Quy Fire Phu Thien Tuong" - Linh Quan Vuong. Statues of this deity have been set up in places in Cuu Hoa Son and Pi Vien Tu, Cam Do Tu to worship and revere.

Looking at the Dharma world to say: Buddha and sentient beings are indifferent, all sentient beings (including gods, fairies, and other living beings) have Buddha nature and are born equally. At least a creature as small as an ant still looks at it with equality, let alone treating religions and gods that take goodness as their nature like that. For the sake of sentient beings, between sects, we must abandon past history, be tolerant and generous, and share the same glory. Only then can the human world be on the right path, heaven and earth should be on the right path.

tieu_de: 7.5 Bowing to gods and praying for blessings
noi_dung:
7.5 Bowing to gods and praying for blessings

In the immediate future, places across the country have many types of temples, large and small (not talking about Buddhist and Bodhisattva temples). Some temples on the day of visiting gods often ostentatiously slaughter animals, using both meat and fish to offer blessings. So basically, it is against Taoism, distorting the meaning of the heavenly way of Buddhism.

“The heavens have the virtue of eagerness for birth” famous classic of Taoism “The Practice of Supreme Induction”. In the book, there is a text that warns human beings not to "chase" (birds) with alcohol to chase (animals), to build nests, to harm fetuses and destroy eggs, not to "kill turtles and fight snakes", "to harm insects"; Furthermore, we must understand and speak to humans, if we can "be kind to things and not kill living beings, we will surely be protected by heaven's path, blessed with blessings, and protected by the gods."

Buddha in the book "Middle Ban Khoi Sutra" said: "Killing living beings on the anniversary of the ancestors' death does not bring blessings, angels do not eat, and the killer commits a sin." Why don't angels eat? Because angels reside in a palace in heaven built of seven precious stones, eating only sweet delicacies like nectar, so why do they have to eat the meat of animals that is smelly, dirty, and ugly? When the angels don't come to eat, they won't be able to pray for blessings. Those who kill living beings to make offerings and worship will also have to bear the additional crime of killing living beings. This is really causing trouble for themselves! Therefore, killing living beings to worship gods is an evil act, a meritless and sinful act.

In the book "An Si Toan Sach" there is recorded a story of "the river god receiving precepts": in the land of crocodile mines in Jiangxi province, there is a river with very dangerous strong currents, called "three meters of waves without wind". This locality has a Dragon King temple, considered very spiritual, the merchants who come and visit, definitely kill living beings and worship, only when the sea will be at peace, for such a long time, because of worshiping, they have killed so many animals that it is impossible to count. During the Ming Dynasty, there was a magician with very high virtue who passed by. One day before his arrival, the manager of the Dragon King temple dreamed that the Dragon King god came and told him, "Tomorrow there will be a great monk coming here. In his previous life, he practiced and worshiped the same monastic master as me. He was inconsolable. In this life, he became a high monk. I just made one mistake and became a god who eats animals and blood (using the use of killing animals). objects to worship the gods), my karma of killing living beings is very serious, in the future I will definitely go to the great hell to suffer retribution. Tomorrow, please pray for me on my behalf to beg the shaman to give me the Buddha precepts, in the future you will come to worship me, you must not use alcohol or meat!The next day, the temple's owner went to investigate, and sure enough, he met a similar magician, so he clearly explained the reason to him and invited him to Dragon Vuong temple to preach the Dharma. From now on, the waves and winds on the riverside will be very peaceful, and passersby will not need to kill animals to make offerings. Therefore, if a god enjoys food that smells fishy, he must also suffer the precepts of killing, and must also go to hell to suffer retribution.

In the world, there are indeed killings to worship gods and ghosts to seek blessings. We should clearly understand that gods and ghosts do not really practice to become a great compassionate holy spirit. They also sometimes make mistakes. Besides, there are indeed many evil spirits, demons, demons who devour flesh and blood, and act strangely in the world. time. If, due to the desire for blood and flesh, you receive offerings from flesh and blood, it will give you a blessing that you do not deserve

yes, help me do things I shouldn't do. This will be an act of bribery that commits the karma of killing and stealing, and will later incur suffering; Speaking from myself, in addition to having to bear the karma of killing, I also have to endure the suffering due to forceful request and be exempted. I must know that I can escape for a while but not forever, and enjoy blessings that I do not deserve. Who knows if evil spirits and evil spirits will turn things around for me to enjoy the blessings that I deserve, so what is there to be happy about? Based on that, killing and worshiping, for gods or humans, both are harmful. Therefore, the "Dhammapada Sutra" says: "If you have little karma, you will see blessings, because evil has not yet come, when evil comes, you will bear the penalty." Thus, when we pray for blessings, we must use pure and compassionate methods such as releasing animals, fasting, chanting sutras, respecting elders, helping lonely elderly people and people in miserable circumstances, supporting poor, illiterate children, reciting Buddha's name, worshiping monks, worshiping the Three Jewels Buddha, and praising the cause and effect of good and evil. Supporting money to print good books to spread to humanity is the right way to seek blessings.If you make offerings to Buddha, you can use fruits and vegetarian foods which are very good. As long as you are sincere, you will be understood.

tieu_de: 7.6 Reciting the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva avoids accidents
noi_dung:
7.6 Reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's name to avoid accidents

Ms. Vuong Tu Phan was 18 years old. She moved from the countryside to the city to work. At night, she often woke up from nightmares, causing mental confusion. She heard that reciting the seven words of the sacred name "Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva" can help you sleep peacefully, and can also increase good luck and eliminate disasters and evils. Should be used every day for 20 minutes and recite 1000 times. That night she slept very peacefully, from then on the nightmares gradually decreased.

One dark night, she dreamed of a group of very ferocious villains, forcing her and some of her sisters to play close to each other, saying they were taking them to work as prostitutes. She was very scared. When she was panicking, she recited the famous phrase "Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva". After just reciting a few sentences, she saw a monk holding an iron stick coming, pointing at her and telling the evil people: "She is my person, you cannot arrest her!" After saying that, he chased all the evil people away and took her home. When she woke up, she felt that this dream was very strange.

Two months later, some friends from the countryside invited her to go to Fujian to work with them. Each month the salary was more than two thousand dong, and a settlement fee of one thousand dong was paid in advance. After hearing that, she was moved and prepared to go. Unexpectedly, the next day my stomach hurt so much and my diarrhea wouldn't stop, so I couldn't go together, so I missed this opportunity. Half a year later, information spread in the countryside that those girls were lured by the gangster "big brother" to go to Fujian and continue to be sold to Taiwan as prostitutes. At this time, she thought back to that strange dream, so she believed even more in the divine power of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

The "Prayer for the Merit of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva" said: "Every day, recite the name "Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva" 1,000 times, persevere for 3 years, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will send the Earth God and the God of Fortune to protect you, so that you will not be brought into harm's way, and your life will be very stable. Concentrate, dress properly, gradually increase your blessings.

tieu_de: 7.7 Quan Thanh defeated the demon god
noi_dung:
7.7 Quan Thanh wins over the evil gods

During the Republic of China, the cities and villages of our country all had gang organizations. During the Qing Dynasty, it was also called the Association of Countrymen, during the Nationalist period it was called Assembly Hall, An Trung people had An Trung Assembly Hall, Hunan people had Hunan Assembly Hall... mainly to protect against being bullied by local people and strangers when an incident occurred. then the guild will intervene. In 1946, the second year of the victorious resistance war, Mr. Ton Vinh Tran, the village chief of the An Trung people's assembly hall, invited my uncle Huynh Hac Ban to paint for them a large painting of the image of Quan Cong. My uncle was a famous artist in the Far South, with a talent for creating cubist figures. After two

The party discussed the painting and the salary. Five days later, when it was completed, the people of the guild saw it and praised the solemnity of the painting and held a party to celebrate the ceremony. While attending the party, my uncle was a bit curious. In the locality, there were many guilds that did not believe in Quan Cong. Only An Trung's guild was willing to pay a high price to paint paintings of the Quan Cong idol. There must be a reason. So when asked, the elder of the Assembly Hall replied: "Quan Cong once saved the people of our entire district, so he told the following story:

- At the end of the Qing Dynasty, Hong Tu Toan and Duong Tu Thanh fought with Qing Dynasty soldiers in An Trung not long ago. In the Far Nam districts, there was an epidemic (infectious disease), only Kinh district did not have any people sick, the reason was because Quan Cong appeared holy and chased away the evil spirits.

- The Elder of the Assembly Hall said: at the southern gate of our district, there is a temple set up to worship Saint Quan Cong. In the temple there is a man who specializes in managing and taking care of the incense and lamps in the temple (called Mr. Chay). One month before the epidemic broke out, one night Saint Quan Cong gave a dream to Mr. Chay and 2 people in the neighboring village and said: "The Holy Spirit is about to come to this district, to avoid living beings from suffering disaster, tomorrow night you must come to my temple to ring the bell, to Supporting divine power, expelling evil spirits, can avoid calamities.
