The next morning, two men in the village without an appointment went to the temple to inform the vegetarian, only to find out that the three people had the same dream. At 11 o'clock that night, the three people suddenly heard the sound of horses running high in the sky and the sound of swords striking, so they immediately rang the bell. In the dead of night, the sword strikes became more fierce. They only saw the idols in the temple sweating like rain. The vegetarian kept wiping with towels and ordered two men in the village to vigorously knock the bell. About an hour later, the sound of needles was heard.

The code gradually disappeared, late at night it became silent again, the three people knelt down to thank the god, the people in the village who were woken up gathered around to ask the reason. Not long after this incident, the whole district had an epidemic. Out of 10 people, only 3 remained. Kinh district was the only one that did not have an epidemic outbreak. Later, people in the village set up a stele engraved with the legend of Quan Cong chasing away evil spirits, which was passed down in the temple. Since then, everyone knows and believes in the miracle of Quan Thanh.

tieu_de: 7.8 Retributions for destroying idols and greed for charity money
noi_dung:
7.8 Retributions for destroying idols and greed for charity money

Beihai town in Guangxi has an ancient temple, called “Pudu Chan Palace”. In 1988, Mr. Chu, the manager of this temple, hired a farmer to carry a carved wooden statue of a god. Because the statue was too large to move, he had to use a saw to cut it into two pieces from the back, then move it away. 10 years later, in 1998, Mr. Chu was hit by a speeding motorbike and was seriously injured, breaking many bones and breaking his back, the broken places were exactly the same as when sawing the idol. After that, Mr. Chu had to be treated for a while before being discharged from the hospital. Next, the farmer also suffered retribution. While he was picking up the rice dumplings, the rice dumplings in the pot clamped a sheet of leaves and when pulled up, splashed boiling water on his face, causing severe burns on half of his face, and his face was also damaged.

From ancient times to the present, the destruction of the statue of Phuc Duc Chanh Than has always encountered bad things. According to our investigation, during the great cultural revolution, none of those who participated in destroying temples and vandalizing Buddha statues had good karma. This is a fact. As long as we go in, investigate, interview, and be a conscientious person, we will definitely confirm that cause and effect are real, not false, and that they do not exist anywhere.

The former "Pho Do Chan Palace" has a manager who often steals money from good men and women who come to make offerings, taking it home to spend on himself.

His retribution is that his two daughters, one is addicted to drugs, the other is a prostitute.

People who go to temples and pagodas to make offerings are usually those who are in trouble or have wishes, have faith in the blessings of the gods and donate money to make offerings, make offerings to overcome disasters and buy blessings. This money should only be used for building temples and pagodas and cultivating or embellishing Buddha statues, or printing and donating scriptures, or helping the single poor and charitable public works. Only doing so can help the person who donates money to achieve their wishes and gain. prove it otherwise, you will face evil consequences. When you steal money to make offerings to the gods to make merit, you must replace the people who wasted their blessings. The ghosts and gods will secretly give your blessings back to the person who donated the offerings, so you will suffer bad luck, endless poverty and bad luck; If your merit and spirit are not enough to compensate for the merit of the person donating money, your body and mind will be weakened and fall ill. In addition, if you violate the strict prohibition of stealing money from all directions, after death you will be pushed into endless hell to suffer.Embezzlement of money donated by temples and pagodas is truly an unreasonable thing. If there are such people, they should quickly repent and improve, especially temple managers and monastics must be especially careful. People who want to make merit and donate money should not be too confused, they should choose the right point to bestow merit to people and solve practical problems. Otherwise, it will harm others and ourselves in vain.

tieu_de: 7.9 Pure Space Dharma masters discuss nourishment
noi_dung:
7.9 Pure Space Dharma Master's Commentary on Provision

Buddhism often says: "A grain of rice from a donor as big as Tuy Nhi Son, the gold will not lead to enlightenment, the heart will be filled with tears." Therefore, how can money be donated to be enjoyed? If the person making the donation has the intention of doing meritorious service, he should receive it, and after receiving it, he must transfer it to the palace for nourishment. An Quang Dharma Master uses his followers' donation money to print prayer books and provide charity relief, bringing the donors' wishes into reality. Just like building a pagoda and establishing a shrine, the people in the pagoda must truly practice with a pure mind for the donors' offerings to have merit.

There are some magicians who, due to being praised and nurtured by their followers, fall into disrepair and later suffer retribution. These followers also have to bear part of the responsibility. Nowadays, some believers make offerings to their entire homes, everything that is good is brought to the palace to be nourished for the shaman. The shaman's life is so happy, the Western world of ecstasy does not want to go anymore - this place is also good! Why do we have to work so hard? Upon attaining Buddhahood, the mind of saving life and death will no longer exist, what a great disaster! If a magician becomes a monk, he no longer has a family. Giving them a house means inviting them to join the family. They have ownership rights and assets. It's gone! They are back like before! So who harmed them like that? The believer killed the magician. Such people do not understand that every day they are destroying the Buddha Dharma and harming the Three Jewels, and they think they can do many meritorious and good deeds. At the end of his life, when he went to hell to meet the King of Hell, he still couldn't tell whether the situation was real or not. What should he do at that time?

The ancient Buddha and his disciples were faithful to the sun. Enjoy the ultimate satisfaction through miserable lives. Young practitioners must endure arduous cultivation. Only "suffering for the sake of the monk" can truly give birth to a righteous mind and a solid heart that transcends this world. You can't bear hardships yourself. When you see others suffering, you should respect them. Don't pull them back. The Buddha only told us to provide food, clothing, medicine (when sick), and basic living items for the shaman, which is enough. If the shaman is truly interested in taking care of the welfare of sentient beings, he should take care of it according to his joy and love to give alms.

For the person who is immobilized by the wind, it is worthy of our efforts to praise and provide care. When I praise these people, they do not give rise to joy; slander them, they do not feel sad, their mood is forever preserved and peaceful, such people are truly praiseworthy. Why? Praising the palace cannot harm them, so we must help praise them and make more people know, the more they will be able to save sentient beings.

tieu_de: CHAPTER 8: GOOD AND EVIL HAVE RESPONSE
noi_dung: CHAPTER 8: GOOD AND EVIL HAVE RESPONSE

tieu_de: 8.1 Mai Lan Phuong's father
noi_dung:
8.1 Mai Lan Phuong's father

A person with a reputation in the theater arts profession is Mai Lan Phuong's father. When he was young, he learned to play the instrument, and after finishing school, he often went to the royal palace to perform. After a few years, he had saved five thousand silver coins, and his family urged him to return home to get married. One day, riding a horse-drawn carriage back to his hometown, while passing through Nanjing, he saw many huts occupied by refugees. Because of the year of drought, hungry and thirsty people flooded in. Seeing the hunger and suffering, his heart was filled with compassion. Compassion arose, he thought in his heart, he had 3,000 taels, if he gave 3,000 taels to help the poor, the remaining 2,000 taels would be enough to get married. So he brought 3,000 taels to aid the poor, but because there were too many poor people, not enough to distribute, the 3,000 taels were used up and there were still too many people asking for help. Mai Quan's heart couldn't bear it, so he gave up the remaining 2,000 taels. The blood money he had accumulated over the past few years was completely wiped out in one day. I feel very relieved, but this time I went back to my hometown to get married and it didn't work out. I thought to myself, I might as well get married in a few years, so I returned to Beijing. His colleagues asked him why he returned so quickly.Mr. Mai Quan recounted the story of giving alms to rescue people, many people said he was stupid. Mai Quan worked another three years before returning home to get married. Because there was a great incident on Earth, God gave him precious children. Mr. Mai Lan Phuong's son is famous all over the world, rich and noble. Although he was not a noble class, his life was full and prosperous, honoring his ancestors and leaving his name for future generations. He and his children were both famous masters in the art world. In fact, God gave him a blessing that was not light.

tieu_de: 8.2 Retributions when Cao Thiet Au brutally raped
noi_dung:
8.2 Retributions when Cao Thiet Au brutally murdered

The reason Cao Thiet Au was famous was not just because she was Khang Sanh's wife, but because she and Khang Sanh were both famous Chinese assassins at that time, both killing crazily. In some matters, she is even more cruel and evil than Khang Sanh. When Cao Thiet Au was alive, he suffered from a special illness.

After Khang Sanh passed away, Cao Thiet Au moved from Beijing to Moc Di Ty Ty Floor No. 22. This house was built specifically for ministerial-level officials to live in. Vuong Quang My and many elderly officials lived here, and were raped by Khang Sanh and Cao Thiet Au.

After Cao Thiet Au moved to this house, she often felt like she was living in a prison because of the people's curses, causing her fear, anxiety, pain, stress and insecurity. She was afraid of knocking on the door, afraid of noise, and even more afraid of people. Especially afraid of the elderly people who had been raped by her, she often had nightmares all day and night, dreaming of many strange and ferocious people wanting to kill her and chase her. Even later, during the day, I saw a ghost coming to demand her life. So, she was very confused. One evening, as soon as her niece entered the house, she immediately knelt down in front of her niece and cried: "Right now, someone wants to take revenge on me, wants to harm me, save me quickly, otherwise I won't be able to live!"

The niece did not feel surprised because in recent years, Cao Thiet Au has been like crazy, talking nonsense, saying things, doing nonsense things and it has been an everyday thing, and besides increasingly serious... In 1991, she ended her life in confusion and fear.

This is the sick Cao Thiet Au at the end of his life. That is, after

When he lost all power, Cao Thiet Au spent the last time of his life in a situation of being criticized by thousands of people and cursed by thousands of people.

Cao Thiet Au and Khang Sanh's method of punishing people was that whoever's literature meant to slander and falsify the truth would be handled criminally.

tieu_de: 8.3 A ferocious person turns into a pig to pay off his debt to the world
noi_dung:
8.3 Ferocious people turn into pigs to pay off their debts to the world

In a certain province in Du Thieu, Triet Giang, there was a butcher named Ton. On Tet holidays, people often invited him to slaughter pigs. When he took refuge in Buddhism and learned that killing is a serious sin, he no longer slaughtered pigs for others. By the end of the year, the relative insisted on asking him to perform surgery. Just because of the emotional awkwardness, he had to slaughter two more pigs. In March of the following year, one night, Mr. Ton defecated behind the house and saw a group of people coming from afar. There were seven men and eight women all tied up as if they were being escorted. In addition, there were some people holding guns. Running closer, Mr. Ton saw there was a man he knew, a tycoon from ten miles from the village. This person colludes with bandits, bullies and oppresses wealth, there is nothing evil that he does not do. Mr. Ton thought to himself, he may have been captured by the soldiers, it's okay to be tied up. Slowly walking home, I only heard that group of people keep going in the direction of the house next door selling groceries. Listening from the wall, I only felt the noise of people making noise, the house lights were bright, I listened for a while then it quieted down. Mr. Ton woke up before dawn, went out to the grocery store, and waited nearly half a day to see the store door open.Mr. Ton asked, what happened to your house yesterday that caused so many prisoners to come to your house. This homeowner said no one came to my house yesterday but my pig gave birth to more than ten piglets. Mr. Ton said: "I also saw that evil tyrant tied up in there." The other boss said: "You must have seen a ghost. That evil boss was shot dead last month." Mr. Ton was so scared, he went to the pig pen and saw 7 male pigs and 8 female pigs, consistent with the number of people he saw yesterday. Mr. Ton was so scared that he ran to the Buddha Hall to repent and swear to become a vegetarian. Later I learned that when he was still alive, he often went to that grocery store to collect bribes, so after he died, he had to reincarnate in that house to pay his debt.

tieu_de: 8.4 Wisdom trumps merit
noi_dung:
8.4 Wisdom trumps merit

In the year of Shuntri during the Qing Dynasty, in Thuan Nghia district, Beijing, there was a large family of the Cung family, with hundreds of acres of land and a herd of horses and donkeys. When they were middle-aged, they gave birth to a son, named Khanh Huu. During this time, Mr. Ly, who worked as a butler and managed tenant farming for the Cung family, also gave birth to a son, named Ly Phuc. When Cung Khanh was 7 years old, Mr. Cung invited a tutor to teach his son. Butler Ly saw that Mr. Cung's son was studying books, so he begged Mr. Cung to let his son study with Mr. Cung Khanh, and Mr. Cung agreed. The days passed quickly, when Ly Phuc was 14 years old, he and Cung Khanh stayed at the academy, that is, they studied together during the day and slept together at night.One night, Ly Phuc was sleeping soundly, dreaming that a large gate opened in the sky, two gods descended from the sky, landing right in the academy, one god pointed his finger at Cung Khanh Huu, and the other god said: "What is he like?" The other god said: "He is a blessed person. At the age of 17, he passed the baccalaureate degree, and at the age of 19, he passed the bachelor's degree. In the future, he will be promoted to second-class rank and enjoy glory and wealth throughout his life." The god pointed at Ly Phuc and asked the other god: "What about you?" The other god said: "This person is destined to suffer without fame and fortune, and is destined to be poor for the rest of his life." Having finished speaking, the two gods flew back to heaven. After the two gods entered the heavenly gate, the heavenly gate closed as before. Ly Phuc woke up, felt strange, and immediately told his parents and others about the dream .

Wait until Khanh Huu was 17 years old, and indeed passed the baccalaureate exam, at this time

Ly Phuc is no longer studying. The family had land, although Ly Phuc farmed, he always paid attention to Khanh Huu's behavior. He saw that Khanh Huu was domineering, always doing evil things, cruel and abusive, not good at all. After Khanh Huu passed the baccalaureate exam and continued to advance, he was actually promoted to a second-class official. But Khanh Huu, as an official, was corrupt, cruel to people, and beat honest people. Khanh Huu's behavior, Ly Phuc considered it a crime in his heart, felt that Khanh Huu would later suffer retribution. Who would have thought that Khanh Huu would live to the age of 71 and still be talented and prosperous, with children and grandchildren filling the house. Not only that, Khanh Huu can also know when he will die. Before he dies, he tells his son how to take care of his funeral. But Ly Phuc's behavior is completely different from Khanh Huu's. Ly Phuc lives very frugally, treats people very carefully, is good and does not do evil. For a cruel person like Khanh Huu, he can enjoy blessings for life, even knowing the day he will die. He felt dissatisfied in his heart, feeling that there was also bribery in the underworld, determined to go with Khanh Huu to Diem Phu to find out the truth.So he told his son that he would die on that day and prepare to take care of his future. Mr. Ly Phuc wanted to go with Khanh Huu to the underworld to see what it was like, so he had to see it clearly. Ly Phuc told his son when he died, not because he knew the date and time of his death, but because he bought a package of poison. If Khanh Huu really died on the day he said, he would drink poison to die and follow Khanh Huu to the underworld to meet the King of Hell. Unexpectedly, Khanh Huu actually died that day. Mr. Ly Phuc also drank poison and died in order to go to the underworld in time to see the King of Hell come out to welcome Khanh Huu. After the King of Hell finished handling Khanh Huu's work, he went out to meet Ly Phuc and said: "Why did you come?" Ly Phuc

answered: "I came down here because of Khanh Huu. On earth, people are afraid of power and respect the rulers. Why should the King of Hell in the underworld also be afraid of power and wealth? I think Mr. Khanh Huu lives on earth, is cruel and cruel, does evil things ten thousand times over. While on earth, he did not have to suffer evil retribution. When he came to the underworld, he must have suffered punishment. Unexpectedly, the world and the underworld were the same."

The King of Hell said: "Please wait a moment and you will understand." The King of Hell ordered the judge to open the book of good and evil birth and death to see that there was a line of words above Cung Khanh Huu's name. The King of Hell said: "Because Khanh Huu did a lot of great good deeds in his previous life, in this life, although he did evil and consumed a lot of the good deeds of his previous life, he still has a lot of great good deeds left over. He will still receive blessings in his next life, but not as great as in his previous life. With the evil deeds he did, he has not yet reached the maturity stage. Because you did not do good deeds in your previous life, Ly Phuc, you will have to suffer in this life. But because you are enlightened and single-mindedly do good deeds, that's why. Although you live in this world and do not enjoy blessings, you do not lack anything in clothing. When you move to the next life, you will enjoy great blessings." Ly Phuc begged the King of Hell when he reincarnated to not let him drink the bewitching water, so that in his next life he could see the results of Khanh Huu's actions. The King of Hell agreed to Ly Phuc's request.

 Ly Phuc followed Khanh Huu to reincarnate. Because he had not yet drunk the enchanting water, he knew everything and learned that Khanh Huu was reincarnated into a wealthy family. He was reincarnated into an average family, still practicing good deeds. Khanh Huu later grew up and became a district chief, still cruel to the people, completely without the slightest sadness, relying on power to corrupt, swindle and become robbers. Because of forced confession, two people's eyes were gouged out; Because of a case, he was cut in half

someone else's leg, Khanh Huu lived to be seventy years old, got sick and passed away. Because Ly Phuc had the wisdom to practice compassion, he had cultivated to the point where his soul could go to the underworld. Ly Phuc meditated, at this time, he saw Khanh Huu after death, his soul followed Khanh Huu down to meet the King of Hell. This time was different from before, the King of Hell followed Ly Phuc first and then executed Khanh Huu. When I saw Khanh Huu's name in the book, the good fortune was completely exhausted. When he was a mandarin, gouging out people's eyes, cutting off other people's legs, these two things, he could only use his body to repay the debt, it was decided that Khanh Huu was reincarnated in his next life into a poor family, his eyes were blind, his legs were disabled, every day he went out on the street to beg, suffering unimaginably. When Ly Phuc saw that Khanh Huu had the retribution of three lifetimes, he was afraid of losing his nature and having to live in reincarnation, so he persevered in practicing, helping others, and finally achieved his merit, achieved the right result, forever escaping the suffering of reincarnation.

tieu_de: 8.5 Being unfilial to one's mother, one gets bitten by a snake and dies
noi_dung:
8.5 Unfilial to mother, bitten to death by snake

Vinh Phuc district in Guangxi, in Dai Tan hamlet, there was a man named Quy, 24 years old this year, with a very fierce personality, everyone in the village was very afraid of him. On March 17, 1998, after Mr. Quy finished gambling and returned home, his mother only scolded him a few times, then suddenly he became angry, picked up a stick to beat his mother, beat her until she was bruised and bleeding profusely, and burst into tears. His mother said: "You are an ungrateful child. If you don't get run over by a car, you will be bitten to death by a snake." Neighbors came over to take his mother to the emergency hospital to escape danger.

On August 27, Mr. Quy went to Tam Hoang village for work. After having a full stomach, the ghost suddenly guided him to a snake shop. He used his hand to knock on the fence in the snake basket. Unexpectedly, the snake aimed at his thumb and bit him. At that time, he only felt an itch.

okay. An hour later, he felt his throat was dry and his face was dizzy. He immediately went to the hospital for treatment. The doctor gave him intravenous fluids, but the effect was not very good. He felt it was ineffective, so he pulled out the IV needle and left to find another way to treat it. At 7 p.m., he felt his heart ache, his eyes flashed, he staggered into the hospital, but it was late at night, and at 9:10 p.m., he died. Just as the mother's words were fulfilled. People in the village felt very scared.

tieu_de: 8.6 Abuse of mother, lightning strikes husband and wife
noi_dung:
8.6 Abuse of mother, lightning strikes husband and wife

In Ha Quang Minh Son town, Lien Ninh village, there was a farmer named Vuong Tu Thinh, who lost his father at the age of three, and was raised into a man by his industrious mother. In the year 60, the government sent him to the iron and steel factory to work as a worker in Phu Dung. At that time, he was a government servant. The village felt very proud. After getting married and having children, the couple went to work. There was no one to take care of the children and cook, so they brought in the mother from the village to take care of the children and cook. Having a "nanny" and not having to pay her wages, they should have treated each other in harmony, to comfort the mother at the end of her life. Who would have thought that after getting married, he would forget his mother, the wife would not treat her mother-in-law well, and the son would listen to his wife and mistreat his old mother. If they don't "take care of" their child and daughter-in-law as expected, they will be scolded and beaten. Over the past five months, the mother could not bear it anymore and said: "If I am so miserable, I would rather die." The bride said: "Can you die? If you really die, I will take your meat to the market to sell", daring to say unfilial things to her mother-in-law, showing how she normally mistreats her.On a dark night, with pouring rain and wind, lightning thundering loudly, a ray of red light flashed through the window, with a loud "swoosh", lightning struck the couple, at that time there were a total of five people in the room from three generations; Vuong Tu Thuan, the couple slept on two sides, in the middle was the old mother and grandchild, both of whom were unharmed! Heavenly thunder hits people, but the strike is so precise. This was a story in 1964, everyone in the village knew it.

tieu_de: 8.7 Arrogant and cruel, evil results in tragic death
noi_dung:
8.7 Arrogant and cruel, cruel and cruel death

Mr. Vuong Mau is a government employee in Hien District City, an office official, relying on his pen to handle lawsuits on his behalf, taking advantage of his position to extort money. However, every time he earned a fortune from an unjust act, he was bound to have another unexpected incident that consumed all of that money, so it was not as good as heaven's calculation.

 There is a Thanh Hoang temple here, in which there is a young monk. One night, while passing through the hallway, I suddenly heard the sound of an abacus and people talking, so I stopped to listen. Among them, one person said: "Mr. Vuong Mau has really collected a lot of money this year, find a way to spend it!" Another person said: "There is no need to think too much to make him tired, just one Thuy Van is enough to make him tired."

In Thanh Hoang temple, it is often said that there are ghosts, so the young monk is used to it, not afraid of anything. It's just that those two people mentioned the name Thuy Van, who is she and what kind of person she is?

Not long ago, at the Lau Xanh restaurant in Hien District city, there was a new flower seller named Thuy Van. The mandarin was so fascinated by Thuy Van's beauty that he lost his soul, and the money he earned from dishonest work was about to consume 70 to 80% of that girl's body. Later, he was also infected with malignant gonorrhea. He invited doctors to find medicine to treat him, but he still couldn't cure it, and all his accumulated assets were destroyed.

Someone calculated a calculation for Mr. Vuong, calculated from the money he got from extortion and corruption, about thirty or forty thousand taels. But later, he suffered a serious illness and suddenly passed away. He did not even have the money to buy a box.

8. 8 The financial line is not stable, the children and grandchildren are scattered

Mr. Duong Quy Dinh said: "In his hometown, there was a great mandarin who returned to the village with glory after completing his term of office, closed the door to say goodbye to guests, and did not pay attention to anything unrelated to him. He was content to enjoy and be happy with the life of seclusion. Only when thinking about old age and having no children or grandchildren, his heart became sad. Not long after, his wife gave birth to a son. The couple is very happy, they are considered treasures in life, they love them wholeheartedly.

Later, the son fell ill and his life was in danger, making the old couple deeply worried. He heard that in Du Son there was a Taoist fortune teller who could predict the future, so he personally came to worship and ask. After the Taoist finished listening to his request, he just smiled and said: "Your precious son still has many things to do, how could he die so early?", he heard the sadness in his heart, not knowing if it was a good thing or a bad thing. Going home to invite a famous doctor, he unexpectedly cured his son's illness.

This young man grew up and matured, with an arrogant and indolent personality, depraved behavior, gambling and all kinds of things, not lacking anything, and soon destroyed all the fortune his father left behind. Later, when he lost his home and property, he had to send his body to a foreign country, like a sad ghost and ghost, wandering in all directions with no one to worship him.

The people in the village discussed and said: "This old man did not do evil, why did he give birth to this depraved child? Thinking back, he was just a poor scholar. When he became a mandarin, his term of office was less than 10 years, and suddenly he became a billionaire. So, in his heart, he became a mandarin, what path made him rich, need to be detailed? So to have such a retribution, is also reasonable and reasonable." The ancients said: "If you use illegal methods to earn money, it won't last long, that's what it means."

tieu_de: 8.9 Respect without worry, be a righteous official
noi_dung:
8.9 Respect without worry, be a righteous official

Mr. Quan To Tien in Bac Xuyen, one day had a dream, dreaming of going down to Diem Palace, seeing the King of Hell holding a trial in the underworld.

Mr. Quan To Tien saw an old woman from a neighboring village being led to the front of the hall. King Yama's ​​face became serious. He stood up, walked to the old woman, greeted her, invited her to sit, and asked someone to pour her some water. After that, he again ordered the judge and said: "Take her to the blessed place of reincarnation."

Mr. Quan To Tien quietly asked the mandarin standing next to him: "What merit did this old woman do when she was alive that the King of Hell favored her so much?"

The mandarin of Diem Palace said: "This old woman's merit is that throughout her life she has never had the heart to harm a selfish person. Almost everyone has the heart to harm a selfish person, whether they are a learned tutor, a monk or an official, it cannot be avoided. When people have this heart, they will harm others more or less. Therefore, many fraudulent tricks arise; many unjust crimes come from that, and even cause scandals. All of these things are caused by people who have a selfish heart to harm others, and this old woman has tried all her life to control her heart, not to harm others, not to do anything for her own benefit that harms others. Compared to the old woman's virtues, Confucian scholars and officials who are always full of Confucianism and have evil thoughts in their minds, there will be no room for them to be treated politely by the King of Hell! Old lady, is there anything too much?"

Mr. To Tien recalled and said: "Before this old lady was brought up to college

There was a man in a mandarin's uniform, boldly walking up the hall. This person said to the King of Hell: "Since I became a mandarin until now, I have only gone to every place to drink a cup of tea, without any acts of embezzlement or bribery. Now standing in front of gods or ghosts, I can have no regrets!" looks popular. Even the petty officials who only guard traffic lights and manage water towers are all greedy for money. If you don't have a bit of greed for money and don't play around, you're a big mandarin. Like that, setting up a wooden man in the mandarin's palace, even a cup of tea is better than drinking it, isn't it better than a big brother like you?

The King of Hell said: "All your life you only seek perfection for yourself, but you don't worry about the interests of the country, the locality and the people. All the cases, you just avoid for fear of being implicated and suspected, not daring to stand up and argue. Isn't that harmful to the people? When it comes to tax evasion, you don't revolutionize and improve it, but you're also afraid of causing trouble for yourself, increasing the amount of work, you're afraid of taking on great responsibility, and deliberately don't do it. Like So, wasn't it harmful to the country? Three years ago, when taking the exam, where was your integrity? You must know, if you are an official, doing nothing is wrong! considered a good mandarin of the third or fourth class. Don't worry, you can still be an official in your next life!" Immediately he waved his hand and ordered the demon soldiers to take him to the tenth palace to meet Samsara King to be reincarnated.

tieu_de: 8.10 Slandering a pure person will result in no good fortune for your descendants
noi_dung:
8.10 Slandering innocent people, descendants have no luck

In Ham Phong, there was a man with the surname Hoang, a man from Guizhou, who took the position of a doctor and held the position of chief administrative officer in Tieu Ninh district.

After taking charge, every time I sit in the chair to handle a lawsuit, I say: "In my previous life, in the year of Gia Khanh, I held the position of chief administrative officer in Tieu Ninh district. There was a rural woman infected with abdominal distention and fluid retention. Her husband, suspected of having an affair, became pregnant and reported it to the district magistrate. At that time, I was handling this case. Misunderstanding the gardener's words, I questioned her if she was pregnant, embarrassed her, and took out a knife. He slashed his stomach and died." Every time Mr. Hoang went to work, he would bewildered and say such words. Wait until the documents are processed and then wake up as usual. His subordinates were all very surprised, so they secretly asked the clerk to investigate the truth. An elderly clerical man, after completing his investigation, said: "That's not wrong! This story happened in the year of Gia Khanh. When I was young, I worked as a clerk for the administrative office in court, arranged documents, and witnessed this with my own eyes. I have reviewed this case, and it matches every sentence Mr. Hoang said when he was on trial."

 At that time, this story reached the ears of the chief officer. He heard that this unjust case was too thrilling. At the same time, he felt sorry for his talented youth, so he ordered the mandarin (mandarin's warden) to replace her to mediate, allowing her to publish her honorary virginity in the newspaper. At the same time, ask Mr. Hoang to build an altar and worship her for the rest of his life. After the story was over, there was a time when the sad soul of the village girl entered Mr. Hoang's body and said: "In the underworld, there is a lot of emphasis on chastity and filial piety. Mr. Hoang has had a doctorate in three generations, and now he has one.

If you have passed the doctoral exam, you can still pass the doctoral exam in the next life. Because he paid great attention to filial piety throughout his life, he did not take away his life, but only reduced his blessings. Otherwise, based on the crime of mistrial, he must die unjustly on the street. I follow the criminal law under Diem Palace, and cannot absolve Mr. Hoang of his crime." After listening to the official, he couldn't say anything. Later, Mr. Hoang indeed had to resign due to changing his teaching position and return to his hometown to try to do good deeds to cultivate blessings for the next life. Just because of the unjust trial of a woman's case, even in her third generation, even if she passes the doctorate exam, she will not be able to enjoy the blessings and blessings. Luckily, Mr. Hoang was usually very filial and respectful to his parents, so he was able to avoid suffering a disaster and having to die in an accident. If Mr. Hoang was not filial and encountered retribution for the crime of his previous life, could he still be alive today? The village girl's in-laws slandered her and the bribe-taking gardener acted as a false witness. Maybe, you will also have to suffer very serious retribution.

tieu_de: 8.11 Obstructing people from seeking rebirth and reincarnating as pigs to receive retribution
noi_dung:
8.11 Obstructing people from praying for rebirth, reincarnating as pigs to pay back

A silk shop in Hangzhou, established for more than ten years. The owner is over 50 years old but has a dishonest heart. One year, there was a fire here, and the silk shop was also involved. Behind the shop there is a poor apartment, the family of three, doing laundry for a living, must go through the side of the silk shop to get in and out. When the fire spread through the poor family's house, the family of three used force to knock on the side door of the fabric store and shouted: "Open the door, open the door!", hoping to escape through the side door to save their lives. Unexpectedly, the owner of the fabric shop wanted to conveniently move and move his property. Have someone forcefully block the door and not open it. By the time the goods were finished, the fire had already gone out, and the poor man's entire family was burned to death in a sea of ​​flames. After a year, the owner of the fabric shop suddenly passed away. One night, he told his son in a dream and said: "I killed the entire poor family, Diem Palace

does not allow me to reincarnate as a human but forces me to reincarnate as a pig. I have now reincarnated into a farm where a family has a herd of pigs giving birth, a total of 4 piglets, on the pig's body there is a dot that means I was reincarnated, you can go to that farmer's house and ask to buy me to take home to raise, to avoid being slaughtered. The pig was born a few days ago, and there was a pig with black spots. When the piglet saw his son coming, he screamed and showed a pitiful face. The son spent money to buy the pig to take home and raise it. In addition, he prepared a room to take care of it and hired someone to take care of it every day and use high-quality food to feed it, just like when his father was alive, he loved to smoke and drink alcohol, so his son always gave him medicine. alcohol, served to pigs, every meal he drank until his face turned red. When he smoked, the worker put the cigarette in his mouth and swallowed it like crazy.So after a few years, the pig came to his son in a dream and said: "While I was alive, I committed a thousand lifetimes of crime. When I died, I was reincarnated as an immoral animal. If I continue to enjoy myself like a person living on earth, it will only increase my sins. From now on, there is no need to bring cigarettes or alcohol, and you should not hire anyone to take care of me. Just feed me with food." There was no one in the city who didn't know about this happening. This information was broadcast on the media in the 17th year of the Republic of China (1928), on April 1, in News Newspaper (China), page 6, with Tieu Son Wei recording this story.

tieu_de: 8.12 Conscience is heavenly reason
noi_dung:
8.12 Conscience is heaven

 During the Song Dynasty, there was a man named Wang Chao, who was talented and strong. For the sake of his reputation, he reported to the court to request troops to occupy the territory of Khoan Cuong and advance to Cam Tieu, killing many people along the way. Later, he was honored as an officer. But for some reason, he felt uneasy in his heart. One day he went to Cam Lo Tu, met nobleman Tieu Canh Thuan, he asked: "Is it a crime to issue a king's law to kill people?" Answer: "First of all, you should not ask whether you are guilty or innocent, you just need to know whether you can pass your heart or not." Vuong Sieu said again: "Passed." Tieu Canh Thuan said: "If you can pass, you don't need to come and ask me. Looking back, I feel like I can't pass your heart!" Later, when Vuong Tieu got sick, he used his hands to cover his eyes when he was scared and asked him to let go of his hands to eat or take medicine. He often said: "I can't open it. I have so many headless and legless people standing in front of me!" These people are all ghosts and demons, and he previously ordered them to be killed. At this time, I discovered, "The mind cannot be raped, ghosts and gods cannot be raped!"

Some people believe that following the directives or policies of the State causes dishonest cause and effect. The executor should not be forced to bear the burden but should be left to the person who issued the policy. It seems that there is a certain morality. But we must see if the person executing the order is following the issued orders or abusing their power to disrupt policies, and see if there is corruption or unruly ordinances. There are people who take advantage of their position of authority, borrow the policies and instructions of their superiors, oppress the good people, form parties and divide factions... If so, they will definitely have to suffer karma. Conscience means heavenly reason! The mind is the spirit, the spirit is the mind, if you deceive the mind, then you deceive the spirit. As an official, you must ask yourself, is it harming others to benefit yourself? Is it fake private work? Can you overcome your conscience? Then the consequences of good and evil will be understood.

tieu_de: 8.13 Receiving bribes unjustly causes your children and grandchildren to be mean
noi_dung:
8.13 Receiving bribes unfairly, poor descendants

Du Tan, in Giang Am district, has a reputation near and far. In the Qianlong year of the Qing Dynasty, he participated in the bachelor's exam. He had not done the homework yet. He gathered his belongings and went out. His face was pale and depressed. Another candidate went to the same exam.

According to him, after many visits to find out the reason, he said: "My father had been a mandarin for half his life and just retired. When he was about to die, he called my four brothers to his side, cried and advised: "I have not done anything unscrupulous while alive in this world. It's just that when I was a district chief, I once accepted two thousand taels of gold in bribe money and unjustly killed two prisoners. Last night, my soul went down to Diem Phu to compare the case. Legally speaking, I should have been extinct. Because a great-grandfather once saved a drowning person, he earned merit and was able to leave behind a son who continued the line for five generations, but he had to endure poverty all his life. I cannot avoid being punished in hell. If I still have false thoughts that my children and grandchildren will have fame and fortune, it will only add to my sins, which is a great lack of filial piety." Having finished speaking, he stopped breathing. Later, several of our brothers passed away, leaving me alone. Twice before, I participated in the exam in the village. During the exam, I suddenly soiled the exam questions (at that time, the National Law stipulated that if the exam questions were dirty, the invigilator would not look at or approve the exam questions, so it was considered that I did not have an exam).Yesterday, at midnight, on the third watch, I suddenly saw my father lift the curtain and say in a reproachful tone: "You have not done things to accumulate merit and transfer merit to heaven so that I can reduce my crime, and you have also violated the will's instructions, causing me to now have to travel to all directions, and my crime is even worse." Having finished speaking, use the handcuff tool in your hand to extinguish the candle. I, my lord Ton Son, cannot bear it. I only regret that I let my father hold his hatred and be imprisoned in the underworld. I will go to the mountain to become a monk, learn the filial conduct of Muc Lien to save my mother", everyone heard, everyone was surprised to the point of speechless. In the same room, there was a candidate named Tran Ho Thanh, who composed a poem "Quy Son" for him.

tieu_de: 8.14 The consequences of good and evil in measuring and measuring wrongly
noi_dung:
8.14 The good and evil retributions of time and error

This event occurred at the end of the Qing Dynasty year in the Long Canh household in Kinh Dong, there was an old man named Thoi Duc Phuong, yesterday

he lived a very happy life, people were prosperous, prosperous, full of prosperity, he had three sons, all married.

On the day of the old man's 60th birthday, he called his three sons in front of him and said: "Children, listen, in the past I started a business with nothing, to gain the current fortune. I started my family with just a heartless scale, this scale had mercury in it. When my family bought it, I could buy 20 taels and calculate it as a kilo (Note: China at this time counted 16 taels as 1 kg). 1 kilo), when my house was sold, it was possible to calculate 14 taels into 1 kilo. Twenty years ago, I bought several thousand kilos of cotton, each kilo cost more than 4 taels, the cotton seller lost a lot of money, got angry and died of typhoid. For this, I was very regretful and there was also a traditional medicine seller who was also angry to death You stand before me, I will destroy this scale, from now on, do good from evil."

The three sons who heard it all said: "Father, you should have done that."

After the old man destroyed that heartless scale, from then on he changed evil and did good, loving to give alms. Unexpectedly, since the old man's grandfather destroyed the scale and started doing good deeds, many unfortunate things happened to his family. In less than a month, his eldest son became seriously ill and passed away, and his eldest daughter-in-law married another man; After the old man finished taking care of his eldest son's affairs, his second son suddenly fell ill and passed away, and his second daughter-in-law also married another man; The old man's grandmother had just finished taking care of his second son's affairs, and the third son was the same. The third daughter-in-law was pregnant so she didn't take any more steps. The family's constant mourning made Thoi Duc Phuong very sad. He told people: "My big scale turned into a small scale. I cheated and got a house full of children and grandchildren, the family prospered. Now I accumulate virtue and good deeds and bring mourning to my family, so is cause and effect really good?", the neighbors heard it and said that heaven has no eyes.

On this day, the third daughter-in-law was about to give birth. For some reason, after 3 days and 3 nights, she still could not give birth. Inviting so many midwives to deliver the baby was ineffective. Some people said that you should keep the mother and then leave the child, others said that you should keep the child and lose the mother. Mr. Thoi thought that his family was full of bad luck at this time, and his heart became even more sad.

While confused, a monk came to the door of destiny. The old butler came out of the house and said: "Great Master, if you want to change your fate, please go somewhere else. My aunt Ba has been in labor for three days and three nights and still hasn't given birth. My master is sad and has no mood to receive you. The monks are ungrateful and won't give alms." The monk said: "It's okay, you didn't report to the old man of your house. I have a spirit medicine to induce birth, drink it and give birth immediately."

The butler heard it, did not dare to delay, quickly went to report to the head of the house, after hearing it, he quickly invited the monk into the house.

He invited the monk into the study room, then asked the master where he lived. The monk said: "I am a sociable person, there is no fixed place, wherever there is fate, I go there."

After that, the monk took out the medicine. Grandmother Cui immediately asked someone to take her to the delivery room and continued talking with the monk. While we were talking, someone came to report and said that after taking the monk's medicine, the third daughter-in-law gave birth to a son. After Cui Duc Phuong heard that he had a grandchild, he was very happy and said to the monk: "The Sangha is truly a god." Having finished speaking, he immediately ordered his servants to make a party to celebrate.

After the party was finished, Mr. Thoi invited the monk to join the party. During the banquet, the old man from the outside said: "Monk Sangha, I have something unclear, I want to ask Sangha Sangha."

Cui Phuong Duc said: "I had a scale that had no heart to do evil and started a business. A few months ago, I canceled that scale, determined to change evil and do good, but I don't understand why in less than half a year, all three of my sons passed away, two daughter-in-laws remarried to other people, this third daughter-in-law gave birth to a grandson for me, fortunately I I don't understand, why do I have to suffer such bad consequences for doing good?

The monk laughed and said: "You don't need to think too much, I tell you, your eldest son is a merchant who sells traditional medicine. If you harm him, he will be reincarnated as your son and come to collect your debt; the second son is to ruin your family, the third son is to bring you great disaster. When you reach old age, you will be sick, suffer from pain and starve and die, but because you have changed evil and done good, God has eyes and has taken back 3 His son was considered the best good man."

After Cui Duc Phuong heard it, he seemed to wake up from a dream and said: "Thank you, holy monk, for your advice, now I have a grandchild, can I raise him?" The monk said: "This grandson of yours will bring glory to his family and ancestors and change the temple." When Cui Duc Phuong heard it, he was very happy. The monk said again: "Cui Vien Dai, do you know why the scale must use 16 taels?" Thoi Duc Phuong said: "I pray to listen to the saintly monk's advice." The Venerable said: "These 16 taels represent the North Dau Seven Stars, the South Dau Six Stars, in addition to increasing blessings and fortune, receiving Three Stars. Therefore, if you give one tael less to someone, you will lose blessings, if you miss 2 taels, you will lose fortune, if you miss 3 taels, you will lose life. The less you give to others, the more harm you will do to yourself. Think about it, how much karma has an evil scale caused?"

Mr. Thoi Duc Phuong listened. Okay, I felt like I was breaking out in a cold sweat, and once again thanked the monk for his guidance. From then on, he believed in the distinction between good and evil retributions, without any hesitation.

tieu_de: 8.15 Suffering the retribution of paralysis for unjustly judging an innocent person:
noi_dung:
8.15 Suffering the retribution of paralysis for unjustly judging an innocent person:

(This story is excerpted from the book "Hell's Manifestations" by Living Buddha Lu Shengyan)

There was a (Taiwanese) official in a wheelchair who came to see me. He said:

"For some reason, my legs suddenly didn't have any feeling at all, completely helpless?"

I asked: "Have you been to the hospital for a check-up?"

Minh Vuong said: "I don't have any solution. But since you asked, thanks to your mighty power, the dead person will be reincarnated, the injustice of the dead will automatically be resolved. The second day, the officer came back to see me, and I told him that the suspect had committed suicide. This official was startled after hearing this. Sure enough, there was this story, it was true: "Fear of crime, so he committed suicide." This official expressed remorse. I told the official that I would of course help the dead to relieve their injustice, but the official had to print 5,000 good books and recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra 49 times. This official said that it was strange that, on the day the book was finished printing, the printer informed him that it had been printed and the entire book had been bound. The official got down from the wheelchair, took the first step, then slowly adjusted and finally his legs were completely restored to normal. tieu_de: 8.16 Virtue wins numbers
noi_dung:
8.16 Virtue overcomes numbers

During the Northern Song Dynasty, in a certain village, there was a disabled boy about ten years old, with a broken leg, living a poor life as a beggar. In front of the village was a large stream. Because there was no bridge, villagers had to wade if they wanted to cross the stream, which was very inconvenient, especially for the elderly during the flood season. Many years passed like that, until one day people saw a crippled beggar boy gathering rocks by the stream. “I want to build a bridge so people can travel conveniently,” he explained. The villagers thought it was a funny story of a crazy boy, so they didn't pay attention.

But the pile of rocks gradually grew over the years to become a mound, and the villagers began to understand. Many people also contributed, and soon there was enough stone to build the bridge. Then they hired a construction worker. During the process, the boy got a stone fragment in his eye and lost both eyes. People felt very sorry for him. But the boy, even though he was crippled and blind, still did not complain and tried his best to help build bridges with the villagers.

Finally, after months of hard work, the bridge was completed. Even though he couldn't see anything, a bright smile appeared on his face. Suddenly, a thunderclap rang out even though the sky was clear and cloudy. And it was found that the poor beggar boy had been struck by lightning and died right on the newly built bridge. At that time, Bao Cong went to inspect the village. The villagers came out to complain to Bao Cong, asking why the blue sky harms good people. Faced with a story that was so pitiful, and feeling so unfair, Bao Thanh Thien couldn't hold back his heart, so he wrote "宁行恶勿行善" (Ning the evil and the good: it's better to do evil than to do good).

Returning to the capital after the trip, Bao Cong felt uncomfortable, especially about what he wrote when he couldn't control his feelings. In his report, he did not report to the Emperor about that rare event. That day, the Emperor invited Bao Cong to visit and took Bao Cong to meet the newly born prince while Bao Cong went to inspect the province. The prince looks handsome but has a habit of crying all day. The Emperor also wanted to ask Bao Cong if there was a way to stop the prince from crying.

Bao Cong saw that the prince's skin was white and smooth, and there seemed to be a line of words in his palm. If you look closely, it's "宁行恶勿行善" (Ning of evil things and good things: it's better to do evil than to do good). Too surprised and embarrassed, Bao Cong used his hand to erase it, and strangely, as soon as he swiped it, the text disappeared. The prince stopped crying immediately.

The Emperor was very surprised and asked why that was so. Bao Cong knelt down in fear and told the whole story, and asked the Emperor to forgive him for not reporting this matter in his report. The Emperor then ordered Bao Cong to investigate the matter clearly. That night, Bao Cong laid his head on the "yin and yang underworld" pillow and immediately in his dream went to the underworld. The King of Hell told him that a few lifetimes ago, that prince had committed great evil deeds, so God had arranged to repay that evil karma in three lifetimes:

The first generation was crippled, the second generation was blind, and the third generation was struck by lightning and died. But when he was crippled and begging for food, the boy always did good deeds for others, so God shortened the time to repay his karma and made the beggar boy blind. After going blind, the boy not only did not complain about anyone but always did good for others. For that reason, the Gods arranged once again for the boy to pay off all his karma in one lifetime.

The King of Hell told Bao Cong: "One life pays off all the karma for three generations, and can also be reincarnated as the reigning Crown Prince, enjoying the blessings of the Son of Heaven." Good deeds should be done, evil deeds should be avoided. How good! How good! "Virtue overcomes fate" that's it!

tieu_de: 9.3 Please do not harm the fetus

(Excerpted from the book “Records of Hell's Transformation” by Lien Sanh Phat Lu Thang Ngan).

Personally, I advocate: “Please do not have an abortion.” Because life is not easy to obtain, and people have no right to kill or harm the fetus. Pregnant women do not have the right to abortion. Doctors also do not have the right to perform abortions. There are some governments that legalize abortion, but from a religious standpoint, we absolutely do not approve of abortion. There are also doctors who believe that fetuses born with monstrous or evil shapes or with incurable diseases or congenital genetic disorders, once born, will be a waste of money for society. So what to do?

To curate or not to curate?

My answer is still resolutely "No". Because in the underworld, I witnessed many "fetal spirits" (souls of fetuses), commonly called "water death spirits", gathering in front of Minh Vuong and crying pitifully. “Thuy Tu Linh” (soul of an aborted baby) cried loudly!

Minh Vuong said:

"People in the world do not know, arbitrarily abort, and do not cherish the life of the fetus. Because they like to live alone or use excuses, do not take on the responsibility of raising them. Now I command you to cling to your parents' bodies, find an opportunity to ask them to return their lives."

I heard Minh Vuong say that, and I could not help but worry and worry. Just as I know: There was a woman who had two abortions. These two fates clung to the mother's body and grew two cancerous tumors right in the ovary. This woman came to me for help.

I knew about this cause and effect, so I especially encouraged her to place a tablet "Thuy Tu Linh" (worshiping children who died while still in the mother's womb) at Cai Hong Son Trang. I taught her "Seven Buddhas to Kill Sins", advising her to recite every day.

Later, following the two cancerous tumors, I learned that they slowly got smaller and shrunk until they were no longer visible! The kind of things just mentioned above keep happening, and there's no end to it. I discovered a great connection between the tumors on a person's body that appear for no reason - and the "water death spirit". Someone once asked me: "What should the sinful and evil seed (human) do?"

I replied: "The seeds of sin are also people."

Many people do not know the importance of the fetus, they realize that it is not yet a life, so they arbitrarily injure or kill the fetus, sow emotional and physical disasters before it is born, a very deep crime. I witnessed with my own eyes in the underworld, the cries rang out in the sky, they gathered like floodwaters rising up, screaming and roaring for their lives to be returned, truly making the listeners extremely scared. People on earth also do not know that their lives are in danger as if hanging by a thread, because many people have suffered from cancerous tumors, feeling terrified, confused, not understanding the cause of the disease. But I know the reason, it is "Thuy Tu Linh" forcing revenge. Not all cancerous tumors are caused by "Water Tu Linh", but the causes of cancerous tumors by "Water Tu

Linh" are many.

I turned "Thai Hong Son Trang" into "Thuy Tu Linh" mountain page, mainly to comfort the lonely, separated "Thuy Tu Linh" who are in anger. Someone said I was superstitious. I had to laugh out loud when I heard this. There are many confusing things in this world, so if you believe it's fine, if you don't believe it's fine, wait until the cancerous tumor grows big, then you'll be fascinated!

I have a question for everyone: There are many disasters in life, many adversities, many afflictions, many tribulations, why are there so many, can anyone answer me why there are so many?
