tieu_de: 10.1 The thrilling story of the nightingale's transformation
noi_dung:
10.1 The thrilling story of a nightingale's reincarnation

In 1997, many domestic news agencies sent reporters to Mr. Ma's house at 4803 Thi Lau Street, Dongtai Town, Jiangsu Province to interview about what is considered a thrilling real event about reincarnation.

Mr. His employees are workers of the brand company. In 1983, at just 18 years old, his only daughter suffered from leukemia. Faced with a huge medical bill, his daughter's school and social protection both wanted to donate to help, but his daughter did not allow this sad story to be published publicly in the press. She comforted her parents and said that after she died, she would come to this house to "reincarnate", asking her parents not to be sad. Not long after, his daughter passed away due to ineffective treatment.

On March 12, 1995, a beautiful day. Early in the morning, Mr. Ma went to the factory earlier than usual. In the house, his wife Thi Don was washing her face. At this time, a bird flew out of nowhere in the yard, landed on the east side of the kitchen, its head facing Thi Don's direction and sang non-stop. Thi Don took a chair and climbed up to try, and caught the bird with absolutely no effort. At noon, Mr. Ma came home and saw a nightingale. He was happy and immediately ran to the market to buy a birdcage and food. After raising it for about two months, no one in the family taught me how to talk, but unexpectedly the bird could talk and called Mr. Ma's name, "Ma Tam Mao". Next, the bird began to speak more and more, and also spoke a lot of Dong Dai's village language, with very accurate pronunciation. According to the testimony of Mr. Ma and his neighbors, the voice was exactly like the voice of his daughter who passed away two years ago. It's strange, several high school girls said: Even the owner of this bird has been raising it for so long and still can't teach it to pronounce

her name, but now it can call each of their classmates' names, without any mistakes.

According to Mr. Ma, he never talked in front of the bird about himself and his close relatives or the names of his neighbors, but for some reason this nightingale knew how to call Mr. Ma, the names of his neighbors and relatives. Of course, the bird also often called Thi Don's name for offering rice "Tieu Phung".

This nightingale was very knowledgeable. One time Mr. Ma and his relatives went to the right corner of the campus to play mahjong. While playing, the nightingale outside the door said two sentences: "It's about to rain, we haven't come to put away the blanket yet". The owner looked up and saw that the sky was gloomy, so he went to collect the blanket. One day, the owner and his friend were playing mahjong. Before placing it on the table, the bird said: "Don't bet money, it's being caught outside!". It can even say to chess players: "Today, your face is not lucky, I'm afraid you will lose money." Not only that, he knows all the words of Mahjong by heart.

As long as the phone rings in the house, the nightingale will shout: "Phone, phone, Ma Tam Mao is on the phone" or "Tieu Phung is on the phone", often when it's almost time to cook rice, the bird will remind: "Ma Tam Mao is cooking!", many people have asked Mr. Ma to bring the bird to the exhibition center. In 1997, Mr. Ma brought the bird to the entrance ticket collection center, and in just one day he collected more than a thousand dong.

However, the bird's temperament was also "strong", the owner saw that it knew how to talk, and taught it many times to say: "Cung Hy, Phat Tai" auspicious sayings, but it never said it. On the contrary, when Mr. Ma's house has guests coming, often Mr. Ma's parents, no matter how old or young, the bird calls out that person's name to offer food. Many times, there are men who have not heard someone calling for over fifty or sixty years, but the call comes from the bird's mouth.

According to Mr. Ma: since his daughter passed away, they really haven't seen anything like the popular folk saying "Demon God", but having this bird in the house really makes it difficult for many people around to understand. Why does this bird sound exactly like its lost master? Is it a coincidence? Looking back: even if the owner was "reincarnated", how could she know the names of her relatives and neighbors? If it weren't for the reincarnated teacher, the bird's classmates could all call out their names.

tieu_de: 10.2 The ruler of samsara in the underworld
noi_dung:
10.2 The ruler of reincarnation in the underworld

Layman Ly Bach Nong said: there is a person named Lang, who works as an English translation professor in Hong Kong. This person is very honest and lives a virtuous life. Every month, Lang Quan had to sleep for seven days and seven nights. He said he was working in the underworld, managing reincarnation, and people couldn't believe it. How many ghosts did he release in seven days? He said there were about 100,000, but asked how many people worked with him? He talks a lot. Ask him, are there so many reincarnated people in heaven? He said: "Hong Kong and Guangdong people like to eat young pigeons. One day they kill countless animals. The spirits of these pigeons and animals, which often live and die within a few dozen days, often suffer reincarnation, and also pass through our hands." He also said that two colleagues had a great disaster, one due to unfilial piety, the other due to unjust corruption, they would die in the sea of ​​​​fire, and told them not to go to the province at this time. The two of them didn't believe it. Just then, the two of them went to a relative's house in the province to have fun. They didn't expect that in the past few days, there would be a big flood and a big fire at the West Gate. One person died in the flood water, the other person died in the fire.Lang Quan also said that in the underworld, the most important thing is Buddhism.

tieu_de: 10.3 Two sisters in England learn about their past lives
noi_dung:
10.3 Two sisters in England learned about their past lives

According to press information, in the UK there was a pair of sisters who died in a traffic accident in a car, and together reincarnated, becoming twins of their mother!

11-year-old Tony and 6-year-old Jacky Lan, a few years ago, unfortunately had an accident in England and passed away. In life, Mr. and Mrs. Porocat, the parents of the two children, were extremely hurt and decided to leave this tragic place.

Half a year later, Mrs. Porocat became pregnant again, gave birth to a pair of twin girls, and named the girls Jeny and Kalin. Strange things continued to happen from then on. Jeny has a white birthmark on her forehead, similar to the position of Jacky Lan's wound when she died. In addition, she has a birthmark on her buttocks that is also in the same position as Jacky Lan's.

Three years later, Mr. and Mrs. Porocat brought the twins back to visit the old house, where Tony and Jacky Lan died. When driving the car into the house, Jeny and Kalin shouted: "We used to often come here to play, our school is over there, this is the slide we used to play on", they could also point out the location of the old house.

At the age of 4, Porocat decided to let these twins play with the toys left behind by their deceased sisters. Jeny immediately knew how to call the names of the two dolls.

 Jeny and Kalin are no different from other children, but they just can't forget the disasters of their previous lives. Many times, in the middle of the night, they often burst into tears of fear, hugged each other, and shouted, "That car is coming to hit me!" At the same time, Kalin held Jeny's head, crying and screaming that her blood was flowing out. Mr. Porocat and his wife had never told them about the accident of their two children before. The mental illness expert in charge of investigating this incident said that only reincarnation and reincarnation had a reason, other than that there was no other most reasonable reason to explain this event.

tieu_de: 10.4 Girls speak the languages ​​of eight countries
noi_dung:
10.4 Baby girl can speak the languages of eight countries

A girl of Bulgarian nationality, less than two months old, can speak the languages of eight countries: Bulgarian, English, French, Latin, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Portuguese, everyone who speaks can understand everything, this event causes a stir among scientists and experts. linguists are all surprised, unable to explain, what is the cause of this unexpected thing.

This baby girl's name is Sofia-Pahafun, born into an ordinary intellectual family, now two months old, weighing only 10 pounds, her face is very mature like an adult. The baby girl was born about 2 weeks old and can already speak complete sentences and can even use several languages. Famous scientists in Bulgaria, after examining it, confirmed that at Sofia's age, she can only make simple sounds, but cannot speak like Sofia, and has never been able to speak the above languages ​​through study.

According to the revelations of Sofia's parents, the baby at one month old could talk to them, whispering about her feelings in her short life. Moscow and the Soviet Union, the "rebirth theory" of Mr. about this event. Just based on the fact that this girl's previous life was a person who spoke many languages ​​and this life is still maintained according to reincarnation, this may be the most perfect explanation.

tieu_de: 10.5 News about reincarnation
noi_dung:
10.5 News about reincarnation

Taizhou Buddhist information announced the 8th installment of 1991, about a reincarnation story: this case arose in Chaozhou province. Mr. Duong Thu Thuy was a construction worker, residing on Thai Binh road, Trieu Chau town, passed away 8 years ago, at the age of thirty years. Earlier this year, his married daughter named Duong Thuc Phuong had a dream. In the dream, her father told her: "I have to change lives." The daughter asked: "Where to?" He said, "I have to move to be your neighbor." The daughter asked, "Do we still need to celebrate your death anniversary?" The father replied, "I still have to do it. You have to buy the things I liked to eat when I was alive." Because the dream situation was very clear and detailed, the next day, Thuc Phuong went to the address her father instructed her to visit. Unexpectedly, the owner of this house is her old friend from the past, this friend gave birth to a grandson yesterday.

This friend's house is not far from her house, but after getting married, everyone was busy with family chores and rarely interacted with each other. Therefore, this dream is not due to thinking about it during the day, but dreaming about the same things at night.

tieu_de: 10.6 Former president of Sirilanca reincarnated
noi_dung:
10.6 Former president of Sirilanca reincarnated and reincarnated

Around January 18, 1999, the newspapers of Sirilanca published details of the reincarnation story of the former president of Sirilanca, Mr. Panoima. In the country, the newspapers all published this event. According to local reports: a 22-year-old son is considered the reincarnation of the former president of Sirilanca. Hundreds of thousands of people, wanting to see with their own eyes this man whose face looked exactly like the President, went to the town of Hancualan, where this man lived. The President was killed by a striker holding a mine and causing an explosion, and died in May 1993.

According to the announcement: this son came from a farmer family. His parents named him “Uykibahua” but he kept calling himself “Panoima”. This son even considered Panoima's family members as his own. Uykibahua mentioned that he was murdered by a man named Babu. Besides, the murderer of the President is indeed named Babu.

According to the information given, every morning Uykibahua wakes up at 3 a.m. and performs Buddhist rituals exactly like the late President did. A person who is only a few years old and still illiterate knows so many things, one cannot help but say that perhaps he is a person from a previous life who has reincarnated and reincarnated.

tieu_de: 10.7 A person's name appears on a buffalo's body
noi_dung:
10.7 A human's name appears on a buffalo's body

On January 28, 1958, in Taichung, Van Tin Daily published the following news: "In Trien Dong district, there is a cow, which has just given birth to a calf with three words "Lam Tan Giao" appearing on its back, the owner of this cow is named Uu Van Kim, he has a son named Uu Van Dat's family was very poor. When this district was not yet developed, he worked for a doctor named Lam Tan Giao. Unfortunately, two thousand kilos of rice were stolen from Lam's family. In fact, this rice was stolen by him, but he falsely accused Uu Van Dat of stealing it. Because at that time, the criminal police officer beat him during questioning. Uu Van Dat could not bear to be tortured and was forced to take revenge. He committed suicide to reveal the truth. Not long after, Lam Tan Giao also passed away, time was like the wind, after ten years, in Uu Van Kim's farm, a cow had just given birth to a calf and the three words Lam Tan Giao appeared on its back.Lam Tan Giao's son, Lam Vinh Quang, found out about this. He immediately contacted the owner of the neighboring livestock farm and agreed to spend ten thousand five hundred dong to buy the calf, but the livestock owner refused. After this news spread, causing a stir in public opinion, "The story of killing a person's life unjustly while still alive" after death the name appeared on the back of a cow, happened in Trien Dong district, Taiwan, many people know. It can be proven that reincarnation is grounded.

tieu_de: 10.8 Going back and forth, the back still has birthmarks
noi_dung:
10.8 After being reincarnated, the back still has a birthmark

The Hoang family in Lien Xu village, Vinh Xuan district, a few months ago, a son died. The Hoang family felt so sorry for him, they took a red pen and drew two lines of words on the child's back; Only then will it be buried. Three days later, the Lam family in the other village gave birth to a son; There are two red lines written on the back, exactly the same as the lines the Hoang family wrote on the back of their son. Using a towel to wipe it off is even more obvious. Some people say that when bathing the child, invite the father of the child's previous life to come and wipe away the words for it to be effective. The Lam family sent someone to invite and allow their son to be the next descendant of the two families.

tieu_de: 10.9 A 3-year-old child remembers his past life, identifies the murderer, and points out where the body was buried
noi_dung:
10.9 3-year-old child remembers past lives, identifies murderer and points out where body buried

A 3-year-old child in the Golan Heights area near the border with Syria and Israel said he was murdered by an ax in a previous life. He showed the village elders where the murderer buried him, and indeed they found the skeleton of a man there. He also showed the elders where the weapon was buried, and when they dug it up, they actually found an ax there.

In his book, “Children Who Have Lived Before: Reincarnation Today,” German therapist Trutz Hardo recounts the story of a young boy, along with many stories of other children who seemed to remember their previous lives with proven accuracy. Dr. Eli Lasch witnessed the story of this boy, Lasch is famous for developing the medical system in Gaza as part of the Israeli government in the 60s. Dr. Lasch died in 2009, and recounted these amazing cases to Hardo.

The boy belonged to the Druze ethnic group, and his culture believed in reincarnation. Even so, his story still shocked the community here.

He was born with a long red birthmark on his head. Like

in some other cultures, the Druze believe that birthmarks are related to death in a past life. When he was old enough to talk, he told his family that he had been murdered by an ax blow to the top of his head.

According to custom here, elders will take children at age 3 to their old home in their previous life if the child can remember. The boy knew the village where he used to live, so they went there. When they arrived, he suddenly remembered his name in his previous life.

A villager said that the man the boy thought was his previous life had disappeared four years ago. Family and friends think he may have wandered into a dangerous area nearby, as similar incidents have occasionally happened before. The boy also remembered the full name of the person who murdered him. When he confronted this person, his face turned pale, Lasch told Hardo, but he did not confess. Then the boy said he could lead the elders to where his body was buried. In that same place, they found a skeleton of a man with a wound on his head, matching the boy's birthmark. They also found the ax, the weapon used to kill him.

Faced with this evidence, the murderer admitted his guilt. Dr. Lasch, the only non-Druze person, was present throughout the incident. To read more of Hardo's stories, read his book, “Children Who Lived Before.”

tieu_de: 10.10 A 5 year old boy can clearly describe his past life. This boy's previous life was Hollywood actor Marty Martyn.
noi_dung:
10.10 A 5-year-old boy can clearly describe his previous life . This boy's past life was Hollywood actor Marty Martyn.

5-year-old Ryan, living in Oklahoma, USA, caused a stir when he was able to tell the story of his past life. Even though he is only 5 years old, this boy can tell stories from a long time ago and are completely true.

When looking at old books about past Hollywood characters, Ryan can read the name of each famous person and say it is... his friend. Ryan can also tell details about black and white movies from long ago and

he can even tell behind-the-scenes secrets that not everyone knows.

Ryan's mother, Cindy, was extremely surprised that her son could know things about his past life. Cindy said that Ryan once pointed to a photo from the movie Night After Night taken in 1932 and said: “Mom, this is me. I have found myself!”. Ryan then described to his mother a scene in the movie where there was a closet filled with lots of guns and ammunition. Cindy watched the movie and confirmed that there was a scene from the movie as Ryan recounted.

Actor Marty Martyn (left) is Ryan's past life

Cindy sent a letter to Tucker B Jim, who is famous for his books about past lives. Tucker found the man in Ryan's past life, which wasMarty Martyn, a former Hollywood celebrity. Marty lived in Los Angeles and died of cancer in 1963.

Ryan said that he died in a room with many numbers on the door. The truth is that Marty passed away in a numbered hospital room. Ryan also recounted that his sisters and mother had brown curly hair, the family had a villa in Los Angeles and took trips to France... Ryan also said he sawMarilyn Monroe at a party, but before he could get close to the star, he was punched in the eye by a bodyguard. Ryan said that Marty wanted to return to make amends because in the past this man loved his work too much and had no time for his family. As for Ryan, the boy is sometimes very tired

Ryan also met Marty's daughter, but after meeting Ryan was very disappointed and said: "Why is she so old, she is no longer a young girl like before." However, Marty's daughter also confirmed that what Ryan told was true. But after a few months of interacting with Marty's daughter, Ryan's memories of his previous life suddenly faded.

Tucker said that children are often only greatly influenced by current life and Ryan has a special ability. In addition to stories about his past life, Ryan can also tell things that few people know, such as his grandmother having a child who died right after birth or knowing who is calling before someone picks up the phone... Tucker believes that Ryan has information that cannot come from normal brain activity and has forms of information storage that surpass human limits.

Tucker is the author of the book Return to life. The book is about children who believe they are reincarnated and can tell stories of their past lives. According to Dailymail

tieu_de: CHAPTER 11: THE REACTION OF RELEASE AND MURDER
noi_dung: CHAPTER 11: THE RESPONSE OF RELEASE AND MURDER MURDER

tieu_de: 11.1 Living Buddha Lien Sanh tells the story of retribution for killing living beings.  (Excerpt from the book "Records of Hell's Transformations" by Living Buddha Lu Sheng Ngan Lian-sheng)
noi_dung:
11.1 Living Buddha Lian-sheng tells the story of retribution for killing living beings. (Excerpt from the book "Records of Hell's Transformations" by Lian-sheng Buddha Lian-sheng)

Once there was a woman who had suffered from "heaven-tossed disease" for 10 years, and had found the monks. Doctors at home and abroad, but there was no way to alleviate the disease. It could be said that the doctors were helpless and unable to cure her. This woman came to take refuge with me and recited the "Master Mind Mantra" hundreds of thousands of times. One time, she came to see me and said: "Master, I really have something to ask for, so I took refuge with you. I hope you will forgive me."

I said: "I don't pay any attention. Many people come to take refuge, I see them all the same." I asked: “What are you asking for?” Only then did she say that the reason for taking refuge was because she wanted the Master to cure her illness. At first I used "strengthening power" and "incantation power" to help her, but it was not always at the right point. Finally, I used my Thien Eye to observe, at which point I suddenly discovered that an invisible nail was implanted in her head, causing pain. The nail is purple, 5 inches long, and causes nerve pain when touched. I was horrified to learn that this invisible, painful nail came from the underworld, so I had to seek guidance from the King of Hell.

I asked the King of Hell what had to do with the invisible nail that hurt this female disciple. The King of Hell said:

“When he was young, his disciple loved to eat chickens and frogs. When he ate frogs, he used oil to burn and grill the frogs. Countless frogs were grilled to death. They had exceeded their blessings, so the Underworld sent out this painful nail as punishment.” – “For such a reason, how can we rescue them now?”

King of Hell replied: “Only to release beings and recite the Vạn Sinh mantra”

I said: “I will encourage her to release beings and recite the Vạn Sinh mantra.

In front of her eyes, she has already recited hundreds of thousands of Master's mind mantras." The King of Hell said: "This way, the nail that hurts will naturally disappear."

I must say the strange thing is that after the trip to the Underworld to meet the King of Hell, the disciple's illness from the head of the head seemed to fly without wings. After waking up from sleep, she no longer had any pain, the pain was as if it had been plucked from her head, completely different from before, the pain was completely relieved. I used my Thien Eye to see again and could no longer see the painful nail.

I asked: "You like eating frogs, don't you?" She replied:

“Master knows it all!” – “How many of them did you eat?”

“I went to the market to buy them, grill them and eat them, I don't know how many more.”

“Now I can't eat anymore, I see, I buy them and release them, reciting the Vang Sanh Mantra as many times as possible, that way the disease will not recur” – “Please obey Master's orders.”

This female disciple, from then on, no longer eats frog meat, but instead only focuses on releasing frogs, reciting mantras. Rebirth hundreds of thousands of times. Use the inspiration that comes to you to inform many people, leading many people to take refuge in me.

As far as I know, there are many people who have had a nail implanted in their body. These nails come from Hell to punish people, some people have shoulder pain, some people have back pain, some people have headaches, some people have pain in the joints, some people have toothache, leg pain, finger pain, etc. It may not necessarily be created by Minh Phu, but I hope everyone will do a lot of freeing animals and read the Vang Sanh Mantra a lot. Eliminate karma!

I would like to truly report to everyone, do not enjoy all the blessings, enjoying all the blessings will lead to disaster. We who study Buddhism must know how to value happiness and create happiness. Buddha once taught us "must let go", try asking "must let go" what does it mean to let go? Please answer.

tieu_de: 11.2 The chef changes his profession, the whole family is blessed
noi_dung:
11.2 Chef changes profession, the whole family is blessed

  A Dung's occupation is a chef at a restaurant, he specializes in slaughtering animals and livestock. No need to think, the salary is also reasonable, your pocket is always full of money. It's just a pity that I haven't been able to save any money in the past 16 years. My mother, wife, and relatives often get sick, so all the money is spent on treating their relatives' illnesses, and their health is not looking good. In his heart, he wished to have a child to carry and continue the worship line, but no matter how he prayed, it was in vain. Even though he was over 40 years old, he still had no anger. When I read the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", I realized that I had been killing for too long a time. There were many reasons for killing but in a short time there was no way to change careers.

I'm used to standing in front of a chopping board chopping meat, and in my dreams I always see myself chopping meat. Several times I dreamed that I was standing there chopping up human flesh. So I often wake up in the middle of the night. However, he was terrified of his job of killing, but because he had to maintain his family's life, he continued to practice like that. Not long after, his wife became pregnant, and he was very happy.

One night, he was having a nightmare, dreaming of going to a deep pit, floating on a suspension bridge, carrying a lot of arms, feet, and human flesh, never ending. At this time, his wife woke him up from his dream because she was about to go into labor and had a severe stomach ache. He immediately took his wife to the hospital. The doctor congratulated him because his wife had given birth to a son, but because he was born two months early, the baby had to sleep in a glass cage. Every day, A Dung stood in front of the glass cage, looking at a small creature struggling with the boundary between life and death. His heart ached like a knife. Finally, he was discharged from the hospital but brought home a pale, weak baby with only four fingers on his left hand. The hematoma had become necrotic, as if it had been cut by a knife, the wife's face

Pale and bewildered, he felt so heartbroken that he shed tears. He vowed in his heart that within one year he was determined to change his profession and asked the Bodhisattva for guidance.

A good-natured, all-knowing person, A Dung was finally introduced by a wise teacher to a vegetarian restaurant to become a chef. For the past month, he has been reciting Buddha's name and fasting. The nightmares and insecurity have gradually disappeared. The most miraculous thing is his beloved child, for a month now he doesn't need to take medicine, is no longer sick, only has a mild cold every now and then. The mother and wife's health is also gradually recovering. The whole family lives in a happy and harmonious atmosphere. He feels that now he is truly a happy family.

In the Buddhist scriptures it says: "Of all the criminal acts, killing lives is the biggest and most serious crime; of all the virtues of doing good, do not kill lives." and releasing animals is the greatest merit.”

tieu_de: 11.3 Do your best to release living beings and diseases will be cured
noi_dung:
11.3 By working hard to release living beings, illnesses are cured

Mr. Diep Hong Ngu in Tien Duong, Triet Giang, at the age of 9, dreamed of a "Green-faced God" leading him to a palace with a large, high-walled gate, and then letting him enter the palace with a red gate. He saw a "Yellow-faced God" sitting inside the gate, looking at him with a very angry face. He looked at him for a long time and nodded repeatedly. "Green-faced God" pulled him out of the palace and slapped him on the back. He was so scared that he woke up from his dream and vomited blood all over the bed.

Even after calling a doctor to treat him for a whole year, his illness still could not be cured, the bleeding still could not be stopped. This little boy from the Diep family was very smart when he was young. Everyone in the family loved him. He often gave money and had accumulated a large amount of money. Now that I'm so sick, my grandmother pointed at her grandchild's face and said: "You're so sick that you can't get out of bed.

What use is that money to you? Just give me all the money I have to buy animals to release animals." Wait until these funds are spent on freeing animals, then you can be cured. Later, Diep Hong Ngu became a famous businessman in Triet Giang city.

tieu_de: 11.4 The eel appears in a dream
noi_dung:
11.4 The eel appears in a dream

Mr. Ninh Ni is a famous lawyer in Nam Xuong. In his dream, he saw 7 people wearing pointed yellow hats, hastily walking in front of him, bowing their heads to the ground to pray and shouting "Save my life!" He saw compassion emerging and replied: "Okay, okay!" denotes seeking relief. These people shouted their thanks again and left. The next morning, Mr. Ninh woke up to wash his face, thinking about the thrilling events in his dream yesterday, not understanding the reason. Just then, the chef came and said: "Sir, the other day you bought eels to prepare for guests, will you cook them and eat them today?" He replied: "Wait, let me see." Sure enough, there were 7 eels wading in the water basin as if asking for help from him. Seeing this, he clearly understood last night's dream and told the story of the dream to the whole family, asking the chef to bring all the eels to the river to release them, fulfilling the promise in the dream. Techniques for Buddha nature and animals are the same. The eel is like a soul, reporting in a dream to ask for help from its owner, to avoid being killed, which has the same meaning as the literature on releasing life by Great Master Lien Tri, "in the midst of trouble seeking rebirth, appearing in yellow clothes and entering the dream" has the same meaning.

tieu_de: 11.5 Releasing animals to cure epidemics, the whole family is safe
noi_dung:
11.5 Releasing animals to cure epidemics, the whole family is safe

Farmers on Thai Ho island specialize in catching fish and operating slaughterhouses to kill animals. Only Tham Van Buu does not do this job, the whole family often does good deeds, when they see people catching fish and birds or buying them to release animals. Many people laugh at him for doing these things because they are not appropriate for the times, but Mr. Tham Van Buu is still not afraid of hardship and difficulty in doing this. Later, this village developed an epidemic. People in the village dreamed of the "Plague God" holding a flag in his hand and telling the demons: "Except for the Tham family, which specializes in freeing living beings and doing good deeds, all families must visit and carry the pestilence flag." In less than a few days, a village of 300 families was infected with an epidemic and killed about half of the people. Only the Tham family was not infected.

tieu_de: 11.6 Releasing the fish will lead to eternal peace
noi_dung:
11.6 Releasing fish is considered death, eternal peace

During the Song Dynasty, Mr. Truong Toan was from Tien Duong district. When I was a child, I was using a small knife to cut fish. I didn't pay attention to cutting my hand, so I felt it and said: "I only injured one finger and it hurt so much. If a fish were to be cut open, how much pain would it be?" So I took the whole basket of fish and dumped it back into the river. From then on, he abstains from killing and prefers to release animals. Later, he dreamed of meeting someone who gave him a big fish. Not long after, his wife gave birth to a noble son. When the young man passed the doctoral exam, he became an official in Vinh Chau, and lived a very happy and wealthy life.

tieu_de: 11.7 Abstain from killing and liberating captive animals (life release), sowing many causes and effects
noi_dung:
11.7 Abstain from killing and liberating captive animals (life release), sowing many causes and effects

In Hangzhou city, Hang Son village, there is a Duong Thu pagoda, in the pagoda worshiping gods is very effective. So many people came to worship. Wei Ngoc Thu in Trieu Hung went to the temple to pray for a son, promising that if he gave birth to a son, he would definitely bring pigs, sheep, chickens, geese, wine and offerings to the temple, and also said he would sing Tuong to thank the gods. That night Ngoc Thu dreamed that God said to him: "When you have a son, you plan to slaughter animals and animals to pay homage to God. Even though I am a God who is not a vegetarian, I cannot arbitrarily let you kill and greedily eat your offerings? Mr. Wei quickly kneel down, bow your head, and pray for God's instructions." The god  said: “You wish to have a son, other

animals also wish to have children, among animals shrimp and snails give birth a lot, you should think again about what to do.” From then on, he saw people catching shrimp and snails and buying them back to release them into the river. Later, his wife gave birth to several sons in succession.

tieu_de: 11.8 Save many lives, increase longevity
noi_dung:
11.8 Save many lives, increase longevity

In Tong Vi, there was a very rich businessman named Duong Tu. At the age of 28, he dreamed of a God telling him: "If you live 10 more days, you will have to die. But if you save 10 thousand lives, you can avoid death." Duong Tu said: "In a short period of ten days, we have to save 10,000 lives. I'm afraid it won't be easy to do that number." The God said: "It is said in the Buddhist scriptures that as long as fish eggs are not salted, even after three years they can still give birth to fry. Why don't you think about this issue?" From then on, Mr. Duong Tu relied on the God's words to write everywhere on the streets and on the walls, so that people would know not to use salt to marinate fish eggs; And when you see someone killing fish, you ask for the eggs back and put them in the lake. A month later, he dreamed again that the God from before said: "You have saved a billion lives, the number is enough, your life will be prolonged." Later, he lived until he was 90 years old before passing away.

tieu_de: 11.9 Memoirs of revenge from a talented fish buster
noi_dung:
11.9 Memoirs of revenge from a talented fish exploder

My house (Ly Kien Quoc) is 3 km away from Tuong Giang, and I often hear the sound of firecrackers exploding on the shore. This is a 26-year-old young man named Duong Phu Lai, who makes a living by exploding to catch fish. Every day from morning to night, we take the tied mines and climb the boat out into the river to explode fish. He was very talented in fish explosion and was named by the local people as a talented fish exploder. The fish he exploded to death were not only thousands or thousands of fish, so he earned a large sum of money.

There is often a saying: "Good and evil will be rewarded in the end". In 1970, on a beautiful summer morning, he brought explosives and rowed his boat out to the river to explode fish. Suddenly he saw a big fish jumping out of the water. He thought the opportunity had come, so he used a burning mosquito incense stick to bait the tube of explosives he was holding in his hand. Suddenly, his eyes and mouth stiffened, the ghost was dazed, as if controlled by someone, his hand holding the burning tube of explosives but refusing to let go, he also did not hear, immediately there was a loud bang, the person exploding fish, flesh and blood flying everywhere, died miserably at the place where he exploded the fish, his wife and children ran to cry in pain, the neighbors just shook their heads and lamented. The retribution of killing is so tragic and so quick! Later people followed the example to abstain from killing.

tieu_de: 11.10 Eating snake meat, body covered with snake scales
noi_dung:
11.10 Eating snake meat, covered with snake scales

Based on the news "Northern Morning Newspaper", in 2001, a piece of information was spread in a village in Tien Son: there was a person who often ate snake meat, suffered a serious illness, his whole body grew snake scales, often shed his skin, liked to soak in rivers and also liked to stick out his tongue. Then, he lay in the cave all day and turned into a snake. The reporter went all the way to find information to verify, find the place where the event happened to interview the snake man as a rumor.

Just entering that village, the reporter heard the tricycle man say: "The Han family has gone to buy burning paper again", the reporter asked why they went to buy burning paper, one of the three tricycle drivers said: "Buy burning paper for the snake because he killed the female snake, the male snake clung to Mr. Han's soul so he would suffer." crime.”

Mr. Han's house is located next to the foot of the mountain, a standard farmyard. In the earthen cave, there was a person wrapped in a blanket, with only his head sticking out. The whole face turned purple but glowed, hair, eyebrows, and beard could not be seen. Outside the cave sat an old woman and a sick young girl,

The young woman often reached in and pulled the blanket back for him. The older woman pointed at the person in the blanket and said: "My son is still under the blanket in the hot sun, because he is cold." In front of the cave there is a water tank, Han's mother said: this is for him to bathe, my son has to soak in the tub for a while to feel comfortable. When he opened the blanket, the reporter was very surprised to see it. Small pieces of silvery purple grew on his body, arranged layer by layer. The skin on the body was peeled into pieces and all I could do was open my mouth and say "uh oh", use my big hands to "swipe" the back of my body, it felt like touching sandpaper, without the slightest elasticity.

Mr. Han's mother reported her son's "strange" story. In November 2000, one evening, Mr. Han came home after drinking and felt a bit tired. His family thought he just had a cold. Heard that eating snake meat can cure colds, so he ran to his friend's house and went into the chicken coop to find a "Yellow pine flower" snake. Normally it likes to eat snake meat so he quickly caught the snake as big as an arm about 1 meter long. At that time, eating this snake included his mother and son. About 3 days after eating, Han's scalp began to peel off, turning red and purple. 10 days later, the situation became more and more serious, his head swelled to the size of a brass basin. Every day, his family scraped off a scab from his body. They used many methods to treat him, applying medicine, taking traditional Chinese medicine, and Western medicine, all of which were ineffective. The dermatologist said he might have a strange skin disease.

tieu_de: 11.11 When eating frog meat, the mouth pronounces frog
noi_dung:
11.11 Eating frog meat, mouth pronounces like frog

On November 23, 1987, "Xianjiang Evening Newspaper" published: Yueyang town, Hunan province, there was a student who after eating frog meat became mentally unstable, his mouth pronounced like frog, everyone who saw it felt strange.

Between In May 1987, Village 8, North of Nhac Duong Town, there was a school with a 17-year-old student. On the lawn in front of the school gate, he discovered a large frog. When he took a closer look, he discovered that it was two frogs connected together. He took it home, skinned it, cut it open, weighed it, weighed more than 2 kg, and cooked it to eat that night. Who would have thought that after eating the meal the next day, he would be mentally unstable, continuously shouting out the words "Oop! Oop! Oop!" like a frog croaking. After many treatments, the patient's condition improved, but there were still sequelae.

tieu_de: 11.12 Not believing the dream, cooked turtle died
noi_dung:
11.12 Did not believe the dream, cooked turtle and died

There was a man named Truong Ky Quang in Suzhou, who liked to eat turtle. During the night, he dreamed that a man dressed in black came to beg him to spare his life and said: "Tomorrow you will have a great disaster." The next morning, his garden tenant caught a large turtle and gave it to him. Ky Quang was very happy to see such a big tortoise. His wife reminded him and said: "Last night I dreamed that the person wearing a black shirt might be this tortoise, so let it go." Ky Quang replied: "Creatures can tell dreams to people, but this one is stupid, can it also tell dreams?" Immediately ordered the chef to cook. Ky Quang ate an entire turtle in one day. That night, he had stomach pain and diarrhea as if he had been cut open. The diarrhea continued non-stop. Treatment was ineffective. He was sick for three months and then passed away.

tieu_de: 11.13 Kill a big tortoise and give birth to a baby like a small tortoise
noi_dung:
11.13 Kill a big tortoise, give birth to a baby like a small tortoise

One day in the summer of 1968, Tu Cung town in Sichuan province had a couple named Liu Ngoc Hoai and Wen Ming. He bought a big turtle and slaughtered it to cook for health.

Next year, on March 13, Minh Anh gave birth to a son. They had two daughters before, and now they are so happy to have a son. But after looking at this boy, he was scared to death. His head was small and shaped like a tortoise's shell. His arms and legs were curled up and turned upside down, unable to move on his own. At 1 year old, he still doesn't know how to turn over, just lies there. When he gets angry, he raises his arms, legs, and shouts "Wow."

When the baby was born, he was less than 2 kg, named Luu Kien Quoc, he was only 1 meter tall. He was unable to stand up all his life. His mother took care of his daily activities such as eating, dressing, and urinating. He had to have someone help him with his illness. He spent a lot of money on medical treatment. Wen Minh Anh admitted that the tortoise was coming to collect his debt.

Actually, no one in Suzhou province knows about this event. Those who kill and eat meat will be punished. We really need to be warned!

tieu_de: 11.14 Those who kill snakes must die unjustly
noi_dung:
11.14 Those who kill snakes must die unjustly

In the year of Canh Ngo, there was a man named Liu in That Ly village, Hubei province. When he went out on the street and saw a big snake, he immediately beat it to death. After returning home, that night he had a dream. In the dream, he saw a person holding a petition in his hand, asking him to follow. That is, the snake that he beat to death went to Diem Phu to sue, "The crime is killing without cause." The snake also said, "I crossed my path, you crossed your path, why did you beat me to death? I must now come to claim your life!". From then on, he became sick and suffered pain for many days before passing away.

tieu_de: 11.15 Burned the female cat to death, the six children had bone defects
noi_dung:
11.15 Female cat burned to death, six children had bone defects

Thirty years ago in Taiwan, in a village, there was a farmer's family raising a female cat. At that time, most every family built a kitchen table, using firewood and straw as fuel because the stove was cozy, especially in the winter, so the female cat often lay in the kitchen to warm up. When it was night time, the other family enjoyed it early in the morning to cook rice, first chasing the female cat out of the kitchen. One day, the weather was bitterly cold. Although I chased away the female cat many times, it still refused to leave.

In the kitchen, the farmer felt angry, brought straw to the stove to cook rice, and the poor cat that loved to sleep was burned alive and died. A year later, this woman gave birth to a son, but his whole body was covered in bones and cartilage, his limbs were shriveled, he could only lie in bed all day, treatment was ineffective, he had to have someone take care of him all year round, it was very heartbreaking. So in the following years, a total of six children were born, each child had a bone disease, the situation was exactly the same, each child lay paralyzed in bed, the neighbors came to ask, everyone felt strange. Because when the female cat was burned to death in the oven, she was carrying many kittens in her belly, and also tragically died along with the mother cat. Not long after, this woman passed away due to depression. Just before his death, he let out a pitiful cry like a cat meowing. Everyone who heard it had chills down their spines. The kittens and the 6 cartilaginous children were truly a terrifying retribution.

Doing evil things in the world is not the top crime, but killing is the most serious crime. Buddhism has many types of abstinence, but committing the crime of killing is the most serious. People who respect Buddha and readers must develop compassion and love for life. Preserving one life accumulates one blessing, which means one less injustice. Proceed to buy things to release beings, grow good roots, and have good luck to live forever in this life and the next.

tieu_de: 11.16 If you kill a monkey and peel its skin, the animal will get sick
noi_dung:
11.16 Killing a monkey to shed its skin, the child gets a strange disease

Information from Malaysia, Kulalumpua has a Mo ethnic person who was abused by a demon for ten years! This young man is 13 years old. From the age of 3 onwards, a black monkey that was murdered by his father possessed him and harassed him, giving him an extraordinary life different from others. people.

This young man's name is Mahada but his family often calls him "Manja". Mother Sama has a total of 4 children, Mayja is the third child, at 2 years old she knew how to call mom and dad, very cute. When Mayja was 3 years old, when his father went hunting and shot a black monkey, he immediately skinned it and slaughtered it on the spot, then hung it on a tree branch to show off. Mayja had a high fever at this time. After the fever, Mayja no longer knew how to talk or joke. All day she could only hide in her room. Occasionally she would utter monkey-like sounds. Eating, bathing, and urinating had to be taken care of by her mother and sister. Physiologically, his 10 fingers are weak and helpless. When eating, Mayja likes to use his hands to bring food to his face and then put it in his mouth; If you find that the food is not delicious, you will throw the food on the ground. Although using traditional medicine and even using healing spells, Mayja could not be the same as before. At the age of 9, he was taken to the Central Hospital in Kulalumpua for treatment. Unfortunately, his condition did not improve, but on the contrary, it got worse; But the medicine given by the hospital can control the tremor.Later, Mayja's father no longer hunted, so he could reduce his karma and wait for a miracle to appear, so that Mayja could return to normal as before.

tieu_de: 11.17 Retribution of the fish poisoner
noi_dung:
11.17 Retribution of the fish poisoner

My uncle used to be a gentle farmer, normally he rarely did bad things, but he also rarely did good things. At the end of his life, he and a few people in the village often went to the riverbank to spread a net. Waiting for the tide to go down, hanging the net high would be able to stop the fish. If he couldn't catch it, he would drop poison to catch the fish. The people in the village were used to that, so no one advised him.

Just like that, on the tenth day of the past year, several years have passed,

On a dark night for several consecutive nights before going to sleep, he seemed to hear the sound of a handcuffed person walking around outside his room. He asked his family if anyone had heard it? The family member said: "There is no one, maybe you heard wrong!" In his heart, he was very doubtful. A few days later, because of a family matter, he had an argument with a family member. While thinking about it, while no one was home, he committed suicide by drinking pesticide. When he died, his eyes looked very scary. The "Cause and Effect Sutra" says: "For whatever reason, those who die are poisoned, and those who block rivers poison fish." Because blocking rivers poisons fish, big and small fish are killed, there is no way to escape, and the water source is polluted very seriously. The government has issued a ban, but there are still people who ignore it as if nothing happened and still do it as usual!

The writer wants to use this story, hoping to wake up those who are blocking the river and poisoning fish. They should not consider it as a small matter but should reform and do good deeds.

tieu_de: 11.18 The assassin kills the monkey, the child becomes a monkey man
noi_dung:
11.18 Killer kills monkey, child becomes monkey man

In 1984, in Malaysia, there was a young man named Hamarusy, who had always lived a life like a monkey. He had no interest in rice and food and could not go a day without eating bananas! His daily food is two or thirty bananas, sometimes he eats a dozen bananas at a time.

His father, Salu, took him to see many doctors for examination and treatment, but no doctor could find the cause of the disease. Later, a magician told him that it was not because he was sick, but because he hunted too many wild animals, so heaven blamed it on his son's body as a warning. Salu also admitted that while Hamarusy had not passed away, he often hunted animals, especially he killed many monkeys. When the incident happened, he brought home a monkey with a long tail and a bunch of bananas, unexpectedly from

That day onwards, Hamarusy became a "monkey man". Because he often tears his clothes, his family ties his hands, but he never destroys the neighbors. Hamarusy's attitude and gestures are like those of a monkey, and even his screams are like those of a monkey. He doesn't like to wear clothes, even when it's raining heavily, he still sleeps naked until morning without catching a cold, it's really:

Steals raw fried meat to satisfy his cravings, slaughters animals because he's full;
Turns the kitchen into hell, the cutting board is like a killing card surgery;
Cutting open the intestines and cutting the belly up to the mountain of knives, frying, cooking, and steaming is a crime;
Swallowing and eating fresh is a delicacy, how do you know that animals can't bear it;
The soul knows how to send hauntings into its body, sooner or later it must Force yourself to pay your debt;
Good and evil must have their consequences, disease caused by killing karma, don't ignore it;
The days passed quickly and evil piled up, illness forced me to be hospitalized; It is
physical pain, mental suffering and loss of wealth, due to the crime of changing clothes;
If you know early that you will have to go to hell, know in advance and don't worry about it.

tieu_de: 11.19 Venerable Tuyen Hoa tells the story of human facial acne: Human facial acne in the present time.
noi_dung:
11.19 Venerable Tuyen Hoa tells the story of acne on a human face: Acne on a human face in the present time.

Today I will tell two koans about killing living beings. Around 1945, there was Venerable Dai Minh, abbot of Thua Thien Pagoda, Suzhou Province, China. Although this Venerable is a Buddhist, he believes in paganism and in the temple worships the Fairy Fox. Therefore, the foxes in this temple freely enter and exit without being chased away by anyone, and they are also not afraid of people. People and foxes lived together peacefully. At that time, the Venerable Master was in retreat at this temple to review and read the Tripitaka. The fox also came to the Venerable's room to practice together. While the Venerable recited the sutras, he slept on the Venerable Buddha's cushion. When the Venerable wanted to bow to the Buddha, the Venerable said to him: "I want to bow to the Buddha, you go out!"

At that time, the fox obediently walked out of the room. Waiting for the Venerable to finish the ceremony, he went back in and continued to sleep on the cushion to worship Buddha. Every day was like that, over a long period of time and the two sides became like friends. One day, the Venerable Master had a bit of a temper. When it was time to pay respect to the Buddha, the Venerable told him: "If you don't come out immediately, I will beat you to death!" The fox glared at him as if he didn't care about the Venerable, then he closed his eyes and continued to sleep. Perhaps he thinks something like this: After all, monastics also have the ambition to be compassionate and use means as a gateway. That's why he didn't go.

So at that time, the Venerable became angry and said: "Why is that! You really are a guest and want to overwhelm the host! I will beat you to death!" Having finished speaking, the Venerable took his stick out to scare it away. But the fox still didn't pay attention. In anger, the Venerable waved his stick and took a breath.

Unexpectedly, the Venerable broke his hand and broke the fox's head, causing blood to stain the Buddha's offering mat red. Indeed, the Venerable Master beat it to death. The Venerable Master committed the crime of killing, so he felt extremely regretful and did not know how to resolve the matter amicably. How can this sinful karma be eliminated? Thinking about it, I can't think of a way. Suddenly, the Venerable's spiritual nature suddenly remembered that someone had said: if you kill a fox and give its meat to others to eat, you will eliminate the karma of killing. So the Venerable peeled the fox's skin and gave the meat to some workers - he thought that was the end of the matter.

Unexpectedly, seven days later, the fox spirit came to the Venerable and said: "I have gone to the King of Hell to denounce you, you must pay for my life!" The Venerable was in the middle of meditation when he heard that, so he was extremely frightened. So the Venerable began reciting the Great Compassion Mantra. Thanks to the blessing of the mantra, the fox could not get close to the Venerable, so it had no way to harm him. But it refused to leave, and it always came to harass him. Seven days later, the fox knew that he could not take revenge on his own, so he went to ask for reinforcements. Can you guess which reinforcements it asked for? They are the souls of Japanese soldiers who died in battle during Japan's invasion of China. The fox gathered many troops, then they used cannons to shoot at the Venerable's body.

But they bombarded the Venerable for many days but could not hit the Venerable. Why? Because the Venerable concentrated all his spirit on reciting the Great Compassion Mantra, without leaving his seat, the artillery shells did not hit him but kept falling around the Venerable. After many days of not eating or drinking, the Venerable Master was truly exhausted. In a moment, the Venerable felt confused and panicked and unfortunately the Venerable's right knee was hit by a cannon. So the Japanese soldiers immediately retreated. The Venerable escaped the artillery threat, so he felt extremely happy because he thought the matter was over. Just thinking like that, the Venerable felt pain right at the spot where the cannon was hit. The Venerable looked down and saw a boil on his right knee, shaped like a human face, with a mouth and teeth. The wound is both swollen and painful, no medicine can cure it.

One day, someone told the Venerable: "If you apply fatty meat to the mouth of a boil, the pain will go away." The Venerable Master tried it and it certainly worked. But when the piece of fatty meat was eaten with pimples on his face, the Venerable began to have pain again. And just like that, the Venerable was tormented by boils all the time, and his suffering was unspeakable. After many painful days, the Venerable suddenly realized that only by destroying all karma can one be free from suffering. So the Venerable devoted himself to practice and did not care about the pain anymore. The Venerable tried to patiently endure the pain and single-mindedly worshiped the Buddha and repented of his karma of killing.

After three years, the Venerable was cured of his illness. This Venerable was a true practitioner. He often went to places to consult and study with wise men and also visited four famous great mountains (Wutai Mountain, Emei Mountain, Jiuhua Mountain, Putuo Mountain) and eight great and small mountains in China. The Venerable Master is a very virtuous person. Even though he accidentally killed the fox, the Venerable still had to repent and worship Buddha to eliminate karma. Therefore we should know that the karma of killing is the worst. Please pay attention! You should not kill living beings but should do a lot of merit to release living beings. If you arbitrarily kill living beings, you will suffer from strange diseases that cannot be cured, or you will become disabled and regret it for the rest of your life!

tieu_de: 11.20 Pimples on people's faces in the past: (Sutra of Compassion and Repentance)
noi_dung:
11.20 Pimples on people's faces in the past: (Sutra of Compassion and Repentance)

During the time of King Yizong of the Tang Dynasty, there was a National Teacher named Zen Master Ngo Dat. When the Zen Master preached sutras at Cu An Pagoda, Truong An Province, King Y Tong personally came to listen to the Dharma and specially gave the Zen Master a throne made of sandalwood and incense. At that time, the Zen Master became arrogant and considered himself the highest monk in the world, with no one equal to him. Unexpectedly, as soon as false thoughts arose in my mind, the Dharma Protector immediately left the Zen Master and went away. So the unjust bondholder had followed the Zen Master for ten generations. Now when he found an opportunity to take revenge, he hit the Zen Master in the shin with a palm. From then on, a pimple appeared on the Zen Master's knee with a human face, with eyelashes, eyes, mouth, and teeth. Every day it must eat meat and drink wine. If you don't give it meat and alcohol, the boils will become painful and indescribable. No matter how many doctors give up, there is no cure.

While Zen Master Ngo Dat had not achieved the glorious position of National Master. One year at the temple in Truong An, the Zen Master met a monk who was suffering from a strange, poisonous wart. Pimples that ooze and bleed look really dirty, and also give off a foul smell, making people want to vomit. Everyone did not dare to go near the sick monk. At that time, Zen Master Ngo Dat was in the next room, coming every day to take care of this sick monk. The Zen master wholeheartedly served, offering food and water and cleaning the monk's wounds without worrying about the bad smell

filthy stink. Time passes without realizing it, summer passes and then autumn returns. When the climate became cool, the monk's acne gradually healed. When they were about to say goodbye, the sick monk said to Zen Master Ngo Dat: "Thank you for taking care of me. In the future, if you have any trouble, come to Mong Son in Sichuan to find me. On the mountain there are two giant pine trees as a sign. My name is Ca Nac." Zen Master Ngo Dat reminisced about the past and went to Mong Son to find the monk who had suffered from poisonous boils before. From afar, looking halfway up the mountain, the Zen Master saw two pine trees towering above the clouds. When he arrived in front of two pine trees, the Zen Master discovered a brightly shining golden pagoda. Just as I was about to go look for him, I saw the monk waiting in front of the temple door, smiling, then brought the Zen Master in. After Zen Master Ngo Dat bowed to the monk, the Zen master told him clearly about his suffering. The monk told the Zen master to go down to the cliff under the stream the next morning to clean his wound, and that would heal him.

On the morning of the second day, the young monk took the Zen Master to the cliff under the stream. Just as he was about to wash the wound, the boil on his face came out and said: "Please don't wash! There is an unfinished grudge between us. You are a senior monk, have read many scriptures, you must have read the history of Western Han. So do you know the story of Vien An slashing Trieu Tho's waist? Vien An is you now, and Trieu Tho is me in the past. You have been a monk for ten lives, practicing seriously, so I haven't found a chance to report it." Because he was arrogant, I had the opportunity to sneak in. Today, thanks to the compassionate Venerable Ca Nac, who wanted to reconcile the resentment between us, he used the samadhi method to cleanse me, so from now on, I will no longer resent him."

After National Teacher Ngo Dat finished listening, his soul drifted to cloud nine. He quickly scooped up water to wash the poisonous boils, but felt a sharp pain in his bones, then fell into a coma. After a long time, when I suddenly woke up and looked down at my knee, I could no longer see any traces of the poisonous boils. Only then did the National Master know that the monk was a holy monk. The National Master intended to return to the temple to admire and worship the monk, but as soon as he turned around and looked back, he could not see the temple anywhere. Then the National Master tied grass and set up a tent in that place and took care of the rituals and recitations early and late in the evening. The National Master is the author of the Dharma Repentance, as we know today, the "Compassionate Samadhi Water Repentance" consisting of three volumes.

Through the two stories above, although there are a few differences, they are mostly the same, they are a warning to people that the cause and effect of retribution is truly flawless. The first story is the retribution that takes place in this life, while the second story is the retribution that occurs in the next ten lives. In short, when karma matures, our destiny has come and we will eventually have to suffer retribution. Today I talk about these two koans so that everyone can clearly understand that killing is harmful, and should not be seen as a child's game. Nowadays, science is getting more and more advanced, so the weapons used to kill people will also get worse. How can they eliminate all the causes and effects they have caused?

Currently the world is in a dark scene full of miasma, the slightest touch will cause a great war to break out. The resentful demons will use this as an excuse to take revenge. But the unjust retribution, who knows when will it end? Unless it is not killing; Otherwise, we will never have a day of peace.

HT. Tuyen Hoa lectured on April 15, 1984

tieu_de: CHAPTER 12: GOOD AND EVIL RESPONSE FOR PORN AND FORLESSNESS
noi_dung: CHAPTER 12: GOOD AND EVIL REPORT FOR PORN AND FORLESSNESS

tieu_de: 12.1 The retribution of cultural celebrities who commit evil karma Story one:
noi_dung:
12.1 The retribution of a cultural celebrity who committed evil karma First story:

During the Song Dynasty, a famous author was the scholar Huynh Son Khuc (also named Huynh Dinh Kien, the same name as To Dong Ba), who liked to compose all kinds of literature and stories depicting sexual immorality. One time, he visited a monk at Vien Thong Zen Monastery. Just when we met, the Zen Master heard him say: "If a great man produces a gentle pen, would he be willing to use it for low-class and lewd works?". At that time, the Zen Master had just advised the artist Ly Bat Thoi to paint horses, which immediately turned into a good saying, everyone knew about it. After hearing this, Huynh Son Khuc laughed and said: "I write poetry and create literature. Based on the law of cause and effect, in this life or the next life, can I be reincarnated into the belly of a horse?" The Zen master said: “Ly Bat Thoi often thinks of horses with all his heart and mind, describes horses, sculpts horses, his spiritual energy turns into horses, if he wants to fall, he is alone, but he uses lewd words about sex to seduce people's minds, seduce humans to penetrate, many people, due to their weak will, have committed many anti-moral things and rape.Your retribution is not just to be reincarnated in the belly of a horse, I'm afraid you will have to lie down in the great hell to never be able to escape! " Huynh Son Khuc heard the hair on the back of his neck, was very ashamed, after that he no longer wrote and composed stories about adultery and sexual lust, and began to cultivate his mind and do good deeds to repent. His literate letters caused a certain consequence, making it difficult for him to escape, his two beloved wives. gradually passed away, old age brought illness to the end of his life.

Second story:

The author of the long-running novel "Water Margin", author Thi Nai Am in "Water Margin" psychologically used a lot of ink and ink to describe stories of rape and murder. Due to the influence of this karma, his descendants for many generations all had diseases in their bodies.

The second story three:

After being published, "Kim Binh Mai" the author's descendants all became mute, and in the next generation, no one became talented, and the lineage continued for five generations.

Story 4:

The author Ly Tong Ngo of "Post-Black Studies" loves to reverse the discourses of previous generations and sages, and specializes in stirring up controversy, causing a lot of stir. He was poor all his life, and eventually died unjustly on the street.

Story 5:

The famous novelist in England, who composed many stories and edited plays, was a talented young man. When he wrote his last book, "Lady Tra's Lover", the book meticulously described extramarital affairs. It was banned by the government from publication because it was considered an adulterous book. When he finished writing this story, he passed away a year later. He was only 44 years old at the time of his death.

The disasters like the above are people who use letters and books to harm people. The ancients have a saying: "If you kill people with a knife, you will kill yourself" which is a very true saying.

tieu_de: 12.2 Change evil to good, pray for your child to be as desired Story 1:
noi_dung:
12.2 Converting evil to good, praying for children to be as desired First story:

There was a person named Gia Nhan, who was over 50 years old and still had no children. He really wanted to. One evening, he dreamed of a palace with the words "Genesis Tu" written on it. Gia Nhan immediately prayed about his children.

The other person took out a notebook, flipped it open and said: "You once raped a woman, wanting to ask for children is impossible." Gia Nhan was very surprised when he heard it, then he prayed wholeheartedly and said: "The small people were ignorant at that time, please beg for mercy and atonement for their sins." The mandarin said: "Even though you are repentant, you must advise 10 people not to commit adultery (not husband and wife but have sexual relations between men and women) in order to erase the sin karma you have and hope to have children to continue the family line." When Gia Nhan woke up, he was determined to repent, advise his friends and relatives to abstain from adultery, and also contributed money to print good books with advice not to fall into adultery and the book "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", which touched many people. Sure enough, he later gave birth to two sons.

Second story:

There is a man named Truong in Hoa Dinh district who, when he was young, often set traps to lure young women into prostitution. After getting married, he gave birth to two sons, but due to congenital malnutrition, he died. He also suffered from lymphadenopathy, and treatment for many years was ineffective. After I died, he had the intention to usurp my wife. My wife did not agree, so she committed suicide. Later, because he died with a reputation for loyalty, I did not accept it. I was able to take revenge; when he reincarnated into a high-ranking monk, I was not able to take revenge; when I reincarnated again, he became a general, and his achievements were very good, so I was not able to take revenge in this life, but because he recently committed the crime of raping women, the God of fortune and fortune left him.Mr. Nguyen said: "The injustice of the family is easy to resolve, but not easy to end, let it go!", replied: "The words are like that but the hatred in the heart is difficult to resolve. Although Mr. Chi became a monk and became a monk, because he did not practice the Pure Land Venerable Dharma well, he did not reach the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, so he still had to enter the six paths of reincarnation. Then recite the mantra "Seven Buddhas to Kill Sins" (7 times, one prostration each time): "Li po li pôte . Khieu ho pheu po te . Thoi la ting numb . Felt pit la numb. Pele Mo ho tre numb . The foot is numb . So Ha” .

Recite this mantra continuously, whenever possible, as much as possible. In your free time, you must prioritize bowing to Buddha constantly, at least 21-50 bows each time. Buddha bowing posture: stand straight, clasp your hands on your forehead, bend down slowly, both hands touch the ground to support the kneeling person, slowly bring your chest down close to your knees, forehead touching the ground. Each time you bow, you recite: "Namo Thirty-Six Thousands of One Hundred Ten Thousand Nine Thousands Five Hundred Thousands with the same Name and Title of Amida Buddha".

2. Press the scriptures:

Proceed to publish sutras, good books and dedicate merits to pray for relief from karma, resentment against the owner or healing of illness, etc. The published scriptures can be "Ksitigarbha Original Prayer Sutra", "Amitabha Sutra", "Medicine Master Sutra", "Immeasurable Life Contemplation Sutra"...; Good books have the books "Ngoc Lich Buu Phieu", "Lieu Pham Tu Huan" or depending on what scripture you are happy with, you can print that scripture. In the case of dedicating to cure a serious illness, especially cancer, in addition to the above scriptures, one should also publish the sutra “Buddha's Teaching on Hemorrhoid Treatment Sutra of Diseases” (Cancer Treatment Sutra - Content, please see the last page). 3. Releasing animals

Sutra Medicine Master Liu Ly's Vow of Merit teaches: "Save living beings lives can eliminate diseases and escape accidents." The most precious living beings are lives, and the Buddhas love the most are living beings. Therefore, liberating captive animals (life release) means fulfilling the wishes of the Buddhas, and will be praised by the Buddhas, with immeasurable merit. Therefore, if you want to increase longevity and eliminate diseases, you should release animals as soon as possible. 14.10 BUDDHA TALK ON HEMORRHOIDS AND MERRHOLOGY

It's true, I heard it myself: at one time, Venerable Bac Gia Pham and five hundred outstanding Bhikkhus resided in Truc Lam, Raja Xa city. At that time, there were many monks among the monks who suffered from internal and external hemorrhoids and ulcers, causing their bodies to be thin, in excruciating pain, and extremely sad and miserable day and night. When Ananda saw this, he quickly went to the Buddha's residence, bowed at his feet, then stood aside and said: "World-Honored One!" Today in the city of Rajagrha, there are many monks suffering from hemorrhoids, causing their bodies to be thin, in excruciating pain, and extremely sad and miserable day and night. White World-Honored One! How to treat this disease?

The Buddha taught: Hey Ananda! Please listen to the sutra Hemorrhoid Treatment , then accept it, recite it, memorize it carefully so you don't forget it, and then preach it again for everyone to hear. This way all hemorrhoids will heal. These are hemorrhoids caused by leprosy, hemorrhoids caused by heat, hemorrhoids caused by the mind, and hemorrhoids caused by all three combined; or hemorrhoids from blood; or ulcers in the abdomen, nose, teeth, tongue, ears, top of the head, limbs, spine, urinary tract, ulcers appearing all over the body. Such hemorrhoids and ulcers will definitely dry up, fall off, and be eliminated. Ananda! Please receive and recite this mantra. The Buddha immediately proclaimed:Dammit tha, Atlanta, Atlam delusion, That's why, That's why, That's what I'm afraid of, That's what I'm afraid of, Tama is great, sa ha.Hey Ananda! On the range

Dai Tuyet mountain king in the north has a very tall Nan Thang sa-la tree. Its flowers have three periods: one is when they first bloom, two is when they are fully bloomed, and three is when they wither. This hemorrhoid dries up just like a flower withers and falls, never bleeding or pus again. Everything is dry and healed, no more pain forever. If anyone regularly recites this sutra, he will gain wisdom and life, remember the events of the past seven lives, and achieve the Dharma. Sa ha! The World-Honored One preached the mantra:Damn it, let it go, let it fall in love, let go of it, let it go, let it go, let it go, sa ha.After listening to the Buddha preach this sutra, he received Ananda and the crowd happily accepted it and respectfully practiced it.
